/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementaryPivot
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Map

/-!
# Canonical bottommost pivot and least column

Selection (Ring): `columnSupport`, `pivotRow = max'`, `IsGreatest`,
vanishing, naturality under injective `f`.

Least column: `leastIndex = min' univ`, `IsLeast`, order-iso.

Division: `canonicalPivotClearedAt g c = pivotCleared M r c _`,
column/row isolation, `canonicalPivotCleared` at `leastIndex`,
naturality via `pivotCleared_map` and injectivity of division homs.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix Finset Function

universe u v w

section ColumnSupport

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
variable {R : Type v} [Ring R]

/-- Rows with nonzero entry in column `c`. No `DecidableEq R`. -/
noncomputable def columnSupport (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) : Finset ι :=
  haveI : DecidablePred (fun i : ι => (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0) :=
    Classical.decPred _
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0

@[simp]
theorem mem_columnSupport (g : GL ι R) (c i : ι) :
    i ∈ columnSupport (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) ↔ (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  simp [columnSupport]

theorem columnSupport_nonempty [Nontrivial R] (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    (columnSupport g c).Nonempty := by
  classical
  by_contra h_empty
  rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h_empty
  have h_all_zero : ∀ i : ι, (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0 := by
    intro i
    by_contra h_ne
    have : i ∈ columnSupport g c := by rwa [mem_columnSupport]
    rw [h_empty] at this
    exact Finset.notMem_empty i this
  let N := ((g⁻¹ : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)
  have h_mul : N * (g : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 := by
    calc N * (g : Matrix ι ι R) = ((g⁻¹ * g : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl
      _ = ((1 : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
      _ = 1 := rfl
  have h_cc : (N * (g : Matrix ι ι R)) c c = (1 : Matrix ι ι R) c c := by
    rw [h_mul]
  have h_one : (1 : Matrix ι ι R) c c = (1 : R) := by simp [Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  have h_zero : (N * (g : Matrix ι ι R)) c c = 0 := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro k _
    simp [h_all_zero k]
  rw [h_zero, h_one] at h_cc
  exact one_ne_zero h_cc.symm

end ColumnSupport

section PivotRow

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type v} [Ring R] [Nontrivial R]

/-- Bottommost nonzero row in column `c`. -/
noncomputable def pivotRow (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) : ι :=
  (columnSupport g c).max' (columnSupport_nonempty g c)

theorem pivotRow_mem_columnSupport (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    pivotRow (R := R) g c ∈ columnSupport g c :=
  Finset.max'_mem _ _

theorem pivotRow_ne_zero (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    (g : Matrix ι ι R) (pivotRow g c) c ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← mem_columnSupport]
  exact pivotRow_mem_columnSupport g c

theorem pivotRow_le (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (i : ι)
    (hi : i ∈ columnSupport g c) : i ≤ pivotRow (R := R) g c :=
  Finset.le_max' _ _ hi

theorem pivotRow_isGreatest (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    IsGreatest {i | (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0} (pivotRow g c) := by
  constructor
  · exact pivotRow_ne_zero g c
  · intro j hj
    exact pivotRow_le g c j (by rwa [mem_columnSupport])

theorem pivotRow_gt_eq_zero (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (i : ι)
    (hi : pivotRow (R := R) g c < i) : (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0 := by
  by_contra h_ne
  exact not_le_of_gt hi (pivotRow_le g c i (by rwa [mem_columnSupport]))

end PivotRow

section Natural

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type v} [Ring R] {S : Type w} [Ring S]

private theorem map_ne_zero_iff_of_injective
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : Injective f) (x : R) : f x ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hfx hx
    rw [hx, f.map_zero] at hfx
    exact hfx rfl
  · intro hx h0
    exact hx (hf (by rw [h0, f.map_zero]))

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem columnSupport_mapRingHom
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : Injective f) (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    columnSupport (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c =
      columnSupport g c := by
  classical
  ext i
  simp only [mem_columnSupport, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom,
    Matrix.map_apply]
  exact map_ne_zero_iff_of_injective f hf _

private theorem isGreatest_unique
    {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] {s : Set α} {a b : α}
    (ha : IsGreatest s a) (hb : IsGreatest s b) : a = b :=
  le_antisymm (hb.2 ha.1) (ha.2 hb.1)

theorem pivotRow_mapRingHom [Nontrivial R] [Nontrivial S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : Injective f) (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) :
    pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c =
      pivotRow g c := by
  classical
  have h_eq_set :
      {i | (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g : Matrix ι ι S) i c ≠ 0} =
        {i | (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply]
    exact map_ne_zero_iff_of_injective f hf _
  have hg : IsGreatest {i | (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0} (pivotRow g c) :=
    pivotRow_isGreatest g c
  have hf_greatest : IsGreatest
      {i | (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g : Matrix ι ι S) i c ≠ 0}
      (pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) :=
    pivotRow_isGreatest _ c
  have hf' : IsGreatest {i | (g : Matrix ι ι R) i c ≠ 0}
      (pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) := by
    rwa [← h_eq_set]
  exact isGreatest_unique hf' hg

end Natural

section LeastIndex

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]

/-- Least element via `min' univ`. -/
noncomputable def leastIndex : ι :=
  Finset.univ.min' Finset.univ_nonempty

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
theorem leastIndex_le (j : ι) : (leastIndex (ι := ι)) ≤ j :=
  Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j)

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
theorem leastIndex_isLeast :
    IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) (leastIndex (ι := ι)) := by
  constructor
  · exact Set.mem_univ _
  · intro y _
    exact leastIndex_le (ι := ι) y

end LeastIndex

section LeastIndexIso

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Nonempty ι]
variable {κ : Type w} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ] [Nonempty κ]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] in
theorem leastIndex_map_orderIso (e : ι ≃o κ) :
    e (leastIndex (ι := ι)) = leastIndex (ι := κ) := by
  have h_img : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set κ) (e (leastIndex (ι := ι))) := by
    constructor
    · exact Set.mem_univ _
    · intro k _
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := e.surjective k
      exact e.monotone (leastIndex_le (ι := ι) j)
  have h_tgt : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set κ) (leastIndex (ι := κ)) :=
    leastIndex_isLeast (ι := κ)
  exact le_antisymm (h_img.2 (Set.mem_univ _)) (h_tgt.2 (Set.mem_univ _))

end LeastIndexIso

section DivisionRingConn

variable {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {K : Type v} [DivisionRing K]

private theorem divRingHom_map_ne_zero
    {L : Type w} [DivisionRing L] (f : K →+* L) {a : K} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    f a ≠ 0 := by
  intro h0
  have h1 : f (a * a⁻¹) = f 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ha]
  have hmul : f a * f a⁻¹ = 1 := by
    calc f a * f a⁻¹ = f (a * a⁻¹) := by rw [← f.map_mul]
      _ = f 1 := by rw [h1]
      _ = 1 := f.map_one
  rw [h0, zero_mul] at hmul
  exact one_ne_zero hmul.symm

private theorem divRingHom_injective
    {L : Type w} [DivisionRing L] (f : K →+* L) : Injective f := by
  intro a b hab
  by_contra hne
  have h_sub : a - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have h_map : f (a - b) = 0 := by rw [f.map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  exact divRingHom_map_ne_zero f h_sub h_map

private theorem rowClear_congr_same (M : Matrix ι ι K) {r c : ι}
    (hp1 hp2 : M r c ≠ 0) :
    rowClear (K := K) M r c hp1 = rowClear (K := K) M r c hp2 := by
  unfold rowClear
  exact congrArg (rowSweep r) (by funext i; rfl)

private theorem columnClear_congr_same (M : Matrix ι ι K) {r c : ι}
    (hp1 hp2 : M r c ≠ 0) :
    columnClear (K := K) M r c hp1 = columnClear (K := K) M r c hp2 := by
  unfold columnClear
  exact congrArg (columnSweep c) (by funext j; rfl)

private theorem pivotCleared_congr_same (M : Matrix ι ι K) {r c : ι}
    (hp1 hp2 : M r c ≠ 0) : pivotCleared M r c hp1 = pivotCleared M r c hp2 := by
  unfold pivotCleared
  rw [rowClear_congr_same M hp1 hp2, columnClear_congr_same M hp1 hp2]

private theorem pivotCleared_congr' (M : Matrix ι ι K) {r1 r2 c : ι}
    (h : r1 = r2) (hp1 : M r1 c ≠ 0) (hp2 : M r2 c ≠ 0) :
    pivotCleared M r1 c hp1 = pivotCleared M r2 c hp2 := by
  cases h
  exact pivotCleared_congr_same M hp1 hp2

/-- Clearing at column `c` using bottommost pivot. -/
noncomputable def canonicalPivotClearedAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    Matrix ι ι K :=
  pivotCleared (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c (pivotRow_ne_zero g c)

theorem canonicalPivotClearedAt_col_isolated
    (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) (i : ι) :
    canonicalPivotClearedAt (K := K) g c i c =
      if i = pivotRow g c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c else 0 := by
  unfold canonicalPivotClearedAt
  exact pivotCleared_col_isolated (pivotRow_ne_zero g c) (pivotRow_isGreatest g c) i

theorem canonicalPivotClearedAt_row_isolated_of_isLeast
    (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) (j : ι) :
    canonicalPivotClearedAt g c (pivotRow g c) j =
      if j = c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c else 0 := by
  unfold canonicalPivotClearedAt
  exact pivotCleared_row_isolated (pivotRow_ne_zero g c) hc j

theorem canonicalPivotClearedAt_pivot (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    canonicalPivotClearedAt g c (pivotRow g c) c =
      (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c := by
  unfold canonicalPivotClearedAt
  exact pivotCleared_pivot _ _ _ _

variable [Nonempty ι] in
/-- Clearing at `leastIndex`. -/
noncomputable def canonicalPivotCleared (g : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K :=
  canonicalPivotClearedAt (K := K) g (leastIndex (ι := ι))

variable [Nonempty ι] in
theorem canonicalPivotCleared_col_isolated (g : GL ι K) (i : ι) :
    canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g i (leastIndex (ι := ι)) =
      if i = pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) then
        (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
          (leastIndex (ι := ι))
      else 0 := by
  unfold canonicalPivotCleared
  exact canonicalPivotClearedAt_col_isolated g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) i

variable [Nonempty ι] in
theorem canonicalPivotCleared_row_isolated (g : GL ι K) (j : ι) :
    canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι))) j =
      if j = leastIndex (ι := ι) then
        (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
          (leastIndex (ι := ι))
      else 0 := by
  unfold canonicalPivotCleared
  exact canonicalPivotClearedAt_row_isolated_of_isLeast g _
    (leastIndex_isLeast (ι := ι)) j

variable [Nonempty ι] in
theorem canonicalPivotCleared_pivot (g : GL ι K) :
    canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
        (leastIndex (ι := ι)) =
      (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
        (leastIndex (ι := ι)) := by
  unfold canonicalPivotCleared
  exact canonicalPivotClearedAt_pivot g (leastIndex (ι := ι))

section NatDiv

variable {L : Type w} [DivisionRing L]

theorem canonicalPivotClearedAt_map
    (f : K →+* L) (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    (canonicalPivotClearedAt g c).map (⇑f) =
      canonicalPivotClearedAt (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c := by
  have hf : Injective f := divRingHom_injective f
  have h_r_eq :
      pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c =
        pivotRow g c := by
    have : Nontrivial K := inferInstance
    have : Nontrivial L := inferInstance
    exact pivotRow_mapRingHom f hf g c
  have hp : (g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c ≠ 0 := pivotRow_ne_zero g c
  have hMp : ((g : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f) (pivotRow g c) c ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.map_apply]
    exact divRingHom_map_ne_zero f hp
  calc (canonicalPivotClearedAt g c).map ⇑f
      = (pivotCleared (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c hp).map ⇑f := rfl
    _ = pivotCleared ((↑g : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f) (pivotRow g c) c hMp :=
        pivotCleared_map f (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c hp hMp
    _ = canonicalPivotClearedAt (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c := by
        calc _ = pivotCleared ((↑g : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f)
              (pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) c _ :=
            pivotCleared_congr' _ h_r_eq.symm hMp _
          _ = _ := rfl

variable [Nonempty ι] in
theorem canonicalPivotCleared_map (f : K →+* L) (g : GL ι K) :
    (canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g).map (⇑f) =
      canonicalPivotCleared (K := L)
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) := by
  unfold canonicalPivotCleared
  rw [canonicalPivotClearedAt_map f g (leastIndex (ι := ι))]

end NatDiv

end DivisionRingConn

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.CanonicalPivot
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.IsolatedCoordinate
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Monomial
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Swap
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-!
# Canonical pivot reduction to an isolated diagonal block

For `g : GL ι K` over a division ring, the canonical pivot clearing produces a matrix
whose column `c` and, when `c` is least, row `pivotRow g c` are isolated.
Swapping rows `pivotRow g c ↔ c` turns the off-diagonal pivot into an isolated
diagonal coordinate at `c`. Deleting `c` yields the smaller `GL (DeletedIndex ι c) K`
block for recursive Bruhat extraction.

API:
* `canonicalPivotUnitAt` / `alignedPivotUnitAt` / `reducedPivotBlockAt`
* least-index variants `canonicalPivotUnit` / `alignedPivotUnit` / `reducedPivotBlock`
* cardinal decrease `Fintype.card (DeletedIndex ι c) = Fintype.card ι - 1`
* naturality under arbitrary division-ring homs `f : K →+* L`
* optional factorisation recovering `g`

Uses `canonicalPivotClearedAt_*` isolation lemmas and `Matrix.swap` row-action lemmas
without expanding permutation matrices.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix

universe uι uK vK

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {K : Type uK} [DivisionRing K]

/-! ## Canonical pivot unit -/

/-- `rowClear * g * columnClear` as a `GL` element. -/
noncomputable def canonicalPivotUnitAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) : GL ι K :=
  let M := (↑g : Matrix ι ι K)
  let r := pivotRow g c
  let hp := pivotRow_ne_zero g c
  rowClear M r c hp * g * columnClear M r c hp

theorem coe_canonicalPivotUnitAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    (↑(canonicalPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) = canonicalPivotClearedAt g c :=
  rfl

/-! ## Swap alignment -/

/-- Row transposition `pivotRow g c ↔ c`. -/
noncomputable def pivotSwap (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) : Equiv.Perm ι :=
  Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c

/-- Permutation unit for `pivotSwap`. -/
noncomputable def pivotPermutation (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) : GL ι K :=
  permutationUnitsHom K ι (pivotSwap g c)

theorem pivotSwap_self_inv (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    (pivotSwap g c)⁻¹ = pivotSwap g c := by
  unfold pivotSwap
  -- `Equiv.swap` is involutive: symm = itself, and Perm inverse = symm
  have h : (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c).symm = Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c :=
    Equiv.symm_swap (pivotRow g c) c
  -- for Perm, inverse is symm
  calc (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c : Equiv.Perm ι)⁻¹
      = (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c).symm := rfl
    _ = Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c := h

theorem coe_pivotPermutation (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    (↑(pivotPermutation g c) : Matrix ι ι K) = Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g c) c := by
  unfold pivotPermutation pivotSwap
  rw [coe_permutationUnitsHom]
  have h_inv : (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c : Equiv.Perm ι)⁻¹ =
      Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c := by
    have h : (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c).symm = Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c :=
      Equiv.symm_swap (pivotRow g c) c
    calc (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c : Equiv.Perm ι)⁻¹
        = (Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c).symm := rfl
      _ = Equiv.swap (pivotRow g c) c := h
  rw [h_inv]
  rfl

/-- Swap-aligned pivot unit: permutation moves the isolated row to diagonal `c`. -/
noncomputable def alignedPivotUnitAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) : GL ι K :=
  pivotPermutation g c * canonicalPivotUnitAt g c

theorem coe_alignedPivotUnitAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g c) c * canonicalPivotClearedAt g c := by
  unfold alignedPivotUnitAt
  calc (↑(pivotPermutation g c * canonicalPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K)
      = (↑(pivotPermutation g c) : Matrix ι ι K) *
        (↑(canonicalPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) := by
          rw [Units.val_mul]
    _ = Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g c) c * canonicalPivotClearedAt g c := by
          rw [coe_pivotPermutation, coe_canonicalPivotUnitAt]

/-! ## Isolated diagonal after swap -/

theorem alignedPivotIsolatedAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (alignedPivotUnitAt g c) c := by
  let pRow := pivotRow g c
  let Bmat : Matrix ι ι K := canonicalPivotClearedAt (K := K) g c
  have hA : (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat := coe_alignedPivotUnitAt g c
  have hBcol : ∀ i : ι, Bmat i c =
      if i = pRow then (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) pRow c else 0 :=
    fun i => canonicalPivotClearedAt_col_isolated g c i
  have hBrow : ∀ j : ι, Bmat pRow j =
      if j = c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) pRow c else 0 :=
    fun j => canonicalPivotClearedAt_row_isolated_of_isLeast g c hc j
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    have h_eq : (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) i c =
        (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) i c := by rw [hA]
    rw [h_eq]
    by_cases h_ir : i = pRow
    · have h_rc_ne : pRow ≠ c := by
        intro h_eq
        exact hi (h_ir.trans h_eq)
      have h_swap_left : (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) pRow c = Bmat c c := by
        have := Matrix.swap_mul_apply_left (R := K) pRow c c Bmat
        exact this
      have h_rw : (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) i c =
          (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) pRow c := by rw [h_ir]
      rw [h_rw, h_swap_left, hBcol c]
      simp [Ne.symm h_rc_ne]
    · have h_i_ne_r : i ≠ pRow := h_ir
      have h_i_ne_c : i ≠ c := hi
      have h_swap_ne : (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) i c = Bmat i c :=
        Matrix.swap_mul_of_ne h_i_ne_r h_i_ne_c Bmat
      rw [h_swap_ne, hBcol i]
      simp [h_i_ne_r]
  · intro j hj
    have h_eq : (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K) c j =
        (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) c j := by rw [hA]
    rw [h_eq]
    have h_swap_right : (Matrix.swap K pRow c * Bmat) c j = Bmat pRow j := by
      have := Matrix.swap_mul_apply_right (R := K) pRow c j Bmat
      exact this
    rw [h_swap_right, hBrow j]
    simp [hj]

/-! ## Reduced block -/

/-- Deleting the isolated coordinate `c` after alignment. -/
noncomputable def reducedPivotBlockAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) :
    GL (DeletedIndex ι c) K :=
  deleteCoordinate (alignedPivotUnitAt g c) c (alignedPivotIsolatedAt g c hc)

theorem coe_reducedPivotBlockAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) :
    (↑(reducedPivotBlockAt g c hc) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) K) =
      (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c) : Matrix ι ι K).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val :=
  rfl

theorem coe_reducedPivotBlockAt_eq (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) :
    (↑(reducedPivotBlockAt g c hc) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) K) =
      (Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g c) c * canonicalPivotClearedAt g c).submatrix
        Subtype.val Subtype.val := by
  rw [coe_reducedPivotBlockAt, coe_alignedPivotUnitAt]

theorem coe_inv_reducedPivotBlockAt (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) :
    (↑(reducedPivotBlockAt g c hc)⁻¹ : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) K) =
      (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt g c)⁻¹ : Matrix ι ι K).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val :=
  rfl

/-! ## Least-index variants -/

section LeastIndex

variable [Nonempty ι]

/-- Canonical pivot clearing at `leastIndex`. -/
noncomputable def canonicalPivotUnit (g : GL ι K) : GL ι K :=
  canonicalPivotUnitAt g (leastIndex (ι := ι))

/-- Aligned version at `leastIndex`. -/
noncomputable def alignedPivotUnit (g : GL ι K) : GL ι K :=
  alignedPivotUnitAt g (leastIndex (ι := ι))

/-- Reduced block at `leastIndex`. -/
noncomputable def reducedPivotBlock (g : GL ι K) :
    GL (DeletedIndex ι (leastIndex (ι := ι))) K :=
  reducedPivotBlockAt g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) (leastIndex_isLeast (ι := ι))

theorem coe_canonicalPivotUnit (g : GL ι K) :
    (↑(canonicalPivotUnit g) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g := by
  unfold canonicalPivotUnit canonicalPivotCleared
  rfl

theorem coe_alignedPivotUnit (g : GL ι K) :
    (↑(alignedPivotUnit g) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι))) (leastIndex (ι := ι)) *
        canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g := by
  unfold alignedPivotUnit canonicalPivotCleared
  exact coe_alignedPivotUnitAt g (leastIndex (ι := ι))

theorem alignedPivotUnit_isolated (g : GL ι K) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (alignedPivotUnit g) (leastIndex (ι := ι)) :=
  alignedPivotIsolatedAt g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) (leastIndex_isLeast (ι := ι))

theorem coe_reducedPivotBlock (g : GL ι K) :
    (↑(reducedPivotBlock g) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
        (DeletedIndex ι (leastIndex (ι := ι))) K) =
      (↑(alignedPivotUnit g) : Matrix ι ι K).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val :=
  rfl

theorem coe_reducedPivotBlock_eq (g : GL ι K) :
    (↑(reducedPivotBlock g) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι (leastIndex (ι := ι)))
        (DeletedIndex ι (leastIndex (ι := ι))) K) =
      (Matrix.swap K (pivotRow g (leastIndex (ι := ι))) (leastIndex (ι := ι)) *
        canonicalPivotCleared (K := K) g).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val := by
  rw [coe_reducedPivotBlock, coe_alignedPivotUnit]

end LeastIndex

/-! ## Cardinality decrease -/

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem card_DeletedIndex (c : ι) :
    Fintype.card (DeletedIndex ι c) = Fintype.card ι - 1 := by
  have h_one : Fintype.card { x : ι // x = c } = 1 :=
    Fintype.card_subtype_eq c
  have h_compl : Fintype.card { x : ι // ¬(x = c) } =
      Fintype.card ι - Fintype.card { x : ι // x = c } :=
    Fintype.card_subtype_compl (fun x => x = c)
  calc Fintype.card (DeletedIndex ι c)
      = Fintype.card { x : ι // ¬(x = c) } := rfl
    _ = Fintype.card ι - Fintype.card { x : ι // x = c } := h_compl
    _ = Fintype.card ι - 1 := by rw [h_one]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem card_DeletedIndex_lt [Nonempty ι] (c : ι) :
    Fintype.card (DeletedIndex ι c) < Fintype.card ι := by
  have h_eq := card_DeletedIndex (ι := ι) c
  have h_pos : 0 < Fintype.card ι := Fintype.card_pos
  omega

/-! ## Naturality under division-ring homs -/

section Naturality

variable {L : Type vK} [DivisionRing L]
variable (f : K →+* L)

private theorem divRingHom_injective_of_div (f : K →+* L) : Function.Injective f := by
  intro a b hab
  by_contra hne
  have h_sub : a - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have h_map : f (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [f.map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have h_mul : f (a - b) * f (a - b)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    have h1 : (a - b) * (a - b)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h_sub
    calc f (a - b) * f (a - b)⁻¹
        = f ((a - b) * (a - b)⁻¹) := by rw [← f.map_mul]
      _ = f 1 := by rw [h1]
      _ = 1 := f.map_one
  rw [h_map, zero_mul] at h_mul
  exact one_ne_zero h_mul.symm

private theorem divRingHom_map_ne_zero_of_div {a : K} (ha : a ≠ 0) (f : K →+* L) :
    f a ≠ 0 := by
  intro h0
  have h1 : f (a * a⁻¹) = f 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ha]
  have hmul : f a * f a⁻¹ = 1 := by
    calc f a * f a⁻¹ = f (a * a⁻¹) := by rw [← f.map_mul]
      _ = f 1 := by rw [h1]
      _ = 1 := f.map_one
  rw [h0, zero_mul] at hmul
  exact one_ne_zero hmul.symm

theorem pivotRow_mapRingHom_div (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) (f : K →+* L) :
    pivotRow (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c = pivotRow g c := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := divRingHom_injective_of_div f
  exact pivotRow_mapRingHom (R := K) (S := L) f hf g c

theorem pivotSwap_mapRingHom_div (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) (f : K →+* L) :
    pivotSwap (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c = pivotSwap g c := by
  unfold pivotSwap
  rw [pivotRow_mapRingHom_div g c f]

theorem canonicalPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) (f : K →+* L) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f (canonicalPivotUnitAt g c) =
      canonicalPivotUnitAt (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_mapRingHom]
  rw [coe_canonicalPivotUnitAt, coe_canonicalPivotUnitAt]
  exact canonicalPivotClearedAt_map f g c

theorem pivotPermutation_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (f : K →+* L) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (pivotPermutation g c) =
      pivotPermutation (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c := by
  unfold pivotPermutation
  have h_swap_eq : pivotSwap (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c = pivotSwap g c :=
    pivotSwap_mapRingHom_div g c f
  calc mapRingHom (n := ι) f (permutationUnitsHom K ι (pivotSwap g c))
      = permutationUnitsHom L ι (pivotSwap g c) :=
          permutationUnitsHom_mapRingHom f (pivotSwap g c)
    _ = permutationUnitsHom L ι (pivotSwap (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) := by
          rw [h_swap_eq]

theorem alignedPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (f : K →+* L) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (alignedPivotUnitAt g c) =
      alignedPivotUnitAt (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c := by
  unfold alignedPivotUnitAt
  rw [map_mul]
  rw [pivotPermutation_mapRingHom g c f,
    canonicalPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom g c f]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
private theorem deleteCoordinate_proof_irrel (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (h1 h2 : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    deleteCoordinate g c h1 = deleteCoordinate g c h2 := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

theorem reducedPivotBlockAt_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K) (c : ι)
    (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) (f : K →+* L) :
    mapRingHom (n := DeletedIndex ι c) f (reducedPivotBlockAt g c hc) =
      reducedPivotBlockAt (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c hc := by
  unfold reducedPivotBlockAt
  have h_map_del :
      mapRingHom (n := DeletedIndex ι c) f
        (deleteCoordinate (alignedPivotUnitAt g c) c
          (alignedPivotIsolatedAt g c hc)) =
      deleteCoordinate (mapRingHom (n := ι) f (alignedPivotUnitAt g c)) c
        ((alignedPivotIsolatedAt g c hc).map f) := by
    rw [← mapRingHom_deleteCoordinate]
  calc mapRingHom (n := DeletedIndex ι c) f
          (deleteCoordinate (alignedPivotUnitAt g c) c
            (alignedPivotIsolatedAt g c hc))
      = deleteCoordinate (mapRingHom (n := ι) f (alignedPivotUnitAt g c)) c
          ((alignedPivotIsolatedAt g c hc).map f) := h_map_del
    _ = deleteCoordinate (alignedPivotUnitAt (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) c
          (alignedPivotIsolatedAt (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c hc) := by
            have h_aligned_val :
                (↑(mapRingHom (n := ι) f (alignedPivotUnitAt g c)) :
                  Matrix ι ι L) =
                (↑(alignedPivotUnitAt (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) c) :
                  Matrix ι ι L) := by
              rw [alignedPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom]
            apply Units.ext
            simp only [coe_deleteCoordinate]
            rw [h_aligned_val]

section Least

variable [Nonempty ι]

theorem canonicalPivotUnit_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K)
    (f : K →+* L) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (canonicalPivotUnit g) =
      canonicalPivotUnit (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) :=
  canonicalPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) f

theorem alignedPivotUnit_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K)
    (f : K →+* L) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (alignedPivotUnit g) =
      alignedPivotUnit (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) :=
  alignedPivotUnitAt_mapRingHom g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) f

theorem reducedPivotBlock_mapRingHom (g : GL ι K)
    (f : K →+* L) :
    let c0 := leastIndex (ι := ι)
    mapRingHom (n := DeletedIndex ι c0) f (reducedPivotBlock g) =
      reducedPivotBlock (mapRingHom (n := ι) f g) := by
  unfold reducedPivotBlock
  exact reducedPivotBlockAt_mapRingHom g (leastIndex (ι := ι)) _ f

end Least

end Naturality

/-! ## Optional factorisation -/

section Factorization

/-- Recover `g` from its pivot clearers. -/
theorem canonicalPivotUnitAt_factorization (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    let Rclear :=
      rowClear (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c (pivotRow_ne_zero g c)
    let Cclear :=
      columnClear (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c (pivotRow_ne_zero g c)
    g = Rclear⁻¹ * canonicalPivotUnitAt g c * Cclear⁻¹ := by
  unfold canonicalPivotUnitAt
  group

/-- Full factorisation with swap alignment. -/
theorem alignedPivotUnitAt_factorization (g : GL ι K) (c : ι) :
    let Rclear :=
      rowClear (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c (pivotRow_ne_zero g c)
    let Cclear :=
      columnClear (↑g : Matrix ι ι K) (pivotRow g c) c (pivotRow_ne_zero g c)
    let P := pivotPermutation g c
    g = Rclear⁻¹ * P⁻¹ * alignedPivotUnitAt g c * Cclear⁻¹ := by
  intro Rclear Cclear P
  have h_aligned : P * (Rclear * g * Cclear) = alignedPivotUnitAt g c := rfl
  calc g = Rclear⁻¹ * P⁻¹ * (P * (Rclear * g * Cclear)) * Cclear⁻¹ := by group
    _ = Rclear⁻¹ * P⁻¹ * alignedPivotUnitAt g c * Cclear⁻¹ := by rw [h_aligned]

end Factorization

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Map
public import MathlibExt.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Quasiregular
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.TwoSidedIdeal.Kernel

/-!
# Congruence subgroups of finite general linear groups

For a two-sided ideal `I` of a ring `R`, the finite-rank congruence subgroup
is the kernel of the coefficient map

`GL n R → GL n (R ⨸ I.ringCon)`.

Membership is equivalently entrywise congruence to the identity matrix.  If
`I` is quasiregular, the quotient map on `GL` is surjective.  The lifting proof
uses both products of chosen lifts of a quotient unit and its inverse; it does
not assume commutativity or stable finiteness.

No stable relative general linear group or relative `K₁` is defined here.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Function

universe u v w

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {n : Type u} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
variable {R : Type v} [Ring R]

/-- The finite-rank congruence subgroup modulo a two-sided ideal. -/
def congruenceSubgroup (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) : Subgroup (GL n R) :=
  (mapRingHom (n := n) I.ringCon.mk').ker

/-- Membership in the congruence subgroup means that reduction modulo the
ideal is the identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) (g : GL n R) :
    g ∈ congruenceSubgroup (n := n) I ↔
      mapRingHom I.ringCon.mk' g = 1 :=
  MonoidHom.mem_ker

/-- Entrywise characterization of congruence-subgroup membership. -/
theorem mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) (g : GL n R) :
    g ∈ congruenceSubgroup (n := n) I ↔
      ∀ i j, (g : Matrix n n R) i j - (1 : Matrix n n R) i j ∈ I := by
  constructor
  · intro hg i j
    have hg' := (mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff I g).mp hg
    have hmat :
        (g : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' =
          (1 : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' := by
      calc
        (g : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' =
            (↑(mapRingHom I.ringCon.mk' g) : Matrix n n I.ringCon.Quotient) :=
          (coe_mapRingHom I.ringCon.mk' g).symm
        _ = ↑(1 : GL n I.ringCon.Quotient) := congrArg Units.val hg'
        _ = 1 := rfl
        _ = (1 : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' :=
          I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix.map_one.symm
    have hij := congr_fun (congr_fun hmat i) j
    exact (I.rel_iff _ _).mp (Quotient.eq'.mp hij)
  · intro hg
    have hmat :
        (g : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' =
          (1 : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' := by
      ext i j
      exact Quotient.sound' ((I.rel_iff _ _).mpr (hg i j))
    apply (mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff I g).mpr
    apply Units.ext
    calc
      (↑(mapRingHom I.ringCon.mk' g) : Matrix n n I.ringCon.Quotient) =
          (g : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' :=
        coe_mapRingHom I.ringCon.mk' g
      _ = (1 : Matrix n n R).map I.ringCon.mk' := hmat
      _ = 1 := I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix.map_one
      _ = ↑(1 : GL n I.ringCon.Quotient) := rfl

/-- Congruence subgroups are monotone in the two-sided ideal. -/
theorem congruenceSubgroup_mono {I J : TwoSidedIdeal R} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    congruenceSubgroup (n := n) I ≤ congruenceSubgroup (n := n) J := by
  intro g hg
  apply (mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries J g).mpr
  intro i j
  exact hIJ ((mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries I g).mp hg i j)

/-- The congruence subgroup modulo the zero ideal is trivial. -/
@[simp]
theorem congruenceSubgroup_bot :
    congruenceSubgroup (n := n) (⊥ : TwoSidedIdeal R) = ⊥ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
    apply Units.ext
    ext i j
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp
      ((TwoSidedIdeal.mem_bot R).mp
        ((mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries (⊥ : TwoSidedIdeal R) g).mp hg i j))
  · exact bot_le

/-- The congruence subgroup modulo the unit ideal is the whole general linear
group. -/
@[simp]
theorem congruenceSubgroup_top :
    congruenceSubgroup (n := n) (⊤ : TwoSidedIdeal R) = ⊤ := by
  apply top_unique
  intro g _
  apply (mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries (⊤ : TwoSidedIdeal R) g).mpr
  intro i j
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mem_top _

/-- A coefficient map carries the congruence subgroup modulo `I` into that
modulo `J` whenever it carries `I` into `J`. -/
theorem mapRingHom_mem_congruenceSubgroup
    {S : Type w} [Ring S] (f : R →+* S)
    {I : TwoSidedIdeal R} {J : TwoSidedIdeal S}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J.comap f) {g : GL n R}
    (hg : g ∈ congruenceSubgroup (n := n) I) :
    mapRingHom f g ∈ congruenceSubgroup (n := n) J := by
  apply (mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries J (mapRingHom f g)).mpr
  intro i j
  have hmem := hIJ ((mem_congruenceSubgroup_iff_entries I g).mp hg i j)
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.mem_comap] at hmem
  have hone : f ((1 : Matrix n n R) i j) = (1 : Matrix n n S) i j :=
    congr_fun (congr_fun f.mapMatrix.map_one i) j
  simpa only [coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply, map_sub, hone] using hmem

private theorem mapMatrix_surjective {S : Type w} [Ring S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (f.mapMatrix : Matrix n n R → Matrix n n S) := by
  classical
  intro A
  choose a ha using fun i j ↦ hf (A i j)
  refine ⟨fun i j ↦ a i j, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  exact ha i j

private theorem isUnit_of_mul_and_reverse_isUnit {M : Type*} [Monoid M]
    {a b : M} (hab : IsUnit (a * b)) (hba : IsUnit (b * a)) : IsUnit a := by
  let r : M := b * ↑hab.unit⁻¹
  let l : M := ↑hba.unit⁻¹ * b
  have har : a * r = 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [← mul_assoc, hab.mul_val_inv]
  have hla : l * a = 1 := by
    dsimp [l]
    rw [mul_assoc, hba.val_inv_mul]
  have hlr : l = r := by
    calc
      l = l * 1 := (mul_one l).symm
      _ = l * (a * r) := by rw [har]
      _ = (l * a) * r := (mul_assoc l a r).symm
      _ = r := by rw [hla, one_mul]
  exact ⟨⟨a, r, har, by rw [← hlr]; exact hla⟩, rfl⟩

private theorem sub_one_mem_matrix_of_map_eq_one
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) (A : Matrix n n R)
    (hA : I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix A = 1) :
    A - 1 ∈ I.matrix n := by
  change ∀ i j, A i j - (1 : Matrix n n R) i j ∈ I
  have hA' :
      I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix A =
        I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix (1 : Matrix n n R) := by
    exact hA.trans I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix.map_one.symm
  intro i j
  apply (I.rel_iff _ _).mp
  apply Quotient.eq'.mp
  exact congr_fun (congr_fun hA' i) j

/-- If `I` is quasiregular, every invertible matrix over `R/I` lifts to an
invertible matrix over `R`. -/
theorem mapRingHom_quotient_surjective (I : TwoSidedIdeal R)
    (hI : I.IsQuasiregular) :
    Function.Surjective (mapRingHom (n := n) I.ringCon.mk') := by
  classical
  intro g
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := mapMatrix_surjective (n := n) I.ringCon.mk'
    I.ringCon.mk'_surjective (g : Matrix n n I.ringCon.Quotient)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := mapMatrix_surjective (n := n) I.ringCon.mk'
    I.ringCon.mk'_surjective (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix n n I.ringCon.Quotient)
  have hABmap : I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix (A * B) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, hA, hB]
    exact congrArg Units.val (mul_inv_cancel g)
  have hBAmap : I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix (B * A) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, hA, hB]
    exact congrArg Units.val (inv_mul_cancel g)
  have hABerr : A * B - 1 ∈ I.matrix n :=
    sub_one_mem_matrix_of_map_eq_one I (A * B) hABmap
  have hBAerr : B * A - 1 ∈ I.matrix n :=
    sub_one_mem_matrix_of_map_eq_one I (B * A) hBAmap
  have hABunit₀ : IsUnit (1 + (A * B - 1)) :=
    (TwoSidedIdeal.isQuasiregular_iff_forall_isUnit_one_add.mp
      (hI.matrix n)) _ hABerr
  have hBAunit₀ : IsUnit (1 + (B * A - 1)) :=
    (TwoSidedIdeal.isQuasiregular_iff_forall_isUnit_one_add.mp
      (hI.matrix n)) _ hBAerr
  have hABeq : 1 + (A * B - 1) = A * B := by abel
  have hBAeq : 1 + (B * A - 1) = B * A := by abel
  have hABunit : IsUnit (A * B) := hABeq ▸ hABunit₀
  have hBAunit : IsUnit (B * A) := hBAeq ▸ hBAunit₀
  have hAunit : IsUnit A := isUnit_of_mul_and_reverse_isUnit hABunit hBAunit
  refine ⟨hAunit.unit, ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  change I.ringCon.mk'.mapMatrix
      (↑hAunit.unit : Matrix n n R) = (g : Matrix n n I.ringCon.Quotient)
  rw [hAunit.unit_spec]
  exact hA

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

end

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementaryDiagonal
import Mathlib.Tactic.NoncommRing

/-! # The rank-one Dennis--Stein matrix identity

The four elementary factors in the Dennis--Stein word multiply to the
standard six-factor torus word.  The calculation is valid over an arbitrary
ring: the two coefficients are only required to commute.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R] {ι : Type*}

private theorem elementary_dennisStein_finTwo
    (r s : R) (hrs : Commute r s) (u : Rˣ) (hu : (u : R) = 1 - r * s) :
    elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (-(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R))) *
        elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-r) *
        elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) s *
        elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * r) =
      (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (u : R) *
          elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (-(↑u⁻¹ : R)) *
          elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (u : R)) *
        (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-1 : R) *
          elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (1 : R) *
          elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-1 : R)) := by
  have hs_rs : Commute s (r * s) := hrs.symm.mul_right (Commute.refl s)
  have hs_u : Commute s (u : R) := by
    rw [hu]
    exact (Commute.one_right s).sub_right hs_rs
  have hs_uinv : Commute s (↑u⁻¹ : R) := hs_u.units_inv_right
  have hu_mul_inv : (u : R) * (↑u⁻¹ : R) = 1 := u.mul_inv
  have hinv_mul_u : (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (u : R) = 1 := u.inv_mul
  have hinv_mul_sub : (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (1 - r * s) = 1 := by
    rw [← hu]
    exact hinv_mul_u
  have hinv_sub : (↑u⁻¹ : R) - (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (r * s) = 1 := by
    calc
      (↑u⁻¹ : R) - (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (r * s) =
          (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (1 - r * s) := by noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 := hinv_mul_sub
  have hinv_rs_add_one : (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (r * s) + 1 = (↑u⁻¹ : R) := by
    rw [← hinv_sub]
    abel
  have hs_inv_r_add_one : 1 + s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r = (↑u⁻¹ : R) := by
    calc
      1 + s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r = 1 + (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (s * r) := by
        rw [hs_uinv.eq, mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 + (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (r * s) := by rw [← hrs.eq]
      _ = (↑u⁻¹ : R) * (r * s) + 1 := add_comm _ _
      _ = (↑u⁻¹ : R) := hinv_rs_add_one
  have h_lower_left :
      -(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) + (1 + s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r) * s = 0 := by
    rw [hs_inv_r_add_one, ← hs_uinv.eq, neg_add_cancel]
  have h_upper_right : (u : R) * ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * r) + (-r) = 0 := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hu_mul_inv, one_mul, add_neg_cancel]
  have h_upper : ∀ a : R,
      (↑(elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) a) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) =
        !![1, a; 0, 1] := by
    intro a
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [coe_elementary]
  have h_lower : ∀ a : R,
      (↑(elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) a) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) =
        !![1, 0; a, 1] := by
    intro a
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [coe_elementary]
  apply Units.ext
  calc
    (↑(elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (-(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R))) *
          elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-r) *
          elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) s *
          elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * r)) :
        Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) =
        !![1, 0; -(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R)), 1] *
          !![1, -r; 0, 1] * !![1, 0; s, 1] *
            !![1, (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r; 0, 1] := by
      simp only [Units.val_mul, h_upper, h_lower]
    _ = !![(u : R), 0; 0, (↑u⁻¹ : R)] := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hu.symm
      · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simpa [hu, sub_eq_add_neg] using h_upper_right
      · simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simpa [add_comm] using h_lower_left
      · suffices hscalar :
          (-(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) + (s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r + 1) * s) *
              ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * r) +
            (s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r + 1) = (↑u⁻¹ : R) by
            simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hscalar
        have hzero :
            -(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R)) + (s * (↑u⁻¹ : R) * r + 1) * s = 0 := by
          simpa [add_comm] using h_lower_left
        rw [hzero, zero_mul, zero_add]
        simpa [add_comm] using hs_inv_r_add_one
    _ = !![1, (u : R); 0, 1] * !![1, 0; -(↑u⁻¹ : R), 1] *
          !![1, (u : R); 0, 1] *
        (!![1, (-1 : R); 0, 1] * !![1, 0; (1 : R), 1] *
          !![1, (-1 : R); 0, 1]) := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, hu_mul_inv, hinv_mul_u]
    _ =
        (↑((elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (u : R) *
            elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (-(↑u⁻¹ : R)) *
            elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (u : R)) *
          (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-1 : R) *
            elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) (1 : R) *
            elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) (-1 : R))) :
          Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) := by
      simp only [Units.val_mul, h_upper, h_lower]

/-- The rank-one Dennis--Stein identity for arbitrary distinct coordinates.

If `r` and `s` commute and the unit `u` has value `1 - r * s`, then the
four-factor Dennis--Stein elementary word is the six-factor torus word. -/
theorem elementary_dennisStein (i j : ι) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
    (hij : i ≠ j) (r s : R) (hrs : Commute r s) (u : Rˣ)
    (hu : (u : R) = 1 - r * s) :
    elementary j i hij.symm (-(s * (↑u⁻¹ : R))) *
        elementary i j hij (-r) * elementary j i hij.symm s *
        elementary i j hij ((↑u⁻¹ : R) * r) =
      (elementary i j hij (u : R) *
          elementary j i hij.symm (-(↑u⁻¹ : R)) *
          elementary i j hij (u : R)) *
        (elementary i j hij (-1 : R) * elementary j i hij.symm (1 : R) *
          elementary i j hij (-1 : R)) := by
  let C := {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)}
  let e : Fin 2 ⊕ C ≃ ι := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.pairComplEquiv hij
  let φ : GL (Fin 2) R →* GL ι R :=
    (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e).toMonoidHom.comp
      (blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2) C R)
  have hi : e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) = i := by
    have h := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_i hij
    calc
      e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) = e (e.symm i) := by rw [h]
      _ = i := e.apply_symm_apply i
  have hj : e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) = j := by
    have h := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_j hij
    calc
      e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) = e (e.symm j) := by rw [h]
      _ = j := e.apply_symm_apply j
  have h01 : ∀ a : R, φ (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) a) =
      elementary i j hij a := by
    intro a
    calc
      φ (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) a) =
          reindexMulEquiv e
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2) C R
              (elementary (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide) a)) := rfl
      _ = reindexMulEquiv e
          (elementary (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) _ a) := by
            rw [blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
      _ = elementary (e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2))) (e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2))) _ a := by
            rw [reindexMulEquiv_elementary]
      _ = elementary i j hij a := by
            apply Units.ext
            simp only [coe_elementary]
            rw [hi, hj]
  have h10 : ∀ a : R, φ (elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) a) =
      elementary j i hij.symm a := by
    intro a
    calc
      φ (elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) a) =
          reindexMulEquiv e
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2) C R
              (elementary (1 : Fin 2) 0 (by decide) a)) := rfl
      _ = reindexMulEquiv e
          (elementary (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) _ a) := by
            rw [blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
      _ = elementary (e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2))) (e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2))) _ a := by
            rw [reindexMulEquiv_elementary]
      _ = elementary j i hij.symm a := by
            apply Units.ext
            simp only [coe_elementary]
            rw [hj, hi]
  have h := congrArg φ (elementary_dennisStein_finTwo r s hrs u hu)
  simpa only [map_mul, h01, h10] using h

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

end

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementarySubgroup
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Determinant.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Transvection

/-!
# Determinant for finite `GL`

Determinant compatibility for `mapRingHom`, `reindexMulEquiv`, `blockDiagonalOne`,
successor `stabilization`, elementary matrices, and `elementarySubgroup ≤ ker det`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup

universe u v w vI

variable {n : Type u} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type v} [CommRing R]
variable {S : Type w} [CommRing S]

/-- Determinant commutes with `mapRingHom` via `RingHom.map_det`. -/
@[simp]
theorem det_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) (g : GL n R) :
    det (mapRingHom (n := n) f g) = (det g).map f := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, coe_mapRingHom, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass]
  exact (RingHom.map_det f (↑g : Matrix n n R)).symm

section Reindex

variable {m : Type vI} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]

/-- Determinant is invariant under `reindexMulEquiv` via `det_reindex_self`. -/
@[simp]
theorem det_reindexMulEquiv (e : n ≃ m) (g : GL n R) :
    det (reindexMulEquiv (A := R) e g) = det g := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, coe_reindexMulEquiv]
  exact det_reindex_self e (↑g : Matrix n n R)

end Reindex

section BlockDiagonal

variable {m : Type vI} [DecidableEq m] [Fintype m]

/-- Determinant of `blockDiagonalOne` is the original determinant,
via `det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁` and `det_one`. -/
@[simp]
theorem det_blockDiagonalOne (g : GL n R) :
    det (blockDiagonalOne n m R g) = det g := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, coe_blockDiagonalOne, det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁,
    det_one, mul_one]

end BlockDiagonal

section Stabilization

/-- Determinant is invariant under successor `stabilization`,
via `blockDiagonalOne` and `reindexMulEquiv`. -/
@[simp]
theorem det_stabilization {k : ℕ} (g : GL (Fin k) R) :
    det (stabilization R (n := k) g) = det g := by
  calc
    det (stabilization R g)
        = det (reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1))
            (blockDiagonalOne (Fin k) (Fin 1) R g)) := rfl
    _ = det (blockDiagonalOne (Fin k) (Fin 1) R g) :=
        det_reindexMulEquiv (finSumFinEquiv (m := k) (n := 1))
          (blockDiagonalOne (Fin k) (Fin 1) R g)
    _ = det g := det_blockDiagonalOne g

end Stabilization

section ElementaryDet

variable {R : Type v} [CommRing R] {n : Type u} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]

/-- Determinant of an elementary matrix is `1`, via `det_transvection_of_ne`. -/
@[simp]
theorem det_elementary (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    det (elementary i j hij a) = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  -- `elementary` val is `1 + single i j a` = `transvection i j a`
  have h : (↑(elementary i j hij a) : Matrix n n R) = Matrix.transvection i j a := rfl
  simp only [GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, h, det_transvection_of_ne i j hij a,
    Units.val_one]

theorem elementary_mem_ker_det (i j : n) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    elementary i j hij a ∈ MonoidHom.ker (det : GL n R →* Rˣ) := by
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
  exact det_elementary i j hij a

/-- The finite elementary subgroup lies in the kernel of determinant. -/
theorem elementarySubgroup_le_ker_det :
    elementarySubgroup n R ≤ MonoidHom.ker (det : GL n R →* Rˣ) := by
  rw [elementarySubgroup, Subgroup.closure_le]
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact elementary_mem_ker_det i j hij a

/-- Every element of `elementarySubgroup` has determinant `1`. -/
theorem det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup {g : GL n R}
    (hg : g ∈ elementarySubgroup n R) : det g = 1 :=
  MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (elementarySubgroup_le_ker_det hg)

end ElementaryDet

end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Whitehead
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockElementary

/-!
# Two-coordinate diagonal matrices in the elementary subgroup

Over a field, determinant-one diagonal matrices supported on two distinct
coordinates (`diag2n` with entries `a` and `a⁻¹` and `1` elsewhere) lie in the
elementary subgroup.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup

open Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

/-- Equivalence between `Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1` and `{k // k = i ∨ k = j}` for distinct `i j`. -/
def twoEquiv {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ {k : ι // k = i ∨ k = j} where
  toFun
    | Sum.inl _ => ⟨i, Or.inl rfl⟩
    | Sum.inr _ => ⟨j, Or.inr rfl⟩
  invFun k := if k.val = i then Sum.inl 0 else Sum.inr 0
  left_inv := by
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl y => fin_cases y; simp
    | inr y => fin_cases y; simp [hij.symm]
  right_inv := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := k
    by_cases h : k = i
    · subst h; simp
    · have hk' : k = j := by
        rcases hk with rfl | rfl
        · exact absurd rfl h
        · rfl
      subst hk'; simp [h]

/-- The pair-plus-complement equivalence `(Fin 2 ⊕ {k // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)}) ≃ ι`
    using `Equiv.sumCompl`. -/
def pairComplEquiv {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Fin 2 ⊕ {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} ≃ ι :=
  let p : ι → Prop := fun k => k = i ∨ k = j
  let ePair : Fin 2 ≃ {k : ι // p k} :=
    (finSumFinEquiv (m := 1) (n := 1)).symm.trans (twoEquiv hij)
  (Equiv.sumCongr ePair (Equiv.refl _)).trans (Equiv.sumCompl p)

omit [Fintype ι] in
/-- `pairComplEquiv` sends `i` to `inl 0`. -/
@[simp]
theorem pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_i {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (pairComplEquiv hij).symm i = Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2) := by
  let p : ι → Prop := fun k => k = i ∨ k = j
  have hpi : p i := Or.inl rfl
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm i = Sum.inl ⟨i, hpi⟩ :=
    Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hpi
  simp [pairComplEquiv, twoEquiv, finSumFinEquiv]

omit [Fintype ι] in
/-- `pairComplEquiv` sends `j` to `inl 1`. -/
@[simp]
theorem pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_j {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (pairComplEquiv hij).symm j = Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2) := by
  let p : ι → Prop := fun k => k = i ∨ k = j
  have hpj : p j := Or.inr rfl
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm j = Sum.inl ⟨j, hpj⟩ :=
    Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hpj
  simp [pairComplEquiv, twoEquiv, finSumFinEquiv, hij.symm]

/-- The field diagonal `diag2n` with entries `a` and `a⁻¹` lies in the elementary subgroup. -/
theorem toGL_diag2n_mem_elementarySubgroup {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a : F) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (toGL (diag2n hij a ha) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) ∈
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup ι F := by
  let u : Fˣ := Units.mk0 a ha
  let g : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 1) F :=
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin 1) u
  have hg_mem : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g ∈
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F :=
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit_mem g
  let p : ι → Prop := fun k => k = i ∨ k = j
  let C := {k : ι // ¬ p k}
  let e₀ : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ C ≃ {k : ι // p k} ⊕ C :=
    Equiv.sumCongr (twoEquiv hij) (Equiv.refl C)
  let e : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ C ≃ ι :=
    e₀.trans (Equiv.sumCompl p)
  have h_block :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) C F
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g) ∈
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup
          ((Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ C) F :=
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockElementary.blockDiagonalOne_mem_elementarySubgroup hg_mem
  have h_reindex :
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) C F
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g))) ∈
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup ι F :=
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_mem_elementarySubgroup e h_block
  suffices heq :
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) C F
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g)) :
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) =
      (toGL (diag2n hij a ha) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) from
    heq ▸ h_reindex
  apply Units.ext
  have hD_eq : (diag2n hij a ha).1 =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun k : ι => if k = i then a else if k = j then a⁻¹ else 1) :=
    diag2n_coe hij a ha
  have h_toGL :
      ((toGL (diag2n hij a ha) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) : Matrix ι ι F) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun k : ι => if k = i then a else if k = j then a⁻¹ else 1) := by
    calc ((toGL (diag2n hij a ha) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) : Matrix ι ι F)
        = (diag2n hij a ha).1 := rfl
      _ = _ := hD_eq
  rw [h_toGL]
  simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_reindexMulEquiv,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_blockDiagonalOne, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  let D : ι → F := fun k => if k = i then a else if k = j then a⁻¹ else 1
  let d₁ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → F := Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 => a) (fun _ : Fin 1 => a⁻¹)
  let d : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ C → F := Sum.elim d₁ (fun _ : C => 1)
  have hg_coe : (↑g : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) F) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i
    fin_cases j
    simp [g, u, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_scalar, Units.val_mk0, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  have hg_inv_coe : (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) F) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 => a⁻¹) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i
    fin_cases j
    simp [g, u, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_scalar, Units.val_mk0, Matrix.scalar_apply]
  have h_diagUnit : (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g) :
      Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F) = Matrix.diagonal d₁ := by
    rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_diagUnit, hg_coe, hg_inv_coe, Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal]
  have hM : Matrix.fromBlocks
      (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g) : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F)
      (0 : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) C F) (0 : Matrix C (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F)
      (1 : Matrix C C F) = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [h_diagUnit, ← Matrix.diagonal_one (n := C) (α := F), Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal]
  have h_reindex_diag :
      (Matrix.fromBlocks
        (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.diagUnit g) : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F)
        (0 : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) C F) (0 : Matrix C (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) F)
        (1 : Matrix C C F)).submatrix ⇑e.symm ⇑e.symm =
      Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ ⇑e.symm) := by
    rw [hM, Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  rw [h_reindex_diag]
  have h_eq : d ∘ ⇑e.symm = D := by
    funext k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · have hpi : p k := by simp [p, hki]
      have he : e.symm k = Sum.inl (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 1)) := by
        have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k = Sum.inl ⟨k, hpi⟩ :=
          Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hpi
        have h2 : e₀.symm (Sum.inl ⟨k, hpi⟩) = Sum.inl (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 1)) := by
          simp [e₀, twoEquiv, hki]
        calc e.symm k = e₀.symm ((Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k) := by simp [e]
          _ = e₀.symm (Sum.inl ⟨k, hpi⟩) := by rw [h1]
          _ = Sum.inl (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 1)) := h2
      have hD : D k = a := by simp [D, hki]
      simp [he, hD, d, d₁]
    · by_cases hkj : k = j
      · have hpj : p k := by simp [p, hkj]
        have he : e.symm k = Sum.inl (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)) := by
          have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k = Sum.inl ⟨k, hpj⟩ :=
            Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hpj
          have h2 : e₀.symm (Sum.inl ⟨k, hpj⟩) = Sum.inl (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)) := by
            simp [e₀, twoEquiv, hij.symm, hkj]
          calc e.symm k = e₀.symm ((Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k) := by simp [e]
            _ = e₀.symm (Sum.inl ⟨k, hpj⟩) := by rw [h1]
            _ = Sum.inl (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)) := h2
        have hD : D k = a⁻¹ := by simp [D, hkj, hij.symm]
        simp [he, hD, d, d₁]
      · have hnp : ¬ p k := by simp [p, hki, hkj]
        have he : e.symm k = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ := by
          have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ :=
            Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hnp
          calc e.symm k = e₀.symm ((Equiv.sumCompl p).symm k) := by simp [e]
            _ = e₀.symm (Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩) := by rw [h1]
            _ = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ := by simp [e₀]
        have hD : D k = 1 := by simp [D, hki, hkj]
        simp [he, hD, d]
  rw [h_eq]

/-- `diag2n` equals the reindexed `blockDiagonalOne` of `diag2`. -/
theorem toGL_diag2n_eq_reindex_blockDiagonalOne_diag2 {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (u : Fˣ) :
    (toGL (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv (pairComplEquiv hij)
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
          {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
          (toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) :
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)) := by
  apply Units.ext
  have hD : (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero).1 =
      Matrix.diagonal
        (fun k => if k = i then (u : F) else if k = j then (u : F)⁻¹ else 1) :=
    diag2n_coe hij _ _
  have h_toGL : ((toGL (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) :
      Matrix ι ι F) = Matrix.diagonal
        (fun k => if k = i then (u : F) else if k = j then (u : F)⁻¹ else 1) := by
    calc _ = (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero).1 := rfl
      _ = _ := hD
  rw [h_toGL]
  simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_reindexMulEquiv,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_blockDiagonalOne, Matrix.reindex_apply]
  let p : ι → Prop := fun k => k = i ∨ k = j
  let C := {k : ι // ¬p k}
  let e : Fin 2 ⊕ C ≃ ι := pairComplEquiv hij
  let D : ι → F := fun k => if k = i then (u : F)
    else if k = j then (u : F)⁻¹ else 1
  let d₂ : Fin 2 → F := fun k => if k = 0 then (u : F) else (u : F)⁻¹
  let d : Fin 2 ⊕ C → F := Sum.elim d₂ (fun _ : C => 1)
  have h_diag2 : (↑(toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F) =
      Matrix.diagonal d₂ := by
    have h := diag2n_coe (ι := Fin 2) zero_ne_one (u : F) u.ne_zero
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [h, d₂]
  have hM : Matrix.fromBlocks
      (↑(toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) :
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F)
      (0 : Matrix (Fin 2) C F) (0 : Matrix C (Fin 2) F)
      (1 : Matrix C C F) = Matrix.diagonal d := by
    rw [h_diag2, ← Matrix.diagonal_one (n := C) (α := F),
      Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal]
  have h_reindex :
      (Matrix.fromBlocks
        (↑(toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) :
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) F)
        (0 : Matrix (Fin 2) C F) (0 : Matrix C (Fin 2) F)
        (1 : Matrix C C F)).submatrix ⇑e.symm ⇑e.symm =
      Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ ⇑e.symm) := by
    rw [hM, Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  rw [h_reindex]
  have h_eq : d ∘ ⇑e.symm = D := by
    funext k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · have he : e.symm k = Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2) := by
        rw [hki]; exact pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_i hij
      have hD : D k = (u : F) := by simp [D, hki]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, d, d₂, he, hD, Sum.elim_inl]
      simp
    · by_cases hkj : k = j
      · have he : e.symm k = Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2) := by
          rw [hkj]; exact pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_j hij
        have hD : D k = (u : F)⁻¹ := by simp [D, hkj, hij.symm]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, d, d₂, he, hD, Sum.elim_inl]
        simp
      · have hnp : ¬p k := by simp [p, hki, hkj]
        have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl
            (fun k : ι => k = i ∨ k = j)).symm k = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ :=
          Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hnp
        have he : e.symm k = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ := by
          calc e.symm k = (pairComplEquiv hij).symm k := rfl
            _ = Sum.inr ⟨k, hnp⟩ := by simp [pairComplEquiv, h1]
        have hD : D k = 1 := by simp [D, hki, hkj]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, d, he, hD, Sum.elim_inr]
  rw [h_eq]

private lemma toGL_transvection_eq_elementary {i j : Fin 2} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : F) :
    (toGL (transvection hij a) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe]

/-- The standard two-coordinate diagonal is the usual six elementary factors. -/
theorem toGL_diag2_eq_six_elementary (u : Fˣ) :
    (toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (u : F) *
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero (-((u : F)⁻¹)) *
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (u : F) *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (-1) *
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero 1 *
                Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (-1) := by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F =>
      (toGL A : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F))
    (diag2_decompose (u : F) u.ne_zero)
  simpa only [map_mul, toGL_transvection_eq_elementary] using h

/-- Arbitrary-index `diag2n` equals six elementary factors. -/
theorem toGL_diag2n_eq_six_elementary {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (u : Fˣ) :
    (toGL (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (u : F) *
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm (-((u : F)⁻¹)) *
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (u : F) *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (-1) *
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm 1 *
                Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (-1) := by
  let e := pairComplEquiv hij
  have hi : e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) = i := by
    have h : e.symm i = Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2) := pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_i hij
    calc e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) = e (e.symm i) := by rw [h]
      _ = i := by simp
  have hj : e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) = j := by
    have h : e.symm j = Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2) := pairComplEquiv_symm_apply_j hij
    calc e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) = e (e.symm j) := by rw [h]
      _ = j := by simp
  have h01 : ∀ a : F,
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
            {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one a)) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a := by
    intro a
    calc Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
              {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
              (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one a))
        = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
              (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) _ a) := by
          rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
            (e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2))) (e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2))) _ a := by
          rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_elementary]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a := by
          apply Units.ext; simp [hi, hj]
  have h10 : ∀ a : F,
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
            {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero a)) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm a := by
    intro a
    calc Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
              {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
              (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero a))
        = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
              (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2)) (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2)) _ a) := by
          rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne_elementary]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary
            (e (Sum.inl (1 : Fin 2))) (e (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 2))) _ a := by
          rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_elementary]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm a := by
          apply Units.ext; simp [hj, hi]
  calc (toGL (diag2n hij (u : F) u.ne_zero) : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι F)
      = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
            {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
            (toGL (diag2 (u : F) u.ne_zero) :
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)) :=
        toGL_diag2n_eq_reindex_blockDiagonalOne_diag2 hij u
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv e
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.blockDiagonalOne (Fin 2)
            {k : ι // ¬(k = i ∨ k = j)} F
            (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (u : F) *
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero (-((u : F)⁻¹)) *
                Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (u : F) *
                  Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (-1) *
                    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 1 0 one_ne_zero 1 *
                      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary 0 1 zero_ne_one (-1))) := by
        rw [toGL_diag2_eq_six_elementary]
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (u : F) *
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm (-((u : F)⁻¹)) *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (u : F) *
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (-1) *
                Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary j i hij.symm 1 *
                  Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij (-1) := by
        simp only [map_mul, h01, h10]

end Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup
