namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]

/-- Canonical order embedding `DeletedIndex ι c ↪o ι` via `Subtype.val`. -/
def deletedOrderEmbedding (c : ι) : DeletedIndex ι c ↪o ι where
  toEmbedding :=
    { toFun := Subtype.val
      inj' := Subtype.val_injective }
  map_rel_iff' := by
    intro a b
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem deletedOrderEmbedding_coe (c : ι) (x : DeletedIndex ι c) :
    (deletedOrderEmbedding c x : ι) = x.val :=
  rfl

section MemRange

variable {ι : Type*} [LinearOrder ι]

/-- Characterisation of the range of `deletedOrderEmbedding`. -/
theorem mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding {c : ι} {k : ι} :
    k ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c) ↔ k ≠ c := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hv
  · intro hk
    exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, rfl⟩

/-- The deleted point is not in the range of the embedding. -/
theorem not_mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding_self (c : ι) :
    c ∉ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c) := by
  rw [mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding]
  exact fun h => h rfl

/-- Membership in the range implies inequality with the deleted point. -/
theorem ne_of_mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding {c : ι} {k : ι}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c)) : k ≠ c :=
  mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding.mp hk

end MemRange

section InvRange

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι]

/-- The inverse of the range embedding recovers the underlying value. -/
theorem invOfRange_deletedOrderEmbedding_val {c : ι} {k : ι}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c)) :
    (invOfRange (deletedOrderEmbedding c) k hk).val = k :=
  invOfRange_spec (deletedOrderEmbedding c) k hk

/-- Explicit description of the range inverse as a subtype. -/
theorem invOfRange_deletedOrderEmbedding_eq {c : ι} {k : ι}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c)) :
    invOfRange (deletedOrderEmbedding c) k hk =
      ⟨k, ne_of_mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding hk⟩ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact invOfRange_deletedOrderEmbedding_val hk

end InvRange

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearEquiv

open Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-- Singleton subtype `{x // x = c}` equivalent to `Unit`. -/
def singletonEquivUnit {α : Type*} {c : α} :
    { x : α // x = c } ≃ Unit where
  toFun _ := ()
  invFun _ := ⟨c, rfl⟩
  left_inv := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := x
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hv.symm
  right_inv := by
    intro u
    cases u
    rfl

/-- Equivalence `α ≃ Unit ⊕ DeletedIndex α c` decomposing `α` at `c`. -/
noncomputable def nEquivUnitSumDel {α : Type*} (c : α) :
    α ≃ Unit ⊕ DeletedIndex α c := by
  classical
  haveI : DecidablePred (fun x : α => x = c) :=
    fun x => Classical.dec (x = c)
  exact Equiv.trans (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c)).symm
    (Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
      (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c)))

/-- `nEquivUnitSumDel` sends `c` to `inl ()`. -/
theorem nEquivUnitSumDel_apply_of_eq {α : Type*} {c : α} :
    nEquivUnitSumDel (α := α) c c = Sum.inl () := by
  classical
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c)).symm c =
      Sum.inl ⟨c, rfl⟩ :=
    Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos (p := fun x => x = c) rfl
  have h_eq : nEquivUnitSumDel c c =
      (Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
        (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c)))
        ((Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c)).symm c) := rfl
  rw [h_eq, h1]
  rfl

/-- `nEquivUnitSumDel` sends `j ≠ c` to `inr ⟨j, _⟩`. -/
theorem nEquivUnitSumDel_apply_of_ne {α : Type*} {c : α}
    {j : α} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    nEquivUnitSumDel c j = Sum.inr ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  classical
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c)).symm j =
      Sum.inr ⟨j, hj⟩ :=
    Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg (p := fun x => x = c) hj
  have h_eq : nEquivUnitSumDel c j =
      (Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
        (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c)))
        ((Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c)).symm j) := rfl
  rw [h_eq, h1]
  rfl

/-- Symmetric of `nEquivUnitSumDel` on `inl`. -/
theorem nEquivUnitSumDel_symm_apply_inl {α : Type*} {c : α} :
    (nEquivUnitSumDel (α := α) c).symm (Sum.inl ()) = c := by
  classical
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
      (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c))).symm (Sum.inl ()) =
      Sum.inl ⟨c, rfl⟩ := rfl
  have h_eq : (nEquivUnitSumDel c).symm (Sum.inl ()) =
      (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c))
        ((Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
          (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c))).symm (Sum.inl ())) := rfl
  rw [h_eq, h1]
  rfl

/-- Symmetric of `nEquivUnitSumDel` on `inr`. -/
theorem nEquivUnitSumDel_symm_apply_inr {α : Type*} {c : α}
    (d : DeletedIndex α c) :
    (nEquivUnitSumDel c).symm (Sum.inr d) = d.val := by
  classical
  have h1 : (Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
      (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c))).symm (Sum.inr d) =
      Sum.inr d := rfl
  have h_eq : (nEquivUnitSumDel c).symm (Sum.inr d) =
      (Equiv.sumCompl (fun x => x = c))
        ((Equiv.sumCongr (singletonEquivUnit (c := c))
          (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex α c))).symm (Sum.inr d)) := rfl
  rw [h_eq, h1]
  rfl

section InsertEquiv

variable {m n : Type*}

/-- Heterogeneous equivalence insertion: map `c` to `r` and otherwise use `σ`. -/
noncomputable def insertEquiv (r : m) (c : n)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) : n ≃ m :=
  Equiv.trans (nEquivUnitSumDel c)
    (Equiv.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ)
      (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm)

@[simp]
theorem insertEquiv_apply_c (r : m) (c : n)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    insertEquiv r c σ c = r := by
  classical
  have h_n : nEquivUnitSumDel c c = Sum.inl () :=
    nEquivUnitSumDel_apply_of_eq
  have h_sum : (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (Sum.inl ()) =
      Sum.inl () := rfl
  have h_m : (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm (Sum.inl ()) = r :=
    nEquivUnitSumDel_symm_apply_inl
  calc insertEquiv r c σ c
      = (Equiv.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ)
            (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm) (nEquivUnitSumDel c c) := rfl
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm
          ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (nEquivUnitSumDel c c)) := rfl
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm
          ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (Sum.inl ())) := by rw [h_n]
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm (Sum.inl ()) := by rw [h_sum]
    _ = r := h_m

/-- Insertion acts via `σ` away from `c`. -/
theorem insertEquiv_apply_of_ne {r : m} {c : n}
    {σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r} {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    insertEquiv r c σ j = (σ ⟨j, hj⟩).val := by
  classical
  have h_n : nEquivUnitSumDel c j = Sum.inr ⟨j, hj⟩ :=
    nEquivUnitSumDel_apply_of_ne hj
  have h_sum : (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (Sum.inr ⟨j, hj⟩) =
      Sum.inr (σ ⟨j, hj⟩) := rfl
  have h_m : (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm (Sum.inr (σ ⟨j, hj⟩)) =
      (σ ⟨j, hj⟩).val := nEquivUnitSumDel_symm_apply_inr _
  calc insertEquiv r c σ j
      = (Equiv.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ)
            (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm) (nEquivUnitSumDel c j) := rfl
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm
          ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (nEquivUnitSumDel c j)) := rfl
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm
          ((Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl Unit) σ) (Sum.inr ⟨j, hj⟩)) := by rw [h_n]
    _ = (nEquivUnitSumDel r).symm (Sum.inr (σ ⟨j, hj⟩)) := by rw [h_sum]
    _ = (σ ⟨j, hj⟩).val := h_m

/-- Symmetry of heterogeneous insertion. -/
theorem insertEquiv_symm_eq (r : m) (c : n)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (insertEquiv r c σ).symm = insertEquiv c r σ.symm :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem insertEquiv_symm_apply_r (r : m) (c : n)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (insertEquiv r c σ).symm r = c := by
  rw [insertEquiv_symm_eq]
  exact insertEquiv_apply_c c r σ.symm

/-- Symmetric insertion away from `r`. -/
theorem insertEquiv_symm_apply_of_ne {r : m} {c : n}
    {σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r} {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    (insertEquiv r c σ).symm i = (σ.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
  rw [insertEquiv_symm_eq]
  exact insertEquiv_apply_of_ne hi

end InsertEquiv

section InsertWeights

variable {m : Type*} {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

/-- Heterogeneous weight insertion: assign `a` at `r` and `u` elsewhere. -/
noncomputable def insertWeights (r : m) (a : Rˣ)
    (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ) : m → Rˣ :=
  fun i => by
    classical
    haveI : Decidable (i = r) := Classical.dec _
    exact if hi : i = r then a else u ⟨i, hi⟩

@[simp]
theorem insertWeights_apply_self (r : m) (a : Rˣ)
    (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ) :
    insertWeights r a u r = a := by
  classical
  simp [insertWeights]

/-- Insertion acts via `u` away from `r`. -/
theorem insertWeights_apply_of_ne {r : m} {a : Rˣ}
    {u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ} {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    insertWeights r a u i = u ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
  classical
  simp [insertWeights, hi]

/-- Functoriality of `insertWeights` under `Units.map`. -/
theorem insertWeights_map {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
    (f : R →+* S) {m : Type*} (r : m) (a : Rˣ)
    (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ) (i : m) :
    Units.map f.toMonoidHom (insertWeights r a u i) =
      insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) i := by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · rw [hi, insertWeights_apply_self, insertWeights_apply_self]
  · rw [insertWeights_apply_of_ne hi, insertWeights_apply_of_ne hi]

/-- Functoriality of `insertWeights` as a function. -/
theorem insertWeights_map_eq {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
    (f : R →+* S) {m : Type*} (r : m) (a : Rˣ)
    (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ) :
    (fun i => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (insertWeights r a u i)) =
      insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) := by
  funext i
  exact insertWeights_map f r a u i

end InsertWeights

section MonomialInsertion

variable {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

/-- Inserting a pivot into a heterogeneous monomial equivalence yields a
monomial equivalence with inserted weights and permutation. -/
theorem insertEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ) =
      monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u) (insertEquiv r c σ) := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · have hi_eq : i = r := hi
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hj_eq : j = c := hj
      have h_left : (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv u σ)).val i j =
          (a : R) := by
        rw [hi_eq, hj_eq]
        exact insertEntryEquiv_val_self r c a _
      have h_right : (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
          (insertEquiv r c σ)).val i j = (a : R) := by
        rw [hi_eq, hj_eq, val_monomialEquiv_apply, insertEquiv_apply_c,
          insertWeights_apply_self, ite_eq_left rfl]
      rw [h_left, h_right]
    · have hj_ne : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_row : (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv u σ)).val i j = 0 := by
        rw [hi_eq]
        exact insertEntryEquiv_val_row_ne r c a (monomialEquiv u σ) hj_ne
      have h_val_ne : (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).val ≠ r :=
        (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).property
      have h_val_ne_i : (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).val ≠ i := by
        rw [hi_eq]
        exact h_val_ne
      have h_right : (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
          (insertEquiv r c σ)).val i j = 0 := by
        calc (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
            (insertEquiv r c σ)).val i j
            = (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
                (insertEquiv r c σ)).val r j := by rw [hi_eq]
          _ = if insertEquiv r c σ j = r then
                (insertWeights r a u r : R) else 0 := by
              simp only [val_monomialEquiv_apply]
          _ = if (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).val = r then
                (insertWeights r a u r : R) else 0 := by
              rw [insertEquiv_apply_of_ne hj_ne]
          _ = 0 := by rw [ite_eq_right h_val_ne]
      rw [h_row, h_right]
  · have hi_ne : i ≠ r := hi
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hj_eq : j = c := hj
      have h_eq : insertEquiv r c σ c = r := insertEquiv_apply_c _ _ _
      have h_ne : r ≠ i := Ne.symm hi_ne
      have h_col : (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv u σ)).val i j = 0 := by
        rw [hj_eq]
        exact insertEntryEquiv_val_col_ne r c a (monomialEquiv u σ) hi_ne
      have h_right : (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
          (insertEquiv r c σ)).val i j = 0 := by
        rw [hj_eq, val_monomialEquiv_apply, h_eq, ite_eq_right h_ne]
      rw [h_col, h_right]
    · have hj_ne : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_left : (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv u σ)).val i j =
          (monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ).val ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ :=
        insertEntryEquiv_val_ne_ne r c a _ hi_ne hj_ne
      rw [h_left]
      simp only [val_monomialEquiv_apply, insertWeights_apply_of_ne hi_ne,
        insertEquiv_apply_of_ne hj_ne]
      by_cases hσ : σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ = ⟨i, hi_ne⟩
      · have h_val : (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).val = i := congrArg Subtype.val hσ
        rw [ite_eq_left h_val, ite_eq_left hσ]
      · have h_val : (σ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩).val ≠ i := by
          intro heq
          apply hσ
          exact Subtype.ext heq
        rw [ite_eq_right h_val, ite_eq_right hσ]

end MonomialInsertion

section Composition

variable {m n p : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p]
  [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

/-- Heterogeneous block composition law for insertion. -/
theorem insertEntryEquiv_trans (r : m) (s : p) (c : n) (a b : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex p s) R)
    (E : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex p s) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r s a D).trans (insertEntryEquiv s c b E) =
      insertEntryEquiv r c (a * b) (D.trans E) := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  simp only [val_trans, Matrix.mul_apply, val_insertEntryEquiv]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · have hi_eq : i = r := hi
    have hA_zero : ∀ k : p, k ≠ s →
        insertEntryVal r s a D i k = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hi_eq]
      simp [insertEntryVal, hk]
    have h_sum : ∀ j : n,
        (∑ k : p, insertEntryVal r s a D i k *
          insertEntryVal s c b E k j) =
        insertEntryVal r s a D i s *
          insertEntryVal s c b E s j := by
      intro j
      apply Fintype.sum_eq_single s
      intro k hk
      rw [hA_zero k hk, zero_mul]
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hj_eq : j = c := hj
      have h_sum_j := h_sum c
      rw [hj_eq, h_sum_j]
      simp [insertEntryVal, Units.val_mul, hi_eq]
    · have hj_ne : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_sum_j := h_sum j
      rw [h_sum_j]
      simp [insertEntryVal, hj_ne, hi_eq]
  · have hi_ne : i ≠ r := hi
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hj_eq : j = c := hj
      let f : p → R := fun k =>
        insertEntryVal r s a D i k * insertEntryVal s c b E k c
      have hf_s : f s = 0 := by
        simp [f, insertEntryVal, hi_ne]
      have h_sum_eq : (∑ k : p, f k) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := s)
        rw [hf_s, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have h_f_eq : ∀ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val =
          D.val ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ d * insertEntryVal s c b E d.val c := by
        intro d
        simp [f, insertEntryVal, hi_ne, d.property]
      have hB_zero : ∀ d : DeletedIndex p s,
          insertEntryVal s c b E d.val c = 0 := by
        intro d
        simp [insertEntryVal, d.property]
      have h_sum_zero : (∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro d _
        rw [h_f_eq d, hB_zero d, mul_zero]
      have h_left : (∑ k : p, insertEntryVal r s a D i k *
          insertEntryVal s c b E k c) = ∑ k : p, f k := rfl
      calc (∑ k : p, insertEntryVal r s a D i k *
            insertEntryVal s c b E k j)
          = (∑ k : p, insertEntryVal r s a D i k *
            insertEntryVal s c b E k c) := by rw [hj_eq]
        _ = ∑ k : p, f k := h_left
        _ = ∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val := h_sum_eq
        _ = 0 := h_sum_zero
        _ = insertEntryVal r c (a * b) (D.trans E) i j := by
            rw [hj_eq]
            simp [insertEntryVal, hi_ne]
    · have hj_ne : j ≠ c := hj
      let f : p → R := fun k =>
        insertEntryVal r s a D i k * insertEntryVal s c b E k j
      have hf_s : f s = 0 := by
        simp [f, insertEntryVal, hi_ne]
      have h_sum_eq : (∑ k : p, f k) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := s)
        rw [hf_s, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have h_f_eq : ∀ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val =
          D.val ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ d * insertEntryVal s c b E d.val j := by
        intro d
        simp [f, insertEntryVal, hi_ne, d.property]
      have hB_eq : ∀ d : DeletedIndex p s,
          insertEntryVal s c b E d.val j = E.val d ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ := by
        intro d
        simp [insertEntryVal, d.property, hj_ne]
      have h_sum_sub : (∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val) =
          (D.val * E.val) ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [h_f_eq d, hB_eq d]
      calc (∑ k : p, insertEntryVal r s a D i k *
            insertEntryVal s c b E k j)
          = ∑ k : p, f k := rfl
        _ = ∑ d : DeletedIndex p s, f d.val := h_sum_eq
        _ = (D.val * E.val) ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ := h_sum_sub
        _ = (D.trans E).val ⟨i, hi_ne⟩ ⟨j, hj_ne⟩ := rfl
        _ = insertEntryVal r c (a * b) (D.trans E) i j := by
            simp [insertEntryVal, hi_ne, hj_ne]

/-- Left unit: inserting `refl` with `1` on the right is neutral. -/
@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_trans_refl_right (r : m) (s : p) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex p s) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r s a D).trans (insertEntryEquiv s s 1 refl) =
      insertEntryEquiv r s a D := by
  have h := insertEntryEquiv_trans r s s a 1 D refl
  simp only [trans_refl, mul_one] at h
  exact h

/-- Right unit: inserting `refl` with `1` on the left is neutral. -/
@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_trans_refl_left (s : p) (c : n) (b : Rˣ)
    (E : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex p s) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv s s 1 refl).trans (insertEntryEquiv s c b E) =
      insertEntryEquiv s c b E := by
  have h := insertEntryEquiv_trans s s c 1 b refl E
  simp only [refl_trans, one_mul] at h
  exact h

end Composition

section SquareBridge

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

private lemma extendMatrix_deletedOrderEmbedding_apply
    (c : ι) (M : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
    (i j : ι) :
    extendMatrix (deletedOrderEmbedding c) M i j =
      if hi : i = c then if j = c then 1 else 0
      else if hj : j = c then 0
      else M ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  have h_range_iff : ∀ k : ι,
      k ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding (ι := ι) c) ↔ k ≠ c :=
    fun k => mem_range_deletedOrderEmbedding
  by_cases h_i : i = c
  · have hi_mem : i ∉ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding c) := by
      intro h_mem
      have h_ne : i ≠ c := (h_range_iff i).mp h_mem
      exact h_ne h_i
    rw [extendMatrix_apply, dite_eq_right hi_mem]
    by_cases h_j : j = c
    · have hij : i = j := by rw [h_i, h_j]
      rw [ite_eq_left hij]
      rw [dite_eq_left h_i]
      rw [ite_eq_left h_j]
    · have hij : i ≠ j := by
        intro h_eq
        apply h_j
        rw [← h_i, h_eq]
      rw [ite_eq_right hij]
      rw [dite_eq_left h_i]
      rw [ite_eq_right h_j]
  · have hi_mem : i ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding c) := by
      rw [h_range_iff]
      exact h_i
    rw [extendMatrix_apply, dite_eq_left hi_mem]
    by_cases h_j : j = c
    · have hj_mem : j ∉ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding c) := by
        intro h_mem
        have h_ne : j ≠ c := (h_range_iff j).mp h_mem
        exact h_ne h_j
      rw [dite_eq_right hj_mem]
      rw [dite_eq_right h_i]
      rw [dite_eq_left h_j]
    · have hj_mem : j ∈ Set.range (deletedOrderEmbedding c) := by
        rw [h_range_iff]
        exact h_j
      rw [dite_eq_left hj_mem]
      rw [dite_eq_right h_i]
      rw [dite_eq_right h_j]
      have h_eq_i := invOfRange_deletedOrderEmbedding_eq hi_mem
      have h_eq_j := invOfRange_deletedOrderEmbedding_eq hj_mem
      rw [h_eq_i, h_eq_j]

/-- Square bridge: insertion of `1` and `g` equals `extendByIdentity` via
`deletedOrderEmbedding`. -/
theorem toGL_insertEntryEquiv_one_ofGL_eq_extendByIdentity (c : ι)
    (g : GL (DeletedIndex ι c) R) :
    toGL (insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c 1 (ofGL g)) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (deletedOrderEmbedding c) g := by
  have h_toGL : toGL (insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c 1 (ofGL g)) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.insertCoordinateUnit c 1 g := by
    calc toGL (insertEntryEquiv c c 1 (ofGL g))
        = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.insertCoordinateUnit c 1 (toGL (ofGL g)) :=
          toGL_insertEntryEquiv c 1 (ofGL g)
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.insertCoordinateUnit c 1 g := by
          rw [toGL_ofGL]
  rw [h_toGL]
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_extendByIdentity,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_insertCoordinateUnit]
  rw [extendMatrix_deletedOrderEmbedding_apply]
  rfl

/-- Insertion preserves upper-elementary membership. -/
theorem toGL_insertEntryEquiv_one_ofGL_mem_upperElementary (c : ι)
    (g : GL (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
    (hg : g ∈ Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.upperElementarySubgroup
      (DeletedIndex ι c) R) :
    toGL (insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c 1 (ofGL g)) ∈
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.upperElementarySubgroup ι R := by
  rw [toGL_insertEntryEquiv_one_ofGL_eq_extendByIdentity]
  exact Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity_mem_upperElementarySubgroup
    (deletedOrderEmbedding c) hg

/-- Bundled upper-elementary version of the square bridge. -/
theorem upperElementary_extendByIdentity_eq (c : ι)
    (g : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.upperElementarySubgroup
      (DeletedIndex ι c) R) :
    (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary.extendByIdentity
      (deletedOrderEmbedding c) g).val =
      toGL (insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c 1 (ofGL g.val)) := by
  simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary.coe_extendByIdentity,
    toGL_insertEntryEquiv_one_ofGL_eq_extendByIdentity]

end SquareBridge

section CoeffNaturality

variable {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
variable {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]

/-- Coefficient naturality for `insertEntryEquiv` composed with monomial. -/
theorem map_insertEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv (f : R →+* S)
    (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ) (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ)).map f =
      insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        (monomialEquiv (R := S) (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) σ) := by
  have h1 : (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ)).map f =
      insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        ((monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ).map f) := by
    rw [map_insertEntryEquiv]
    rfl
  have h2 : (monomialEquiv (R := R) u σ).map f =
      monomialEquiv (R := S) (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) σ := by
    rw [map_monomialEquiv]
    rfl
  calc (insertEntryEquiv r c a (monomialEquiv u σ)).map f
      = insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
          ((monomialEquiv u σ).map f) := h1
    _ = insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
          (monomialEquiv (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) σ) := by
        rw [h2]

/-- Coefficient naturality for monomial with inserted weights. -/
theorem map_monomialEquiv_insertWeights (f : R →+* S)
    (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ) (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u) (insertEquiv r c σ)).map f =
      monomialEquiv (R := S)
        (insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
          (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)))
        (insertEquiv r c σ) := by
  have h_map : (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
      (insertEquiv r c σ)).map f =
      monomialEquiv (R := S)
        (fun i => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (insertWeights r a u i))
        (insertEquiv r c σ) := by
    rw [map_monomialEquiv]
    rfl
  have h_eq : (fun i => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (insertWeights r a u i)) =
      insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) := by
    funext i
    exact insertWeights_map f r a u i
  calc (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
          (insertEquiv r c σ)).map f
      = monomialEquiv (R := S)
          (fun i => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (insertWeights r a u i))
          (insertEquiv r c σ) := h_map
    _ = monomialEquiv (R := S)
          (insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
            (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)))
          (insertEquiv r c σ) := by
        rw [h_eq]

/-- Naturality bridge between insertion and monomial forms. -/
theorem insertEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_map (f : R →+* S)
    (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ) (u : DeletedIndex m r → Rˣ)
    (σ : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u) (insertEquiv r c σ)).map f =
      insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
        (monomialEquiv (R := S) (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) σ) := by
  calc (monomialEquiv (R := R) (insertWeights r a u)
          (insertEquiv r c σ)).map f
      = monomialEquiv (R := S)
          (insertWeights r (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
            (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)))
          (insertEquiv r c σ) := by
        rw [map_monomialEquiv_insertWeights]
    _ = insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a)
          (monomialEquiv (R := S) (fun d => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (u d)) σ) := by
        rw [← insertEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv]

end CoeffNaturality

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.GeneralLinearEquiv
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.IsolatedCoordinate
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.IsolatedCoordinateInsertion
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearEquiv

open Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {m n p : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype p]
  [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
variable {R S : Type*} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]

/-! ### Predicate `IsolatedEntry` -/

structure IsolatedEntry (e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R) (r : m) (c : n) : Prop where
  row_zero : ∀ j : n, j ≠ c → e.val r j = 0
  col_zero : ∀ i : m, i ≠ r → e.val i c = 0

namespace IsolatedEntry

variable {e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R} {r : m} {c : n}

theorem row_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    e.val r j = 0 :=
  h.row_zero j hj

theorem col_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    e.val i c = 0 :=
  h.col_zero i hi

theorem mk_of_if
    (hrow : ∀ j : n, e.val r j = if j = c then e.val r c else 0)
    (hcol : ∀ i : m, e.val i c = if i = r then e.val r c else 0) :
    IsolatedEntry e r c where
  row_zero j hj := by rw [hrow j, ite_eq_right hj]
  col_zero i hi := by rw [hcol i, ite_eq_right hi]

theorem map (f : R →+* S) (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    IsolatedEntry (e.map f) r c where
  row_zero j hj := by
    have : (e.map f).val r j = f (e.val r j) := by
      simp [val_map, Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [this, h.row_zero j hj, f.map_zero]
  col_zero i hi := by
    have : (e.map f).val i c = f (e.val i c) := by
      simp [val_map, Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [this, h.col_zero i hi, f.map_zero]

end IsolatedEntry

/-! ### Helpers -/

private lemma sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ι → R) (c : ι) (hf : f c = 0) :
    (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c, f k.1) = ∑ k : ι, f k := by
  have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
  rw [hf, zero_add] at h
  exact h.symm

private lemma one_submatrix_left
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
    (c : ι) (i j : ι) (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (1 : Matrix ι ι R) i j =
      (1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
        (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) := by
  simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · simp [hij]
  · have hij' : (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) ≠ (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) := by
      intro h
      apply hij
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp [hij, hij']

/-! ### Pivot unit -/

section PivotUnit

variable {e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R} {r : m} {c : n}

private lemma iso_sum_val_inv_row_aux (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) (k : m) :
    e.val r c * e.inv c k = (1 : Matrix m m R) r k := by
  classical
  have hmul : (e.val * e.inv) r k = (1 : Matrix m m R) r k := by rw [e.val_inv]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply] at hmul
  have hz : ∀ j : n, j ≠ c → e.val r j * e.inv j k = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [h.row_zero j hj, zero_mul]
  have hsum : ∑ j : n, e.val r j * e.inv j k = e.val r c * e.inv c k :=
    Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => hz b hb)
  rw [hsum] at hmul
  exact hmul

private lemma iso_sum_inv_val_col_aux (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) (k : n) :
    e.inv k r * e.val r c = (1 : Matrix n n R) k c := by
  classical
  have hmul : (e.inv * e.val) k c = (1 : Matrix n n R) k c := by rw [e.inv_val]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply] at hmul
  have hz : ∀ i : m, i ≠ r → e.inv k i * e.val i c = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [h.col_zero i hi, mul_zero]
  have hsum : ∑ i : m, e.inv k i * e.val i c = e.inv k r * e.val r c :=
    Fintype.sum_eq_single r (fun b hb => hz b hb)
  rw [hsum] at hmul
  exact hmul

def isolatedPivotUnit (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) : Rˣ where
  val := e.val r c
  inv := e.inv c r
  val_inv := by
    have h1 := iso_sum_val_inv_row_aux h (k := r)
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_left rfl] at h1
    exact h1
  inv_val := by
    have h1 := iso_sum_inv_val_col_aux h (k := c)
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_left rfl] at h1
    exact h1

@[simp]
theorem coe_isolatedPivotUnit (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    (isolatedPivotUnit h : R) = e.val r c := rfl

theorem coe_inv_isolatedPivotUnit (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    ((isolatedPivotUnit h)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val = e.inv c r := rfl

theorem isolatedPivotUnit_val_inv (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    e.val r c * e.inv c r = 1 :=
  (isolatedPivotUnit h).val_inv

theorem isolatedPivotUnit_inv_val (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    e.inv c r * e.val r c = 1 :=
  (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv_val

theorem inv_row_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    e.inv c i = 0 := by
  have h1 : e.val r c * e.inv c i = 0 := by
    have := iso_sum_val_inv_row_aux h (k := i)
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hi)] at this
    exact this
  have hunit : (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv * (e.val r c * e.inv c i) = e.inv c i := by
    calc (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv * (e.val r c * e.inv c i)
        = ((isolatedPivotUnit h).inv * e.val r c) * e.inv c i := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = ((isolatedPivotUnit h).inv * (isolatedPivotUnit h).val) * e.inv c i := by rfl
      _ = 1 * e.inv c i := by rw [(isolatedPivotUnit h).inv_val]
      _ = e.inv c i := by rw [one_mul]
  rw [h1, mul_zero] at hunit
  exact hunit.symm

theorem inv_col_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    e.inv j r = 0 := by
  have h1 : e.inv j r * e.val r c = 0 := by
    have := iso_sum_inv_val_col_aux h (k := j)
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hj] at this
    exact this
  have hunit : (e.inv j r * e.val r c) * (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv = e.inv j r := by
    calc (e.inv j r * e.val r c) * (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv
        = e.inv j r * (e.val r c * (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = e.inv j r * ((isolatedPivotUnit h).val * (isolatedPivotUnit h).inv) := by rfl
      _ = e.inv j r * 1 := by rw [(isolatedPivotUnit h).val_inv]
      _ = e.inv j r := by rw [mul_one]
  rw [h1, zero_mul] at hunit
  exact hunit.symm

theorem isIsolated_symm (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) : IsolatedEntry e.symm c r where
  row_zero j hj := by
    simp only [val_symm]
    exact inv_row_zero_of_ne h hj
  col_zero i hi := by
    simp only [val_symm]
    exact inv_col_zero_of_ne h hi

end PivotUnit

theorem IsolatedEntry.symm {e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R} {r : m} {c : n}
    (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) : IsolatedEntry e.symm c r :=
  isIsolated_symm h

/-! ### Reindexing -/

section Reindexing

variable {m' n' : Type*} [Fintype m'] [Fintype n'] [DecidableEq m'] [DecidableEq n']
variable {e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R} {r : m} {c : n}

theorem IsolatedEntry.reindex (em : m' ≃ m) (en : n' ≃ n)
    (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    IsolatedEntry (e.reindex em en) (em.symm r) (en.symm c) where
  row_zero j hj := by
    simp only [val_reindex, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hj' : en j ≠ c := by
      intro heq
      apply hj
      calc j = en.symm (en j) := by simp
        _ = en.symm c := by rw [heq]
    exact h.row_zero (en j) hj'
  col_zero i hi := by
    simp only [val_reindex, Matrix.submatrix_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hi' : em i ≠ r := by
      intro heq
      apply hi
      calc i = em.symm (em i) := by simp
        _ = em.symm r := by rw [heq]
    exact h.col_zero (em i) hi'

theorem IsolatedEntry.reindex_of_eq {r' : m'} {c' : n'} {em : m' ≃ m} {en : n' ≃ n}
    (hr : em r' = r) (hc : en c' = c) (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    IsolatedEntry (e.reindex em en) r' c' where
  row_zero j hj := by
    simp only [val_reindex, Matrix.submatrix_apply, hr]
    have hj' : en j ≠ c := by
      intro heq
      apply hj
      have : en j = en c' := by rw [heq, hc]
      exact en.injective this
    exact h.row_zero (en j) hj'
  col_zero i hi := by
    simp only [val_reindex, Matrix.submatrix_apply, hc]
    have hi' : em i ≠ r := by
      intro heq
      apply hi
      have : em i = em r' := by rw [heq, hr]
      exact em.injective this
    exact h.col_zero (em i) hi'

end Reindexing

/-! ### Block insertion -/

section Insertion

variable {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R]

def insertEntryVal (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    Matrix m n R :=
  fun i j =>
    if hi : i = r then
      if j = c then (a : R) else 0
    else
      if hj : j = c then 0
      else D.val (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c)

def insertEntryInvVal (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    Matrix n m R :=
  fun j i =>
    if hj : j = c then
      if i = r then ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) else 0
    else
      if hi : i = r then 0
      else D.inv (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r)

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryVal_self (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    insertEntryVal r c a D r c = (a : R) := by simp [insertEntryVal]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryVal_row_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    insertEntryVal r c a D r j = 0 := by simp [insertEntryVal, hj]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryVal_col_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    insertEntryVal r c a D i c = 0 := by simp [insertEntryVal, hi]

theorem insertEntryVal_ne_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} {j : n} (hi : i ≠ r) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    insertEntryVal r c a D i j =
      D.val (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) := by
  simp [insertEntryVal, hi, hj]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryInvVal_self (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    insertEntryInvVal r c a D c r = ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by simp [insertEntryInvVal]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryInvVal_row_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    insertEntryInvVal r c a D c i = 0 := by simp [insertEntryInvVal, hi]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryInvVal_col_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    insertEntryInvVal r c a D j r = 0 := by simp [insertEntryInvVal, hj]

theorem insertEntryInvVal_ne_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} {i : m} (hj : j ≠ c) (hi : i ≠ r) :
    insertEntryInvVal r c a D j i =
      D.inv (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) := by
  simp [insertEntryInvVal, hj, hi]

lemma insertEntryVal_mul_insertEntryInvVal (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    insertEntryVal r c a D * insertEntryInvVal r c a D = 1 := by
  classical
  ext i k
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · rw [hi]
    have hz : ∀ j : n, j ≠ c → insertEntryVal r c a D r j * insertEntryInvVal r c a D j k = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      rw [insertEntryVal_row_ne r c a D hj, zero_mul]
    have hsum : ∑ j : n, insertEntryVal r c a D r j * insertEntryInvVal r c a D j k =
        insertEntryVal r c a D r c * insertEntryInvVal r c a D c k :=
      Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => hz b hb)
    rw [hsum, insertEntryVal_self]
    by_cases hk : k = r
    · rw [hk, insertEntryInvVal_self]
      have : (a : R) * ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) = 1 := by
        calc (a : R) * ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) = ((a * a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := rfl
          _ = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
          _ = 1 := rfl
      rw [this, Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_left rfl]
    · have hk' : k ≠ r := hk
      rw [insertEntryInvVal_row_ne r c a D hk', mul_zero]
      rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hk')]
  · have hi' : i ≠ r := hi
    by_cases hk : k = r
    · rw [hk]
      have hz : ∀ j : n, insertEntryVal r c a D i j * insertEntryInvVal r c a D j r = 0 := by
        intro j
        by_cases hj : j = c
        · rw [hj, insertEntryVal_col_ne r c a D hi', zero_mul]
        · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
          rw [insertEntryVal_ne_ne r c a D hi' hj', insertEntryInvVal_col_ne r c a D hj', mul_zero]
      have hsum : ∑ j : n, insertEntryVal r c a D i j * insertEntryInvVal r c a D j r = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun j => hz j)
      rw [hsum, Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hi']
    · have hk' : k ≠ r := hk
      let f : n → R := fun j => insertEntryVal r c a D i j * insertEntryInvVal r c a D j k
      have hf_c : f c = 0 := by dsimp [f]; rw [insertEntryVal_col_ne r c a D hi', zero_mul]
      have hsum_eq : (∑ j : n, f j) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex n c, f d.1 := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
        rw [hf_c, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have hf_eq : ∀ d : DeletedIndex n c,
          f d.1 = D.val (⟨i, hi'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) d *
            D.inv d (⟨k, hk'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) := by
        intro d
        dsimp [f]
        have hd : d.1 ≠ c := d.property
        rw [insertEntryVal_ne_ne r c a D hi' hd, insertEntryInvVal_ne_ne r c a D hd hk']
      have hsum_sub : (∑ d : DeletedIndex n c, f d.1) =
          (D.val * D.inv) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨k, hk'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [hf_eq d]
      calc (∑ j : n, f j) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex n c, f d.1 := hsum_eq
        _ = (D.val * D.inv) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨k, hk'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) := hsum_sub
        _ = (1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex m r) R)
            (⟨i, hi'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨k, hk'⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) := by rw [D.val_inv]
        _ = (1 : Matrix m m R) i k := (one_submatrix_left (R := R) r i k hi' hk').symm

lemma insertEntryInvVal_mul_insertEntryVal (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    insertEntryInvVal r c a D * insertEntryVal r c a D = 1 := by
  classical
  ext j l
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hj : j = c
  · rw [hj]
    have hz : ∀ i : m, i ≠ r → insertEntryInvVal r c a D c i * insertEntryVal r c a D i l = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      rw [insertEntryInvVal_row_ne r c a D hi, zero_mul]
    have hsum : ∑ i : m, insertEntryInvVal r c a D c i * insertEntryVal r c a D i l =
        insertEntryInvVal r c a D c r * insertEntryVal r c a D r l :=
      Fintype.sum_eq_single r (fun b hb => hz b hb)
    rw [hsum, insertEntryInvVal_self]
    by_cases hl : l = c
    · rw [hl, insertEntryVal_self]
      have : ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (a : R) = 1 := by
        calc ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (a : R) = ((a⁻¹ * a : Rˣ) : R) := rfl
          _ = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
          _ = 1 := rfl
      rw [this, Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_left rfl]
    · have hl' : l ≠ c := hl
      rw [insertEntryVal_row_ne r c a D hl', mul_zero, Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hl')]
  · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
    by_cases hl : l = c
    · rw [hl]
      have hz : ∀ i : m, insertEntryInvVal r c a D j i * insertEntryVal r c a D i c = 0 := by
        intro i
        by_cases hi : i = r
        · rw [hi, insertEntryInvVal_col_ne r c a D hj', zero_mul]
        · have hi' : i ≠ r := hi
          rw [insertEntryVal_col_ne r c a D hi', mul_zero]
      have hsum : ∑ i : m, insertEntryInvVal r c a D j i * insertEntryVal r c a D i c = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun i => hz i)
      rw [hsum, Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hj']
    · have hl' : l ≠ c := hl
      let f : m → R := fun i => insertEntryInvVal r c a D j i * insertEntryVal r c a D i l
      have hf_r : f r = 0 := by dsimp [f]; rw [insertEntryInvVal_col_ne r c a D hj', zero_mul]
      have hsum_eq : (∑ i : m, f i) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex m r, f d.1 := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := r)
        rw [hf_r, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have hf_eq : ∀ d : DeletedIndex m r,
          f d.1 = D.inv (⟨j, hj'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) d *
            D.val d (⟨l, hl'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) := by
        intro d
        dsimp [f]
        have hd : d.1 ≠ r := d.property
        rw [insertEntryInvVal_ne_ne r c a D hj' hd, insertEntryVal_ne_ne r c a D hd hl']
      have hsum_sub : (∑ d : DeletedIndex m r, f d.1) =
          (D.inv * D.val) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨l, hl'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [hf_eq d]
      calc (∑ i : m, f i) = ∑ d : DeletedIndex m r, f d.1 := hsum_eq
        _ = (D.inv * D.val) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨l, hl'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) := hsum_sub
        _ = (1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex n c) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
            (⟨j, hj'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨l, hl'⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) := by rw [D.inv_val]
        _ = (1 : Matrix n n R) j l := (one_submatrix_left (R := R) c j l hj' hl').symm

def insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    GeneralLinearEquiv m n R where
  val := insertEntryVal r c a D
  inv := insertEntryInvVal r c a D
  val_inv := insertEntryVal_mul_insertEntryInvVal r c a D
  inv_val := insertEntryInvVal_mul_insertEntryVal r c a D

@[simp]
theorem val_insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).val = insertEntryVal r c a D := rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).inv = insertEntryInvVal r c a D := rfl

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_val_self (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).val r c = (a : R) := by
  simp [val_insertEntryEquiv, insertEntryVal]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_val_row_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).val r j = 0 :=
  insertEntryVal_row_ne r c a D hj

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_val_col_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).val i c = 0 :=
  insertEntryVal_col_ne r c a D hi

theorem insertEntryEquiv_val_ne_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} {j : n} (hi : i ≠ r) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).val i j =
      D.val (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) :=
  insertEntryVal_ne_ne r c a D hi hj

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_inv_self (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).inv c r = ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by
  simp [inv_insertEntryEquiv, insertEntryInvVal]

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_inv_row_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {i : m} (hi : i ≠ r) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).inv c i = 0 :=
  insertEntryInvVal_row_ne r c a D hi

@[simp]
theorem insertEntryEquiv_inv_col_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).inv j r = 0 :=
  insertEntryInvVal_col_ne r c a D hj

theorem insertEntryEquiv_inv_ne_ne (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    {j : n} {i : m} (hj : j ≠ c) (hi : i ≠ r) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).inv j i =
      D.inv (⟨j, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) (⟨i, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) :=
  insertEntryInvVal_ne_ne r c a D hj hi

theorem isIsolated_insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    IsolatedEntry (insertEntryEquiv r c a D) r c where
  row_zero _ hj := insertEntryEquiv_val_row_ne r c a D hj
  col_zero _ hi := insertEntryEquiv_val_col_ne r c a D hi

theorem symm_insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).symm = insertEntryEquiv c r a⁻¹ D.symm := by
  apply ext
  ext j i
  by_cases hj : j = c
  · by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst hj; subst hi
      simp
    · subst hj
      simp [hi]
  · by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst hi
      simp [hj]
    · simp only [val_symm, inv_insertEntryEquiv, val_insertEntryEquiv,
        insertEntryVal, insertEntryInvVal, hj, hi]

theorem map_insertEntryEquiv (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R)
    (f : R →+* S) :
    (insertEntryEquiv r c a D).map f =
      insertEntryEquiv r c (Units.map f a) (D.map f) := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  simp only [val_map, Matrix.map_apply, val_insertEntryEquiv, insertEntryVal]
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · simp [hi, hj]
    · simp [hi, hj]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · simp [hi, hj]
    · simp [hi, hj]

end Insertion

/-! ### Deletion -/

section Deletion

variable {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
variable {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
variable {e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R} {r : m} {c : n}

def deleteEntryVal (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    Matrix (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R :=
  e.val.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

def deleteEntryInvVal (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    Matrix (DeletedIndex n c) (DeletedIndex m r) R :=
  e.inv.submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

theorem deleteEntryVal_apply (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c)
    (i : DeletedIndex m r) (j : DeletedIndex n c) :
    deleteEntryVal _h i j = e.val i.1 j.1 := rfl

theorem deleteEntryInvVal_apply (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c)
    (i : DeletedIndex n c) (j : DeletedIndex m r) :
    deleteEntryInvVal _h i j = e.inv i.1 j.1 := rfl

lemma deleteEntryVal_mul_deleteEntryInvVal (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    deleteEntryVal h * deleteEntryInvVal h = 1 := by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, deleteEntryVal_apply, deleteEntryInvVal_apply]
  set f : n → R := fun k => e.val i.1 k * e.inv k j.1
  have hf : f c = 0 := by dsimp [f]; rw [h.col_zero i.1 i.2, zero_mul]
  have hsum_full : (e.val * e.inv) i.1 j.1 = ∑ k : n, f k := by simp [f, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hsum_del : (∑ k : DeletedIndex n c, f k.1) = ∑ k : n, f k :=
    sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c f c hf
  calc (∑ k : DeletedIndex n c, e.val i.1 k.1 * e.inv k.1 j.1)
      = ∑ k : DeletedIndex n c, f k.1 := rfl
    _ = ∑ k : n, f k := hsum_del
    _ = (e.val * e.inv) i.1 j.1 := hsum_full.symm
    _ = (1 : Matrix m m R) i.1 j.1 := by rw [e.val_inv]
    _ = (1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex m r) R) i j := by
        simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij; simp
        · have hij_val : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
            intro heq
            apply hij
            exact Subtype.ext heq
          simp [hij, hij_val]

lemma deleteEntryInvVal_mul_deleteEntryVal (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    deleteEntryInvVal h * deleteEntryVal h = 1 := by
  classical
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, deleteEntryVal_apply, deleteEntryInvVal_apply]
  set f : m → R := fun k => e.inv i.1 k * e.val k j.1
  have hf : f r = 0 := by dsimp [f]; rw [h.row_zero j.1 j.2, mul_zero]
  have hsum_full : (e.inv * e.val) i.1 j.1 = ∑ k : m, f k := by simp [f, Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hsum_del : (∑ k : DeletedIndex m r, f k.1) = ∑ k : m, f k :=
    sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c f r hf
  calc (∑ k : DeletedIndex m r, e.inv i.1 k.1 * e.val k.1 j.1)
      = ∑ k : DeletedIndex m r, f k.1 := rfl
    _ = ∑ k : m, f k := hsum_del
    _ = (e.inv * e.val) i.1 j.1 := hsum_full.symm
    _ = (1 : Matrix n n R) i.1 j.1 := by rw [e.inv_val]
    _ = (1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex n c) (DeletedIndex n c) R) i j := by
        simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij; simp
        · have hij_val : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
            intro heq
            apply hij
            exact Subtype.ext heq
          simp [hij, hij_val]

def deleteEntryEquiv (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R where
  val := deleteEntryVal h
  inv := deleteEntryInvVal h
  val_inv := deleteEntryVal_mul_deleteEntryInvVal h
  inv_val := deleteEntryInvVal_mul_deleteEntryVal h

@[simp]
theorem val_deleteEntryEquiv (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    (deleteEntryEquiv _h).val = deleteEntryVal _h := rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_deleteEntryEquiv (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    (deleteEntryEquiv _h).inv = deleteEntryInvVal _h := rfl

theorem val_deleteEntryEquiv_apply (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c)
    (i : DeletedIndex m r) (j : DeletedIndex n c) :
    (deleteEntryEquiv _h).val i j = e.val i.1 j.1 := rfl

theorem inv_deleteEntryEquiv_apply (_h : IsolatedEntry e r c)
    (i : DeletedIndex n c) (j : DeletedIndex m r) :
    (deleteEntryEquiv _h).inv i j = e.inv i.1 j.1 := rfl

theorem delete_after_insert (r : m) (c : n) (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex m r) (DeletedIndex n c) R) :
    deleteEntryEquiv (isIsolated_insertEntryEquiv r c a D) = D := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  have hi : i.val ≠ r := i.property
  have hj : j.val ≠ c := j.property
  simp only [val_deleteEntryEquiv, deleteEntryVal, val_insertEntryEquiv]
  calc insertEntryVal r c a D i.val j.val
      = D.val ⟨i.val, hi⟩ ⟨j.val, hj⟩ := insertEntryVal_ne_ne r c a D hi hj
    _ = D.val i j := by
        have hi_eq : (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) = i := Subtype.ext rfl
        have hj_eq : (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) = j := Subtype.ext rfl
        rw [hi_eq, hj_eq]

theorem insert_delete_reconstruction (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) :
    insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h) (deleteEntryEquiv h) = e := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · rw [hi]
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hj]
      simp only [val_insertEntryEquiv, insertEntryVal_self, coe_isolatedPivotUnit]
    · have hrj : e.val r j = 0 := h.row_zero j hj
      have hleft : (insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h) (deleteEntryEquiv h)).val r j = 0 :=
        insertEntryEquiv_val_row_ne r c _ _ hj
      rw [hleft, hrj]
  · have hi' : i ≠ r := hi
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hj]
      have hic : e.val i c = 0 := h.col_zero i hi'
      have hleft : (insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h) (deleteEntryEquiv h)).val i c = 0 :=
        insertEntryEquiv_val_col_ne r c _ _ hi'
      rw [hleft, hic]
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      calc (insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h) (deleteEntryEquiv h)).val i j
          = (deleteEntryEquiv h).val ⟨i, hi'⟩ ⟨j, hj'⟩ :=
            insertEntryEquiv_val_ne_ne r c _ _ hi' hj'
        _ = e.val i j := rfl

theorem eq_of_pivot_and_delete_eq {e₁ e₂ : GeneralLinearEquiv m n R}
    {r : m} {c : n} {h₁ : IsolatedEntry e₁ r c} {h₂ : IsolatedEntry e₂ r c}
    (hpivot : e₁.val r c = e₂.val r c)
    (hdel : deleteEntryEquiv h₁ = deleteEntryEquiv h₂) :
    e₁ = e₂ := by
  have h1 := insert_delete_reconstruction h₁
  have h2 := insert_delete_reconstruction h₂
  have hpivot_units : isolatedPivotUnit h₁ = isolatedPivotUnit h₂ := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact hpivot
  calc e₁ = insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h₁) (deleteEntryEquiv h₁) := h1.symm
    _ = insertEntryEquiv r c (isolatedPivotUnit h₂) (deleteEntryEquiv h₂) := by
        rw [hpivot_units, hdel]
    _ = e₂ := h2

theorem map_deleteEntryEquiv (h : IsolatedEntry e r c) (f : R →+* S) :
    (deleteEntryEquiv h).map f = deleteEntryEquiv (h.map f) := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  simp [val_map, Matrix.map_apply, deleteEntryVal, Matrix.submatrix_apply]

end Deletion

/-! ### Square compatibility bridges -/

section SquareBridge

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {R : Type*} [Semiring R]
variable (c : ι)

theorem toGL_insertEntryEquiv_val (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) (i j : ι) :
    insertEntryVal (m := ι) (n := ι) c c a D i j =
      insertVal (R := R) c a (toGL D) i j := by
  simp only [insertEntryVal, insertVal, val_toGL]

theorem toGL_insertEntryEquiv (a : Rˣ)
    (D : GeneralLinearEquiv (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) :
    toGL (insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c a D) =
      insertCoordinateUnit c a (toGL D) := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [toGL, Units.val_mk, coe_insertCoordinateUnit]
  exact toGL_insertEntryEquiv_val c a D i j

theorem ofGL_insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (DeletedIndex ι c) R) :
    ofGL (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) =
      insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c a (ofGL x) := by
  apply ext
  ext i j
  simp only [val_insertEntryEquiv, insertEntryVal, coe_insertCoordinateUnit, insertVal,
    val_ofGL]

variable {R' : Type*} [Ring R']

theorem IsolatedCoordinate.toIsolatedEntry {g : GL ι R'} {c : ι}
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) : IsolatedEntry (ofGL g) c c where
  row_zero j hj := by
    have : (↑g : Matrix ι ι R') c j = 0 := h.row_zero j hj
    simpa [ofGL] using this
  col_zero i hi := by
    have : (↑g : Matrix ι ι R') i c = 0 := h.col_zero i hi
    simpa [ofGL] using this

theorem IsolatedEntry.toIsolatedCoordinate {e : GeneralLinearEquiv ι ι R'} {c : ι}
    (h : IsolatedEntry e c c) : IsolatedCoordinate (toGL e) c where
  col_zero i hi := by
    have : e.val i c = 0 := h.col_zero i hi
    simpa [toGL] using this
  row_zero j hj := by
    have : e.val c j = 0 := h.row_zero j hj
    simpa [toGL] using this

theorem isolatedPivotUnit_toGL {e : GeneralLinearEquiv ι ι R'} {c : ι}
    (h : IsolatedEntry e c c) :
    isolatedPivotUnit h =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.isolatedPivotUnit c (toGL e) h.toIsolatedCoordinate := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

theorem delete_toGL {e : GeneralLinearEquiv ι ι R'} {c : ι}
    (h : IsolatedEntry e c c) :
    toGL (deleteEntryEquiv h) = deleteCoordinate (toGL e) c h.toIsolatedCoordinate := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  rfl

theorem ofGL_reconstruction {g : GL ι R'} {c : ι} (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    ofGL g = insertEntryEquiv (m := ι) (n := ι) c c
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (ofGL (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
  calc ofGL g =
        ofGL (insertCoordinateUnit c
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
        rw [insert_isolatedPivotUnit_deleteCoordinate]
    _ = insertEntryEquiv c c
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.isolatedPivotUnit c g h)
          (ofGL (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
        rw [ofGL_insertCoordinateUnit]

end SquareBridge

end GeneralLinearEquiv
