/-! ### E. Deletion API for heterogeneous monomial equivalences

We work with `monomialEquiv w σ : GeneralLinearEquiv m n K` whose
orientation is

  `val i j = if σ j = i then (w i : K) else 0`.

Thus column `c : n` carries its unique nonzero entry at row `σ c`
with weight `w (σ c)`.  Deleting this pivot gives

* target deletion `DeletedIndex m (σ c)` and source deletion
  `DeletedIndex n c`,
* induced permutation `deletePerm σ c : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m (σ c)`,
* restricted weights `deleteWeights w (σ c) : DeletedIndex m (σ c) → Kˣ`.

Insertion `insertPerm` and `insertWeights` are the inverse operations.
`deleteEntryEquiv` on the isolated monomial entry coincides with the
monomial built from the deleted data.  Reinsertion via
`insertEntryEquiv` recovers the original monomial; away from the pivot
the entries agree.  Multiplication order is preserved by construction;
no commutativity is used.

Nonclaims: we do not claim Bruhat factors are trivial in this packet;
we do not provide order-isomorphism upgrades or `Finset.erase`
translations beyond the `DeletedIndex` API already in the library.
All side conditions `i ≠ σ c`, `j ≠ c` are proved explicitly. -/

section MonomialDeletePerm

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

/-- Deletion of a pivot from a heterogeneous permutation.

For `σ : n ≃ m` and `c : n`, the induced equivalence
`DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m (σ c)` sends `⟨j, hj⟩` to
`⟨σ j, _⟩`.  The inequality proof uses injectivity of `σ`. -/
def deletePerm (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m (σ c) where
  toFun j :=
    ⟨σ j.val, fun hEq => j.prop (σ.injective hEq)⟩
  invFun i :=
    ⟨σ.symm i.val, fun hEq => i.prop (by
      calc i.val = σ (σ.symm i.val) := (σ.apply_symm_apply i.val).symm
        _ = σ c := congrArg σ hEq)⟩
  left_inv j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact σ.symm_apply_apply j.val
  right_inv i := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact σ.apply_symm_apply i.val

omit [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] in
@[simp]
theorem deletePerm_apply (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) (j : DeletedIndex n c) :
    (deletePerm σ c j).val = σ j.val := rfl

omit [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] in
@[simp]
theorem deletePerm_symm_apply (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) (i : DeletedIndex m (σ c)) :
    ((deletePerm σ c).symm i).val = σ.symm i.val := rfl

omit [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] in
theorem deletePerm_apply_eq_iff (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n)
    (j : DeletedIndex n c) (i : DeletedIndex m (σ c)) :
    deletePerm σ c j = i ↔ σ j.val = i.val := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa using this
  · intro h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h

/-- Insertion of a pivot into a deleted permutation.

Given `c : n`, `r : m` and `e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r`,
build `n ≃ m` sending `c ↦ r` and `j ≠ c ↦ (e ⟨j, _⟩).val`.
Orientation matches `deletePerm`: column → row via `σ`.

The `toFun`/`invFun` are defined inline via `where` so that `left_inv`/`right_inv`
goals already contain the `if`-branch; each branch is then closed with
`simp only [dite_eq_left/dite_eq_right]`. -/
def insertPerm (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) : n ≃ m where
  toFun j := if h : j = c then r else (e ⟨j, h⟩).val
  invFun i := if h : i = r then c else (e.symm ⟨i, h⟩).val
  left_inv := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = c
    · subst j
      change (if h : (if h : c = c then r else (e ⟨c, h⟩).val) = r then c else
          (e.symm ⟨(if h : c = c then r else (e ⟨c, h⟩).val), h⟩).val) = c
      rw [dite_eq_left rfl, dite_eq_left rfl]
    · have hp : (e ⟨j, hj⟩).val ≠ r := (e ⟨j, hj⟩).prop
      simp only [dite_eq_right hj, dite_eq_right hp]
      have hSub : (⟨(e ⟨j, hj⟩).val, hp⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) = e ⟨j, hj⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext rfl
      rw [hSub]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.symm_apply_apply ⟨j, hj⟩)
  right_inv := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = r
    · subst i
      change (if h : (if h : r = r then c else (e.symm ⟨r, h⟩).val) = c then r else
          (e ⟨(if h : r = r then c else (e.symm ⟨r, h⟩).val), h⟩).val) = r
      rw [dite_eq_left rfl, dite_eq_left rfl]
    · have hp : (e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val ≠ c := (e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).prop
      simp only [dite_eq_right hi, dite_eq_right hp]
      have hSub : (⟨(e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val, hp⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) = e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext rfl
      rw [hSub]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply ⟨i, hi⟩)

theorem insertPerm_apply_of_eq (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    insertPerm c r e c = r := by
  change (if h : c = c then r else (e ⟨c, h⟩).val) = r
  exact dite_eq_left rfl

theorem insertPerm_apply_of_ne (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) (j : n) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    insertPerm c r e j = (e ⟨j, hj⟩).val := by
  change (if h : j = c then r else (e ⟨j, h⟩).val) = (e ⟨j, hj⟩).val
  exact dite_eq_right hj

theorem insertPerm_symm_apply_of_eq (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (insertPerm c r e).symm r = c := by
  have h : (insertPerm c r e).symm ((insertPerm c r e) c) = c :=
    (insertPerm c r e).symm_apply_apply c
  rw [insertPerm_apply_of_eq] at h
  exact h

theorem insertPerm_symm_apply_of_ne (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) (i : m) (hi : i ≠ r) :
    (insertPerm c r e).symm i = (e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
  change (if h : i = r then c else (e.symm ⟨i, h⟩).val) = (e.symm ⟨i, hi⟩).val
  exact dite_eq_right hi

/-- Insertion after deletion recovers the original permutation pointwise. -/
theorem insertPerm_deletePerm_apply (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) (j : n) :
    insertPerm c (σ c) (deletePerm σ c) j = σ j := by
  by_cases hj : j = c
  · rw [hj, insertPerm_apply_of_eq]
  · rw [insertPerm_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hj]
    rfl

/-- Full Equiv equality: inserting the deleted perm recovers `σ`. -/
theorem insertPerm_deletePerm (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    insertPerm c (σ c) (deletePerm σ c) = σ := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro j
  exact insertPerm_deletePerm_apply σ c j

/-- Deletion after insertion recovers the smaller permutation pointwise at the
value level.  The codomain of `deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c` is
`DeletedIndex m ((insertPerm c r e) c)`, propositionally but not definitionally `r`,
so we state equality of underlying `m` values. -/
theorem deletePerm_insertPerm_apply (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) (j : DeletedIndex n c) :
    (deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c j).val = (e j).val := by
  have hj : j.val ≠ c := j.prop
  have hEq : (insertPerm c r e) j.val = (e ⟨j.val, hj⟩).val := by
    rw [insertPerm_apply_of_ne c r e j.val hj]
  have hSub : (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : DeletedIndex n c) = j := Subtype.ext rfl
  calc (deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c j).val
      = (insertPerm c r e) j.val := rfl
    _ = (e ⟨j.val, hj⟩).val := hEq
    _ = (e j).val := by rw [hSub]

/-- Full Equiv equality with explicit transport along `insertPerm_apply_of_eq`:
`deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c` has codomain indexed by `(insertPerm c r e) c`,
so we compose with `deletedIndexEquivOfEq` before comparing to `e`. -/
theorem deletePerm_insertPerm (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c).trans
        (deletedIndexEquivOfEq (insertPerm_apply_of_eq c r e)) = e := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro j
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc ((deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c).trans
          (deletedIndexEquivOfEq (insertPerm_apply_of_eq c r e)) j).val
      = (deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c j).val := rfl
    _ = (e j).val := deletePerm_insertPerm_apply c r e j

end MonomialDeletePerm

section MonomialDeleteWeights

variable {m : Type*} [DecidableEq m]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

/-- Deletion/restriction of monomial weights at `r : m`. -/
def deleteWeights (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) :
    DeletedIndex m r → Kˣ := fun i => w i.val

omit [DecidableEq m] in
@[simp]
theorem deleteWeights_apply (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) (i : DeletedIndex m r) :
    deleteWeights w r i = w i.val := rfl

omit [DecidableEq m] in
theorem insertWeights_apply_of_eq (r : m) (a : Kˣ) (w' : DeletedIndex m r → Kˣ) :
    insertWeights r a w' r = a := insertWeights_apply_self r a w'

omit [DecidableEq m] in
/-- `deleteWeights` after `insertWeights` is identity. -/
theorem deleteWeights_insertWeights (r : m) (a : Kˣ) (w' : DeletedIndex m r → Kˣ) :
    deleteWeights (insertWeights r a w') r = w' := by
  funext i
  have hi : i.val ≠ r := i.prop
  calc deleteWeights (insertWeights r a w') r i
      = insertWeights r a w' i.val := rfl
    _ = w' ⟨i.val, hi⟩ := by rw [insertWeights_apply_of_ne hi]
    _ = w' i := by
        have hSub : (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : DeletedIndex m r) = i := Subtype.ext rfl
        rw [hSub]

omit [DecidableEq m] in
/-- `insertWeights` after `deleteWeights` recovers the original weights. -/
theorem insertWeights_deleteWeights (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) :
    insertWeights r (w r) (deleteWeights w r) = w := by
  classical
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i = r
  · rw [hi, insertWeights_apply_of_eq]
  · rw [insertWeights_apply_of_ne hi]
    rfl

end MonomialDeleteWeights

section MonomialDeleteWeightsMap

variable {m : Type*}
variable {K L : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [DivisionRing L]

/-- Pointwise `Units.map` commutes with `deleteWeights`. -/
theorem deleteWeights_map (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) (i : DeletedIndex m r) (f : K →+* L) :
    Units.map f.toMonoidHom (deleteWeights w r i) =
      deleteWeights (fun j => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (w j)) r i :=
  rfl

/-- Function-level `Units.map` commutes with `deleteWeights`. -/
theorem deleteWeights_map_eq (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) (f : K →+* L) :
    (fun i => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (deleteWeights w r i)) =
      deleteWeights (fun j => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (w j)) r :=
  rfl

end MonomialDeleteWeightsMap

section MonomialDeleteWeightsMonomialMap

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
variable {K L : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [DivisionRing L]

/-- Mapping a deleted-weight monomial along `f` equals the monomial over mapped deleted weights. -/
theorem monomialEquiv_deleteWeights_map (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) (f : K →+* L) :
    (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c)).map f =
      monomialEquiv (R := L) (deleteWeights (fun j => Units.map f.toMonoidHom (w j)) (σ c))
        (deletePerm σ c) := by
  rw [map_monomialEquiv]
  exact congrArg (fun w' : DeletedIndex m (σ c) → Lˣ =>
    monomialEquiv (R := L) w' (deletePerm σ c)) (deleteWeights_map_eq w (σ c) f)

end MonomialDeleteWeightsMonomialMap

section MonomialInsertCompat

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

/-- Alias for the monomial-specific deletion of weights via `σ c`. -/
abbrev monomialDeleteWeights (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    DeletedIndex m (σ c) → Kˣ := deleteWeights w (σ c)

/-- Alias for the monomial-specific `deletePerm`. -/
abbrev monomialDeletePerm (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m (σ c) := deletePerm σ c

/-- Insertion/deletion compatibility for permutations with explicit transport:
deleting the inserted perm then transporting along `insertPerm_apply_of_eq`
recovers `e`. -/
theorem insertEquiv_deletePerm (c : n) (r : m)
    (e : DeletedIndex n c ≃ DeletedIndex m r) :
    (deletePerm (insertPerm c r e) c).trans
        (deletedIndexEquivOfEq (insertPerm_apply_of_eq c r e)) = e :=
  deletePerm_insertPerm c r e

/-- Insertion/deletion compatibility for permutations: inserting the
deleted permutation recovers `σ`. -/
theorem deletePerm_insertEquiv (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    insertPerm c (σ c) (deletePerm σ c) = σ :=
  insertPerm_deletePerm σ c

omit [DecidableEq m] in
/-- Insertion/deletion compatibility for weights (API-native name:
`insertWeights_deleteWeights`). -/
theorem insertWeights_deleteWeights_compat (r : m) (a : Kˣ)
    (w' : DeletedIndex m r → Kˣ) :
    deleteWeights (insertWeights r a w') r = w' :=
  deleteWeights_insertWeights r a w'

omit [DecidableEq m] in
theorem deleteWeights_insertWeights_compat (w : m → Kˣ) (r : m) :
    insertWeights r (w r) (deleteWeights w r) = w :=
  insertWeights_deleteWeights w r

end MonomialInsertCompat

section MonomialDeleteEntryEquiv

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
/-- The monomial matrix is isolated at its pivot `(σ c, c)`. -/
theorem isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    IsolatedEntry (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ) (σ c) c where
  row_zero j hj := by
    have hNe : σ j ≠ σ c := fun hEq => hj (σ.injective hEq)
    exact monomialEquiv_val_zero_of_row_ne (K := K) w σ hNe
  col_zero i hi := by
    exact monomialEquiv_val_zero_of_col_ne (K := K) w σ hi

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
theorem isolatedPivotUnit_monomialEquiv (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    isolatedPivotUnit (isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c) = w (σ c) := by
  apply Units.ext
  have hVal : (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val (σ c) c = (w (σ c) : K) := by
    rw [val_monomialEquiv_apply, ite_eq_left rfl]
  calc ((isolatedPivotUnit (isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c)).val : K)
      = (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val (σ c) c := rfl
    _ = (w (σ c) : K) := hVal

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
/-- Deletion of the isolated pivot entry from a monomial equivalence coincides
with the monomial built from restricted weights and deleted permutation.

Orientation: column `c` and row `σ c` are deleted; the induced permutation
is `deletePerm σ c` sending deleted columns to deleted rows. -/
theorem deleteEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_eq (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    deleteEntryEquiv (isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c) =
      monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c) := by
  apply GeneralLinearEquiv.ext
  ext i j
  have hBase : (deleteEntryEquiv (isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c)).val i j =
      (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val i.val j.val := rfl
  rw [hBase, val_monomialEquiv_apply, val_monomialEquiv_apply]
  by_cases hEq : σ j.val = i.val
  · have hPermEq : deletePerm σ c j = i := Subtype.ext hEq
    rw [ite_eq_left hEq, ite_eq_left hPermEq, deleteWeights_apply]
  · have hPermNe : deletePerm σ c j ≠ i :=
      fun hContra => hEq (congrArg Subtype.val hContra)
    rw [ite_eq_right hEq, ite_eq_right hPermNe]

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
/-- Entrywise identification away from the pivot. -/
theorem deleteEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_entry_eq (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n)
    (i : m) (hi : i ≠ σ c) (j : n) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val i j =
      (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c)).val
        ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  have hDel := deleteEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_eq w σ c
  calc (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val i j
      = (deleteEntryEquiv (isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c)).val ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := rfl
    _ = (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c)).val ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
        rw [hDel]

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
/-- Reinsertion: putting the deleted monomial data back via `insertEntryEquiv`
recovers the original monomial equivalence.

This uses `insert_delete_reconstruction` together with the exact
deleted-data identification and pivot-unit lemma above. -/
theorem insertEntryEquiv_monomialDeleteEquiv (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n) :
    insertEntryEquiv (σ c) c (w (σ c))
      (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c)) =
      monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ := by
  have hIso : IsolatedEntry (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ) (σ c) c :=
    isIsolatedEntry_monomialEquiv w σ c
  have hUnit : isolatedPivotUnit hIso = w (σ c) :=
    isolatedPivotUnit_monomialEquiv w σ c
  have hDel : deleteEntryEquiv hIso =
      monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c) :=
    deleteEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_eq w σ c
  calc insertEntryEquiv (σ c) c (w (σ c))
        (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c))
      = insertEntryEquiv (σ c) c (isolatedPivotUnit hIso) (deleteEntryEquiv hIso) := by
        rw [← hUnit, ← hDel]
    _ = monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ := insert_delete_reconstruction hIso

omit [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] in
/-- Entrywise version of reinsertion away from the pivot. -/
theorem insertEntryEquiv_monomialEquiv_away (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) (c : n)
    (i : m) (_ : i ≠ σ c) (j : n) (_ : j ≠ c) :
    (insertEntryEquiv (σ c) c (w (σ c))
      (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c))).val i j =
      (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ).val i j := by
  rw [insertEntryEquiv_monomialDeleteEquiv w σ c]

end MonomialDeleteEntryEquiv

section CanonicalPivotMonomialFixedPoint

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] [Nonempty n]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

/-- Monomial equivalences are fixed by canonical pivot clearing.

The canonical pivot row of `monomialEquiv w σ` is `σ canonicalColumn`,
its column support is the singleton `{σ canonicalColumn}` and its row
support is `{canonicalColumn}`; hence both the upper row and column
clearing factors are identity and `canonicalPivotCleared` is the identity
on the monomial. -/
theorem canonicalPivotCleared_monomialEquiv (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) :
    canonicalPivotCleared (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ) =
      monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ := by
  set e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n K := monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ with he
  set c : n := (canonicalColumn : n) with hc
  have hRowEq : canonicalPivotRow e = σ c := canonicalPivotRow_monomialEquiv w σ
  have hRowClear : rowClear e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e) = 1 := by
    apply rowClear_eq_one_of_forall_ne_zero_eq
    intro i hi
    have hσ : σ c = i := (monomialEquiv_val_ne_zero_iff w σ i c).mp hi
    calc i = σ c := hσ.symm
      _ = canonicalPivotRow e := hRowEq.symm
  have hColClear : columnClear e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e) = 1 := by
    apply columnClear_eq_one_of_forall_ne_zero_eq
    intro j hj
    have hσ : σ j = canonicalPivotRow e :=
      (monomialEquiv_val_ne_zero_iff w σ (canonicalPivotRow e) j).mp hj
    have hσc : σ j = σ c := hσ.trans hRowEq
    exact σ.injective hσc
  apply GeneralLinearEquiv.ext
  -- `canonicalPivotCleared` is `pivotClearedEquiv` at the canonical row/col
  have hVal : (canonicalPivotCleared e).val =
      pivotClearedMatrix e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e) := rfl
  rw [hVal]
  -- unfold clearing product and use identity factors
  calc pivotClearedMatrix e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e)
      = ((rowClear e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e) : GL m K) :
          Matrix m m K) * e.val *
          ((columnClear e.val (canonicalPivotRow e) c (canonicalPivotRow_ne_zero e) : GL n K) :
            Matrix n n K) := rfl
    _ = ((1 : GL m K) : Matrix m m K) * e.val * ((1 : GL n K) : Matrix n n K) := by
        rw [hRowClear, hColClear]
    _ = e.val := by simp

end CanonicalPivotMonomialFixedPoint

section ReducedPivotMonomialEquiv

variable {m n : Type*} [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
  [LinearOrder m] [LinearOrder n] [Nonempty n]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

/-- After canonical pivot clearing a monomial equivalence, its reduced pivot
equivalence, reindexed along the equality of the canonical pivot row with
`σ canonicalColumn`, is the monomial equivalence built from `deleteWeights`
and `deletePerm`.

Orientation fix: `canonicalPivotRow_monomialEquiv` proves
`canonicalPivotRow (monomialEquiv w σ) = σ canonicalColumn`.  The reindex
needs `DeletedIndex m (σ c) ≃ DeletedIndex m (canonicalPivotRow _)`,
i.e. the symmetric equality, which is `.symm` of the stated helper.
The task statement therefore type-checks with `.symm`; this is the only
adjustment beyond `(R := K)`.

Uses the fixed-point `canonicalPivotCleared_monomialEquiv`, `val_reindex`,
and a direct entrywise argument via `val_monomialEquiv_apply` and
`deletePerm_apply_eq_iff`.  No case split on `Fintype.card n`; the empty
`DeletedIndex` case is uniform because `submatrix` and `monomialEquiv` handle vacuous indices. -/
theorem reducedPivotEquiv_monomialEquiv (w : m → Kˣ) (σ : n ≃ m) :
    (reducedPivotEquiv (monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ)).reindex
      (deletedIndexEquivOfEq (canonicalPivotRow_monomialEquiv (K := K) w σ).symm)
      (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex n (canonicalColumn : n))) =
    monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ (canonicalColumn : n)))
      (deletePerm σ (canonicalColumn : n)) := by
  set e : GeneralLinearEquiv m n K := monomialEquiv (R := K) w σ with he_def
  set c : n := (canonicalColumn : n) with hc_def
  have hRow : canonicalPivotRow e = σ c :=
    canonicalPivotRow_monomialEquiv (K := K) w σ
  have hClear : canonicalPivotCleared e = e :=
    canonicalPivotCleared_monomialEquiv (K := K) w σ
  have hClearVal : (canonicalPivotCleared e).val = e.val := by rw [hClear]
  apply GeneralLinearEquiv.ext
  ext i j
  calc ((reducedPivotEquiv e).reindex (deletedIndexEquivOfEq hRow.symm)
          (Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex n c))).val i j
      = (reducedPivotEquiv e).val ((deletedIndexEquivOfEq hRow.symm) i)
          ((Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex n c)) j) := by
        simp [val_reindex, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    _ = (canonicalPivotCleared e).val ((deletedIndexEquivOfEq hRow.symm) i).val
          (((Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex n c)) j).val) := rfl
    _ = e.val ((deletedIndexEquivOfEq hRow.symm) i).val
          (((Equiv.refl (DeletedIndex n c)) j).val) := by rw [hClearVal]
    _ = e.val i.val j.val := rfl
    _ = (monomialEquiv (R := K) (deleteWeights w (σ c)) (deletePerm σ c)).val i j := by
        rw [val_monomialEquiv_apply, val_monomialEquiv_apply]
        by_cases hEq : σ j.val = i.val
        · have hPerm : deletePerm σ c j = i := by
            rw [deletePerm_apply_eq_iff]
            exact hEq
          rw [ite_eq_left hEq, ite_eq_left hPerm]
          rfl
        · have hPermNe : deletePerm σ c j ≠ i := by
            intro hContra
            have : σ j.val = i.val :=
              (deletePerm_apply_eq_iff σ c j i).mp hContra
            exact hEq this
          rw [ite_eq_right hEq, ite_eq_right hPermNe]

end ReducedPivotMonomialEquiv

end GeneralLinearEquiv

end Matrix

/-
  Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Map
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators

/-!
# Isolated coordinate deletion for `GL`

For an invertible matrix with a row and column isolated at `c`
(zero off the pivot), delete the coordinate `c` to obtain an invertible
principal submatrix on the complementary indices.

This is the ring-generic recursive primitive for Bruhat-style extractions.
No order, division, `Fin`, field, or commutativity assumptions are used.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe uι uR vR wR

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
variable {R : Type uR} [Ring R]

/-- Indices distinct from `c`. -/
abbrev DeletedIndex (ι : Type uι) (c : ι) := { i : ι // i ≠ c }

/-- Row and column `c` are zero off the diagonal for `g`. -/
structure IsolatedCoordinate (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) : Prop where
  col_zero : ∀ i : ι, i ≠ c → (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0
  row_zero : ∀ j : ι, j ≠ c → (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c j = 0

namespace IsolatedCoordinate

variable {g : GL ι R} {c : ι}

theorem col_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0 :=
  h.col_zero i hi

theorem row_zero_of_ne (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) {j : ι} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c j = 0 :=
  h.row_zero j hj

/-- Constructor from exact `if` formulas for the isolated row and column. -/
theorem mk_of_if
    (hcol : ∀ i : ι, (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = if i = c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c c else 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j : ι, (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c j = if j = c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c c else 0) :
    IsolatedCoordinate g c where
  col_zero i hi := by
    simp [hcol i, hi]
  row_zero j hj := by
    simp [hrow j, hj]

/-- Preservation under arbitrary ring homomorphism. -/
theorem map {S : Type vR} [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) c where
  col_zero i hi := by
    have : (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) : Matrix ι ι S) i c =
        f ((↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i c) := by
      simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [this, h.col_zero i hi, f.map_zero]
  row_zero j hj := by
    have : (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) : Matrix ι ι S) c j =
        f ((↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c j) := by
      simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply]
    rw [this, h.row_zero j hj, f.map_zero]

end IsolatedCoordinate

/-- The `≠ c` principal submatrix of `g`. -/
def delVal (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R :=
  (↑g : Matrix ι ι R).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

/-- The `≠ c` principal submatrix of `g⁻¹`. -/
def delInvVal (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R :=
  (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val

private lemma sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c
    {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type uR} [AddCommMonoid R]
    (f : ι → R) (c : ι) (hf : f c = 0) :
    (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c, f k.1) = ∑ k : ι, f k := by
  have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
  rw [hf, zero_add] at h
  exact h.symm

private lemma val_inv_aux (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c)
    (i j : DeletedIndex ι c) :
    ((delVal g c * delInvVal g c) i j) = ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
  dsimp [delVal, delInvVal, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  set f : ι → R := fun k => (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 k * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) k j.1
  have hf : f c = 0 := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h.col_zero i.1 i.2, zero_mul]
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c,
          (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 k.1 * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) k.1 j.1) =
        ∑ k : ι, f k :=
    sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c f c hf
  calc
    (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c,
        (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 ↑k * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) ↑k j.1) =
        ∑ k : ι, f k := hsum
    _ = ((↑g : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R)) i.1 j.1 := by
        simp [f, Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
        have h1 : (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 := by
          rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one]
        rw [h1]

private lemma inv_val_aux (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c)
    (i j : DeletedIndex ι c) :
    ((delInvVal g c * delVal g c) i j) = ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
  dsimp [delVal, delInvVal, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  set f : ι → R := fun k => (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 k * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) k j.1
  have hf : f c = 0 := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h.row_zero j.1 j.2, mul_zero]
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c,
          (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 ↑k * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) ↑k j.1) =
        ∑ k : ι, f k :=
    sum_subtype_eq_of_zero_at_c f c hf
  calc
    (∑ k : DeletedIndex ι c,
        (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 ↑k * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) ↑k j.1) =
        ∑ k : ι, f k := hsum
    _ = ((↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R)) i.1 j.1 := by
        simp [f, Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
        have h1 : (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) * (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 := by
          rw [← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one]
        rw [h1]

/-- Deleting an isolated coordinate. The value is the principal submatrix
on indices `≠ c`; the inverse is the corresponding submatrix of `g⁻¹`. -/
def deleteCoordinate (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    GL (DeletedIndex ι c) R where
  val := delVal g c
  inv := delInvVal g c
  val_inv := by
    ext i j
    have h1 := val_inv_aux g c h i j
    have h2 : ((1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) i j) =
        ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
      simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        simp
      · have hij_val : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
          intro heq
          apply hij
          exact Subtype.ext heq
        simp [hij, hij_val]
    rw [h2]
    exact h1
  inv_val := by
    ext i j
    have h1 := inv_val_aux g c h i j
    have h2 : ((1 : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) i j) =
        ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) i.1 j.1) := by
      simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        simp
      · have hij_val : i.1 ≠ j.1 := by
          intro heq
          apply hij
          exact Subtype.ext heq
        simp [hij, hij_val]
    rw [h2]
    exact h1

@[simp]
theorem coe_deleteCoordinate (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    (↑(deleteCoordinate g c h) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) =
      (↑g : Matrix ι ι R).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_deleteCoordinate (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    (↑(deleteCoordinate g c h)⁻¹ : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) =
      (↑(g⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val :=
  rfl

section Naturality

variable {S : Type vR} [Ring S]
variable {T : Type wR} [Ring T]

/-- Mapping preserves isolatedness. -/
theorem isolatedCoordinate_map (f : R →+* S) (g : GL ι R) (c : ι)
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) c :=
  h.map f

/-- Naturality of `deleteCoordinate` for an arbitrary ring homomorphism. -/
theorem mapRingHom_deleteCoordinate (f : R →+* S) (g : GL ι R) (c : ι)
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (deleteCoordinate g c h) =
      deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) c (h.map f) := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, coe_deleteCoordinate,
    Matrix.submatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply]

/-- Identity naturality for `deleteCoordinate`. -/
theorem deleteCoordinate_mapRingHom_id (g : GL ι R) (c : ι)
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (RingHom.id R) g) c
        (h.map (RingHom.id R)) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (RingHom.id R) (deleteCoordinate g c h) := by
  rw [← mapRingHom_deleteCoordinate (f := RingHom.id R)]

/-- Composition naturality for `deleteCoordinate`. -/
theorem deleteCoordinate_mapRingHom_comp (f : R →+* S) (f' : S →+* T)
    (g : GL ι R) (c : ι) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (f'.comp f) g) c
        (h.map (f'.comp f)) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f'
        (deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) c (h.map f)) := by
  calc
    deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (f'.comp f) g) c
        (h.map (f'.comp f))
        = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (f'.comp f) (deleteCoordinate g c h) := by
          rw [← mapRingHom_deleteCoordinate]
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f'
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
          have hcomp :
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (f'.comp f) (deleteCoordinate g c h) =
                Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f'
                  (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
            exact DFunLike.congr_fun (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_comp f f')
              (deleteCoordinate g c h)
          exact hcomp
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f'
          (deleteCoordinate (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) c (h.map f)) := by
          rw [mapRingHom_deleteCoordinate]

end Naturality

section Reconstruction

variable (g : GL ι R) (c : ι)

/-- Entry with both indices distinct from `c` comes from the deleted block. -/
theorem coe_of_ne_ne (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) {i j : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i j =
      (↑(deleteCoordinate g c h) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
        ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  simp [coe_deleteCoordinate]

/-- Column isolation. -/
theorem coe_of_ne_eq (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0 :=
  h.col_zero i hi

/-- Row isolation. -/
theorem coe_of_eq_ne (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) {j : ι} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c j = 0 :=
  h.row_zero j hj

/-- Reconstruction with `dite`: the matrix is determined by its deleted block and pivot. -/
theorem coe_eq_block_of_isolated (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) (i j : ι) :
    (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) i j =
      if hi : i = c then
        if j = c then (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) c c else 0
      else
        if hj : j = c then 0
        else
          (↑(deleteCoordinate g c h) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
            ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · simp [hi, hj]
    · simp [hi, hj, h.row_zero j hj]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · simp [hi, hj, h.col_zero i hi]
    · simp [hi, hj, coe_deleteCoordinate]

end Reconstruction

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-
Author: @toskua, Avocado
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.MonomialCoordinateInsertion

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open PermutationBilinearCocycle
open Matrix

universe uι uR vR wR

/-- Deleted indices distinct from `c`, short alias. -/
abbrev Del (ι : Type uι) (c : ι) := DeletedIndex ι c

/-- Square matrices on `ι`, short alias. -/
abbrev Mat (ι : Type uι) (R : Type uR) := Matrix ι ι R

/-- Square matrices on `DeletedIndex ι c`, short alias. -/
abbrev DelMat (ι : Type uι) (c : ι) (R : Type uR) :=
  Matrix (Del ι c) (Del ι c) R

section InsertionSemiring

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] (c : ι)


/-- Matrix with pivot `a` at `(c,c)` and `x` on the complementary principal block. -/
def insertVal (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) : Mat ι R :=
  fun i j =>
    if hi : i = c then
      if j = c then (a : R) else 0
    else
      if hj : j = c then 0
      else (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c)

/-- Inverse matrix for the block insertion: `a⁻¹` at `(c,c)` and `x⁻¹` on complement. -/
def insertInvVal (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) : Mat ι R :=
  fun i j =>
    if hi : i = c then
      if j = c then ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) else 0
    else
      if hj : j = c then 0
      else ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c)

omit [Fintype ι] in
lemma one_submatrix (i j : ι) (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (1 : Mat ι R) i j =
      (1 : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := by
  simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · have hij' : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) = (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := Subtype.ext hij
    simp [hij]
  · have hij' : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) ≠ (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := by
      intro h
      apply hij
      exact congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp [hij, hij']

lemma val_mul_inv_aux (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    insertVal c a x * insertInvVal c a x = 1 := by
  ext i j
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      have h_zero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ c → insertVal c a x c k * insertInvVal c a x k c = 0 := by
        intro k hk
        have : insertVal c a x c k = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a x c k * insertInvVal c a x k c =
          insertVal c a x c c * insertInvVal c a x c c :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => h_zero b hb)
      rw [h_sum]
      have h1 : insertVal c a x c c = (a : R) := by unfold insertVal; simp
      have h2 : insertInvVal c a x c c = ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by unfold insertInvVal; simp
      rw [h1, h2]
      have : (a : R) * ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) = 1 := by
        calc (a : R) * ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)
            = ((a * a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by rfl
          _ = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel]
          _ = 1 := by simp
      rw [this]
      simp
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertVal c a x c k * insertInvVal c a x k j = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertInvVal c a x c j = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hj']
          simp [this]
        · have : insertVal c a x c k = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a x c k * insertInvVal c a x k j = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) c j = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj')]
      rw [hi, h_sum, h_one]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertVal c a x i k * insertInvVal c a x k c = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertVal c a x i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
          rw [this, zero_mul]
        · have : insertInvVal c a x k c = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, mul_zero]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a x i k * insertInvVal c a x k c = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) i c = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
      rw [hj, h_sum, h_one]
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      let f : ι → R := fun k => insertVal c a x i k * insertInvVal c a x k j
      have hf_c : f c = 0 := by
        dsimp [f]
        have : insertVal c a x i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum_eq : (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
        rw [hf_c, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have h_f_eq : ∀ d : Del ι c,
          f d.1 =
            (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d *
            ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        intro d
        dsimp [f]
        have hd : d.1 ≠ c := d.property
        have h1 : insertVal c a x i d.1 =
            (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d := by
          unfold insertVal; simp [hi', hd]
        have h2 : insertInvVal c a x d.1 j =
            ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
          unfold insertInvVal; simp [hd, hj']
        rw [h1, h2]
      have h_sum_sub : (∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1) =
          (x.val * (x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [h_f_eq d]
      have h_val_inv : (x.val : Matrix _ _ _) * ((x⁻¹).val : Matrix _ _ _) = 1 := by
        rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one]
      calc (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := h_sum_eq
        _ = (x.val * (x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R)
            (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := h_sum_sub
        _ = (1 : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by rw [h_val_inv]
        _ = (1 : Mat ι R) i j := (one_submatrix c i j hi' hj').symm


lemma inv_mul_val_aux (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    insertInvVal c a x * insertVal c a x = 1 := by
  ext i j
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      have h_zero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ c → insertInvVal c a x c k * insertVal c a x k c = 0 := by
        intro k hk
        have : insertInvVal c a x c k = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hk]
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertInvVal c a x c k * insertVal c a x k c =
          insertInvVal c a x c c * insertVal c a x c c :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => h_zero b hb)
      rw [h_sum]
      have h1 : insertInvVal c a x c c = ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by unfold insertInvVal; simp
      have h2 : insertVal c a x c c = (a : R) := by unfold insertVal; simp
      rw [h1, h2]
      have : ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (a : R) = 1 := by
        calc ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * (a : R)
            = ((a⁻¹ * a : Rˣ) : R) := by rfl
          _ = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel]
          _ = 1 := by simp
      rw [this]
      simp
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertInvVal c a x c k * insertVal c a x k j = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertVal c a x c j = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hj']
          simp [this]
        · have : insertInvVal c a x c k = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertInvVal c a x c k * insertVal c a x k j = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) c j = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj')]
      rw [hi, h_sum, h_one]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertInvVal c a x i k * insertVal c a x k c = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertInvVal c a x i c = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hi']
          rw [this, zero_mul]
        · have : insertVal c a x k c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, mul_zero]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertInvVal c a x i k * insertVal c a x k c = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) i c = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
      rw [hj, h_sum, h_one]
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      let f : ι → R := fun k => insertInvVal c a x i k * insertVal c a x k j
      have hf_c : f c = 0 := by
        dsimp [f]
        have : insertInvVal c a x i c = 0 := by unfold insertInvVal; simp [hi']
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum_eq : (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
        rw [hf_c, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have h_f_eq : ∀ d : Del ι c,
          f d.1 =
            ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d *
            (x.val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        intro d
        dsimp [f]
        have hd : d.1 ≠ c := d.property
        have h1 : insertInvVal c a x i d.1 =
            ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d := by
          unfold insertInvVal; simp [hi', hd]
        have h2 : insertVal c a x d.1 j =
            (x.val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
          unfold insertVal; simp [hd, hj']
        rw [h1, h2]
      have h_sum_sub : (∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1) =
          ((x⁻¹).val * x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [h_f_eq d]
      have h_inv_val : ((x⁻¹).val : Matrix _ _ _) * (x.val : Matrix _ _ _) = 1 := by
        rw [← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one]
      calc (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := h_sum_eq
        _ = ((x⁻¹).val * x.val : DelMat ι c R)
            (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := h_sum_sub
        _ = (1 : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by rw [h_inv_val]
        _ = (1 : Mat ι R) i j := (one_submatrix c i j hi' hj').symm


/-- Block-diagonal insertion of a pivot unit and a complementary `GL` element. -/
def insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) : GL ι R where
  val := insertVal c a x
  inv := insertInvVal c a x
  val_inv := val_mul_inv_aux c a x
  inv_val := inv_mul_val_aux c a x

@[simp]
theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) = insertVal c a x := rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) = insertInvVal c a x := rfl

theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit_apply (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) (i j : ι) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) i j =
      if hi : i = c then if j = c then (a : R) else 0
      else if hj : j = c then 0
        else (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := rfl

theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit_apply (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) (i j : ι) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) i j =
      if hi : i = c then if j = c then ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) else 0
      else if hj : j = c then 0
        else ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_c (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) c c = (a : R) := by
  simp [coe_insertCoordinateUnit, insertVal]

@[simp]
theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_ne (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {j : ι}
    (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) c j = 0 := by
  simp [coe_insertCoordinateUnit, insertVal, hj]

@[simp]
theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_c (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {i : ι}
    (hi : i ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) i c = 0 := by
  simp [coe_insertCoordinateUnit, insertVal, hi]

theorem coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_ne (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {i j : ι}
    (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) i j =
      (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := by
  simp [coe_insertCoordinateUnit, insertVal, hi, hj]

@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit_c_c (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) c c = ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) := by
  simp [coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit, insertInvVal]

@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit_c_ne (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {j : ι}
    (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) c j = 0 := by
  simp [coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit, insertInvVal, hj]

@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_c (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {i : ι}
    (hi : i ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) i c = 0 := by
  simp [coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit, insertInvVal, hi]

theorem coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_ne (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) {i j : ι}
    (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x)⁻¹ : Mat ι R) i j =
      ((x⁻¹).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj⟩ : Del ι c) := by
  simp [coe_inv_insertCoordinateUnit, insertInvVal, hi, hj]

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_mul (a₁ a₂ : Rˣ) (x₁ x₂ : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    insertCoordinateUnit c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) =
      insertCoordinateUnit c a₁ x₁ * insertCoordinateUnit c a₂ x₂ := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [Units.val_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, coe_insertCoordinateUnit]
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      have h_zero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ c →
          insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k c = 0 := by
        intro k hk
        have : insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k c =
          insertVal c a₁ x₁ c c * insertVal c a₂ x₂ c c :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => h_zero b hb)
      rw [h_sum]
      simp [insertVal, Units.val_mul]
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k j = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertVal c a₂ x₂ c j = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hj']
          simp [this]
        · have : insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a₁ x₁ c k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k j = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      rw [hi, h_sum]
      have : insertVal c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) c j = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hj']
      rw [this]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have h_all : ∀ k : ι, insertVal c a₁ x₁ i k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k c = 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = c
        · rw [hk]
          have : insertVal c a₁ x₁ i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
          rw [this, zero_mul]
        · have : insertVal c a₂ x₂ k c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hk]
          rw [this, mul_zero]
      have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, insertVal c a₁ x₁ i k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k c = 0 :=
        Fintype.sum_eq_zero _ (fun k => h_all k)
      rw [hj, h_sum]
      have : insertVal c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
      rw [this]
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      let f : ι → R := fun k => insertVal c a₁ x₁ i k * insertVal c a₂ x₂ k j
      have hf_c : f c = 0 := by
        dsimp [f]
        have : insertVal c a₁ x₁ i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
        rw [this, zero_mul]
      have h_sum_eq : (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := by
        have h := Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (f := f) (a := c)
        rw [hf_c, zero_add] at h
        exact h
      have h_f_eq : ∀ d : Del ι c,
          f d.1 =
            (x₁.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d *
            (x₂.val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        intro d
        dsimp [f]
        have hd : d.1 ≠ c := d.property
        have h1 : insertVal c a₁ x₁ i d.1 =
            (x₁.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) d := by
          unfold insertVal; simp [hi', hd]
        have h2 : insertVal c a₂ x₂ d.1 j =
            (x₂.val : DelMat ι c R) d (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
          unfold insertVal; simp [hd, hj']
        rw [h1, h2]
      have h_sum_sub : (∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1) =
          ((x₁.val : DelMat ι c R) *
            (x₂.val : DelMat ι c R)) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c)
            (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro d _
        rw [h_f_eq d]
      have h_mul : ((x₁ * x₂).val : DelMat ι c R) =
          (x₁.val : DelMat ι c R) * (x₂.val : DelMat ι c R) := by
        rw [← Units.val_mul]
      have h_eq : (∑ k : ι, f k) =
          ((x₁ * x₂).val : DelMat ι c R)
            (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        calc (∑ k : ι, f k) = ∑ d : Del ι c, f d.1 := h_sum_eq
          _ = ((x₁.val : DelMat ι c R) *
              (x₂.val : DelMat ι c R)) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c)
              (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := h_sum_sub
          _ = ((x₁ * x₂).val : DelMat ι c R)
              (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
            rw [h_mul]
      have h_left : insertVal c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) i j =
          ((x₁ * x₂).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        unfold insertVal; simp [hi', hj']
      calc insertVal c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) i j
          = ((x₁ * x₂).val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := h_left
        _ = (∑ k : ι, f k) := h_eq.symm
        _ = ∑ j_1, insertVal c a₁ x₁ i j_1 * insertVal c a₂ x₂ j_1 j := rfl

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_one :
    insertCoordinateUnit c (1 : Rˣ) (1 : GL (Del ι c) R) = 1 := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [Units.val_one, coe_insertCoordinateUnit]
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      simp [insertVal]
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      have h1 : insertVal c (1 : Rˣ) (1 : GL _ R) c j = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hj']
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) c j = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hj')]
      rw [hi, h1, h_one]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have h1 : insertVal c (1 : Rˣ) (1 : GL _ R) i c = 0 := by unfold insertVal; simp [hi']
      have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) i c = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hi]
      rw [hj, h1, h_one]
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      have h1 : insertVal c (1 : Rˣ) (1 : GL _ R) i j =
          (1 : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
        unfold insertVal
        simp [hi', hj', Units.val_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · have : (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) = (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := Subtype.ext hij
        simp [hij]
      · have : (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) ≠ (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) := by
          intro h
          apply hij
          exact congrArg Subtype.val h
        simp [hij]

/-- Bundled monoid hom `Rˣ × GL (DeletedIndex) →* GL ι`. -/
def insertCoordinateUnitHom : Rˣ × GL (Del ι c) R →* GL ι R where
  toFun p := insertCoordinateUnit c p.1 p.2
  map_one' := insertCoordinateUnit_one c
  map_mul' := by
    intro p q
    rcases p with ⟨a₁, x₁⟩
    rcases q with ⟨a₂, x₂⟩
    simp only [Prod.mul_def]
    rw [insertCoordinateUnit_mul]

theorem insertCoordinateUnitHom_apply (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    insertCoordinateUnitHom c (a, x) = insertCoordinateUnit c a x := rfl

variable {S : Type vR} [Semiring S] {T : Type wR} [Semiring T]

theorem mapRingHom_insertCoordinateUnit (f : R →+* S)
    (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) =
      insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f a) (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f x) := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply, coe_insertCoordinateUnit]
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      simp [insertVal]
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      rw [hi]
      simp [insertVal, hj', RingHom.map_zero]
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      simp [insertVal, hi', hj, RingHom.map_zero]
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      simp only [insertVal, dite_eq_right hi', dite_eq_right hj']
      simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply]

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_mapRingHom_id (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (RingHom.id R) (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) =
      insertCoordinateUnit c a x := by
  rw [mapRingHom_insertCoordinateUnit]
  simp

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_mapRingHom_comp (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T)
    (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (g.comp f) (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom g
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (insertCoordinateUnit c a x)) := by
  have h := Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom_comp (n := ι) f g
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h.symm (insertCoordinateUnit c a x)

end InsertionSemiring

section IsolationRing

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type uR} [Ring R] (c : ι)

theorem isIsolated_insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (insertCoordinateUnit c a x : GL ι R) c where
  col_zero _ hi := coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_c c a x hi
  row_zero _ hj := coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_ne c a x hj

theorem deleteCoordinate_insertCoordinateUnit (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R)
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate (insertCoordinateUnit c a x : GL ι R) c) :
    deleteCoordinate (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) c h = x := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  simp only [coe_deleteCoordinate, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  have hi : i.val ≠ c := i.property
  have hj : j.val ≠ c := j.property
  have h1 : (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a x) : Mat ι R) i.val j.val =
      (x.val : DelMat ι c R) (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : Del ι c) :=
    coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_ne c a x hi hj
  have hi_eq : (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Del ι c) = i := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hj_eq : (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : Del ι c) = j := Subtype.ext rfl
  rw [h1, hi_eq, hj_eq]

theorem deleteCoordinate_insertCoordinateUnit' (a : Rˣ) (x : GL (Del ι c) R) :
    deleteCoordinate (insertCoordinateUnit c a x) c (isIsolated_insertCoordinateUnit c a x) = x :=
  deleteCoordinate_insertCoordinateUnit c a x _

end IsolationRing

section PivotRing

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type uR} [Ring R] (c : ι)

lemma pivot_val_inv_aux (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    (↑g : Mat ι R) c c * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c = 1 := by
  classical
  have hmul : (↑g : Mat ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) = 1 := by
    rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one]
  have h_at : ((↑g : Mat ι R) * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R)) c c = (1 : Mat ι R) c c := by
    rw [hmul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply] at h_at
  have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) c c = 1 := by simp
  rw [h_one] at h_at
  have h_zero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ c → (↑g : Mat ι R) c k * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) k c = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [h.row_zero k hk, zero_mul]
  have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, (↑g : Mat ι R) c k * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) k c =
      (↑g : Mat ι R) c c * (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c :=
    Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => h_zero b hb)
  rw [h_sum] at h_at
  exact h_at

lemma pivot_inv_val_aux (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c * (↑g : Mat ι R) c c = 1 := by
  classical
  have hmul : (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) * (↑g : Mat ι R) = 1 := by
    rw [← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one]
  have h_at : ((↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) * (↑g : Mat ι R)) c c = (1 : Mat ι R) c c := by
    rw [hmul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply] at h_at
  have h_one : (1 : Mat ι R) c c = 1 := by simp
  rw [h_one] at h_at
  have h_zero : ∀ k : ι, k ≠ c → (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c k * (↑g : Mat ι R) k c = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [h.col_zero k hk, mul_zero]
  have h_sum : ∑ k : ι, (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c k * (↑g : Mat ι R) k c =
      (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c * (↑g : Mat ι R) c c :=
    Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun b hb => h_zero b hb)
  rw [h_sum] at h_at
  exact h_at

/-- Pivot unit of an isolated coordinate: `g c c` with inverse `(g⁻¹) c c`. -/
def isolatedPivotUnit (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) : Rˣ where
  val := (↑g : Mat ι R) c c
  inv := (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c
  val_inv := pivot_val_inv_aux c g h
  inv_val := pivot_inv_val_aux c g h

@[simp]
theorem coe_isolatedPivotUnit (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    (isolatedPivotUnit c g h : R) = (↑g : Mat ι R) c c := rfl

theorem coe_inv_isolatedPivotUnit (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    ((isolatedPivotUnit c g h)⁻¹ : Rˣ).val = (↑(g⁻¹) : Mat ι R) c c := rfl

theorem insert_isolatedPivotUnit_deleteCoordinate (g : GL ι R)
    (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    insertCoordinateUnit c (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h) = g := by
  classical
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      simp [coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_c]
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      rw [hi]
      have hl :
          (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c
              (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)) : Mat ι R) c j = 0 :=
        coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_ne c _ _ hj'
      rw [hl]
      exact (h.row_zero j hj').symm
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hl :
          (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c
              (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)) : Mat ι R) i c = 0 :=
        coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_c c _ _ hi'
      rw [hj]
      rw [hl]
      exact (h.col_zero i hi').symm
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      calc (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c
            (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)) : Mat ι R) i j
          = (↑(deleteCoordinate g c h) : Matrix _ _ _) (⟨i, hi'⟩ : Del ι c) (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Del ι c) :=
              coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_ne c _ _ hi' hj'
        _ = (↑g : Mat ι R) i j :=
              coe_of_ne_ne g c h hi' hj'

theorem eq_of_pivot_and_delete_eq {g₁ g₂ : GL ι R}
    {h₁ : IsolatedCoordinate g₁ c} {h₂ : IsolatedCoordinate g₂ c}
    (hpivot : (↑g₁ : Mat ι R) c c = (↑g₂ : Mat ι R) c c)
    (hdel : deleteCoordinate g₁ c h₁ = deleteCoordinate g₂ c h₂) :
    g₁ = g₂ := by
  have h1 := insert_isolatedPivotUnit_deleteCoordinate c g₁ h₁
  have h2 := insert_isolatedPivotUnit_deleteCoordinate c g₂ h₂
  have hpivot_units : isolatedPivotUnit c g₁ h₁ = isolatedPivotUnit c g₂ h₂ := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact hpivot
  calc g₁ = insertCoordinateUnit c (isolatedPivotUnit c g₁ h₁) (deleteCoordinate g₁ c h₁) := h1.symm
    _ = insertCoordinateUnit c (isolatedPivotUnit c g₂ h₂) (deleteCoordinate g₂ c h₂) := by
        rw [hpivot_units, hdel]
    _ = g₂ := h2

variable {S : Type vR} [Ring S]

theorem mapRingHom_isolatedPivotUnit (f : R →+* S)
    (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    Units.map f (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) =
      isolatedPivotUnit c (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g) (h.map f) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.map_apply]

theorem mapRingHom_reconstruction (f : R →+* S)
    (g : GL ι R) (h : IsolatedCoordinate g c) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g =
      insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f (isolatedPivotUnit c g h))
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
  have h_recon := insert_isolatedPivotUnit_deleteCoordinate c g h
  calc Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f g
      = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f
          (insertCoordinateUnit c (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
            rw [h_recon]
    _ = insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f (isolatedPivotUnit c g h))
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (deleteCoordinate g c h)) := by
            exact mapRingHom_insertCoordinateUnit c f
              (isolatedPivotUnit c g h) (deleteCoordinate g c h)

end PivotRing

section MonomialBridge

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type uR} [Semiring R] (c : ι)

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_monomial (a : Rˣ) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (Del ι c)) :
    insertCoordinateUnit c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x) =
      monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x) := by
  classical
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  by_cases hi : i = c
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · rw [hi, hj]
      rw [coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_c]
      exact (monomialInsert_matrix_c_c c a x).symm
    · have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      rw [hi]
      have hl : (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x)) : Mat ι R) c j = 0 :=
        coe_insertCoordinateUnit_c_ne c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x) hj'
      rw [hl]
      exact (monomialInsert_matrix_row_c c a x hj').symm
  · by_cases hj : j = c
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      rw [hj]
      have hl : (↑(insertCoordinateUnit c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x)) : Mat ι R) i c = 0 :=
        coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_c c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x) hi'
      rw [hl]
      exact (monomialInsert_matrix_col_c c a x hi').symm
    · have hi' : i ≠ c := hi
      have hj' : j ≠ c := hj
      rw [coe_insertCoordinateUnit_ne_ne c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x) hi' hj']
      rw [monomialInsert_matrix_block c a x hi' hj']

variable {S : Type vR} [Semiring S]

theorem insertCoordinateUnit_monomial_naturality (f : R →+* S)
    (a : Rˣ) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (Del ι c)) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f
        (insertCoordinateUnit c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x)) =
      insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f a)
        (monomialMatrixHom S (Del ι c) (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)) := by
  calc Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f
        (insertCoordinateUnit c a (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x))
      = insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f a)
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom f (monomialMatrixHom R (Del ι c) x)) := by
            rw [mapRingHom_insertCoordinateUnit]
    _ = insertCoordinateUnit c (Units.map f a)
          (monomialMatrixHom S (Del ι c) (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)) := by
            rw [monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply]

end MonomialBridge

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.LocalBlockReduction
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.RankOneCorrection
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.RankOneCorrectionFactorization

/-!
# Elementary subgroup over commutative local rings

Over a commutative local ring, `GL (Fin n)` is generated by elementary matrices
exactly when the determinant is `1`.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Matrix

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]

/-- Over a commutative local ring, a matrix in `GL (Fin n)` with determinant `1`
lies in the elementary subgroup. -/
theorem mem_elementarySubgroup_of_det_eq_one_of_isLocalRing {n : ℕ}
    {g : GL (Fin n) R} (hg : det g = 1) : g ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin n) R := by
  have hP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : GL (Fin n) R), det g = 1 → g ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin n) R := by
    apply Nat.twoStepInduction
    · intro g hg
      have h_eq : g = 1 := by
        apply Units.ext
        ext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro g hg
      have h_val : (det g).val = (1 : Rˣ).val := congrArg Units.val hg
      have h_det_val : (det g).val = (↑g : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R).det := rfl
      have h_one_val : (1 : Rˣ).val = (1 : R) := rfl
      have h_det_eq : (↑g : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R).det = 1 := by
        rw [← h_det_val, h_val, h_one_val]
      have h_entry : (↑g : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) 0 0 = 1 := by
        have h := Matrix.det_fin_one (A := (↑g : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R))
        rw [h] at h_det_eq
        exact h_det_eq
      have h_eq : g = 1 := by
        apply Units.ext
        ext i j
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim i 0
        have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim j 0
        subst hi
        subst hj
        simp [h_entry]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · intro n _ih0 ih1 g hg
      let e : Fin (n + 2) ≃ Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1 :=
        (finSumFinEquiv (m := n + 1) (n := 1)).symm
      let g' : GL (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R := reindexMulEquiv e g
      have hg'_det : det g' = 1 := by
        rw [det_reindexMulEquiv]
        exact hg
      obtain ⟨eL, eR, s, p, heL, heR, h_eq, h_det⟩ :=
        exists_elementary_blockReduction_finOne (R := R) g'
      let s' : GL (Fin (n + 1)) R := s * rankOneEmbedding n R p
      have hs'_det : det s' = 1 := by
        have h1 : det s' = det s * det (rankOneEmbedding n R p) := by
          simp [s']
        rw [h1, det_rankOneEmbedding, h_det, hg'_det]
      have hs'_mem : s' ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1)) R := ih1 s' hs'_det
      have h_blockOne_mem : blockDiagonalOne (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin 1) R s' ∈
          elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
        BlockElementary.blockDiagonalOne_mem_elementarySubgroup hs'_mem
      have h_corr_mem : rankOneCorrection n R p ∈
          elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
        rankOneCorrection_mem_elementarySubgroup n R p
      have h_bd_mem : BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p ∈
          elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R := by
        have h_factor := blockDiagonal_factor_rankOneCorrection n R s p
        rw [h_factor]
        exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ h_blockOne_mem h_corr_mem
      have h_eL_g'_eR_mem : eL * g' * eR ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R := by
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_bd_mem
      have h_g'_eR_mem :
          g' * eR ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R := by
        have h :
            eL * (g' * eR) ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R := by
          rwa [mul_assoc] at h_eL_g'_eR_mem
        exact
          (Subgroup.mul_mem_cancel_left
              (H := elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R) heL).mp h
      have hg'_mem :
          g' ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
        (Subgroup.mul_mem_cancel_right
            (H := elementarySubgroup (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Fin 1) R) heR).mp
          h_g'_eR_mem
      have hg_eq : reindexMulEquiv e.symm g' = g := by
        apply Units.ext
        simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, g', e]
        ext i j
        simp
      rw [← hg_eq]
      exact reindexMulEquiv_mem_elementarySubgroup e.symm hg'_mem
  exact hP n g hg

/-- The elementary subgroup equals the kernel of the determinant over a
commutative local ring. -/
theorem elementarySubgroup_eq_ker_det_of_isLocalRing (n : ℕ) :
    elementarySubgroup (Fin n) R = MonoidHom.ker (det : GL (Fin n) R →* Rˣ) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact elementarySubgroup_le_ker_det
  · intro g hg
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hg
    exact mem_elementarySubgroup_of_det_eq_one_of_isLocalRing hg

/-- Membership in the elementary subgroup iff determinant is `1` over a
commutative local ring. -/
theorem mem_elementarySubgroup_iff_det_eq_one_of_isLocalRing {n : ℕ}
    {g : GL (Fin n) R} : g ∈ elementarySubgroup (Fin n) R ↔ det g = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    exact det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup hg
  · intro hg
    exact mem_elementarySubgroup_of_det_eq_one_of_isLocalRing hg

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup
