module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockElementary
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.LocalPivot
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement

/-! Elementary local block reduction via the Schur complement. -/

@[expose] public section

open Matrix
open Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section Schur22

variable {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
  [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Schur complement `A - B * D⁻¹ * C` is a unit. -/
theorem isUnit_schurComplement₂₂
    (g : GL (α ⊕ β) R) [Invertible g.val.toBlocks₂₂] :
    IsUnit
      (g.val.toBlocks₁₁ -
        g.val.toBlocks₁₂ * ⅟(g.val.toBlocks₂₂) * g.val.toBlocks₂₁) := by
  have hU : IsUnit g.val := ⟨g, rfl⟩
  have h_eq :
      g.val =
        fromBlocks g.val.toBlocks₁₁ g.val.toBlocks₁₂
          g.val.toBlocks₂₁ g.val.toBlocks₂₂ :=
    (fromBlocks_toBlocks g.val).symm
  have h_isUnit_fromBlocks :
      IsUnit
        (fromBlocks g.val.toBlocks₁₁ g.val.toBlocks₁₂
          g.val.toBlocks₂₁ g.val.toBlocks₂₂) :=
    h_eq ▸ hU
  exact
    (Matrix.isUnit_fromBlocks_iff_of_invertible₂₂).mp
      h_isUnit_fromBlocks

/-- Bundled Schur complement unit `S = A - B D⁻¹ C`. -/
noncomputable def schurComplement₂₂Unit
    (g : GL (α ⊕ β) R) [Invertible g.val.toBlocks₂₂] : GL α R :=
  (isUnit_schurComplement₂₂ g).unit

@[simp]
theorem coe_schurComplement₂₂Unit
    (g : GL (α ⊕ β) R) [Invertible g.val.toBlocks₂₂] :
    (schurComplement₂₂Unit (α := α) (β := β) g : Matrix α α R) =
      g.val.toBlocks₁₁ -
        g.val.toBlocks₁₂ * ⅟(g.val.toBlocks₂₂) * g.val.toBlocks₂₁ :=
  IsUnit.unit_spec (isUnit_schurComplement₂₂ g)

/-- Clearing off-diagonal blocks gives block-diagonal Schur form. -/
theorem upper_mul_mul_lower_eq_blockDiagonal_schur
    (g : GL (α ⊕ β) R) [Invertible g.val.toBlocks₂₂] :
    BlockElementary.upperUnit (-(g.val.toBlocks₁₂ * ⅟(g.val.toBlocks₂₂))) *
        g *
      BlockElementary.lowerUnit
        (-(⅟(g.val.toBlocks₂₂) * g.val.toBlocks₂₁)) =
      BlockElementary.blockDiagonal
        (schurComplement₂₂Unit g) (unitOfInvertible g.val.toBlocks₂₂) := by
  let A := g.val.toBlocks₁₁
  let B := g.val.toBlocks₁₂
  let C := g.val.toBlocks₂₁
  let D := g.val.toBlocks₂₂
  have h_g_eq : g.val = fromBlocks A B C D :=
    (fromBlocks_toBlocks g.val).symm
  have h_s_eq :
      (schurComplement₂₂Unit (α := α) (β := β) g : Matrix α α R) =
        A - B * ⅟D * C :=
    coe_schurComplement₂₂Unit g
  have h_LDU :
      fromBlocks A B C D =
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (0 : Matrix β α R) D *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R) :=
    Matrix.fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₂₂ A B C D
  have h_inv_upper :
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
          (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
          (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) =
        (1 : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp
  have h_inv_lower :
      fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
          (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
          (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R) =
        (1 : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := by
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
    simp
  apply Units.ext
  -- expand GL products to matrix products
  have h_mul_expand :
      (BlockElementary.upperUnit (-(B * ⅟D)) * g *
        BlockElementary.lowerUnit (-(⅟D * C))).val =
        (BlockElementary.upperUnit (-(B * ⅟D))).val *
          g.val *
          (BlockElementary.lowerUnit (-(⅟D * C))).val := by
    simp [Units.val_mul]
  rw [h_mul_expand]
  simp only [BlockElementary.coe_upperUnit, BlockElementary.coe_lowerUnit,
    BlockElementary.blockDiagonal_eq_blockDiagonalHom, coe_blockDiagonalHom, h_s_eq]
  -- isolate middle g.val
  calc
    fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
          (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
        g.val *
        fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
          (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R)
      = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          fromBlocks A B C D *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by
        rw [h_g_eq]
    _ = fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
            (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
          (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
              (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
            fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
              (0 : Matrix β α R) D *
            fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
              (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R)) *
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
            (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R) := by
        rw [← h_LDU]
    _ = fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
          (0 : Matrix β α R) D := by
        -- cancel left and right factors
        have h_left_cancel :
            fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
                (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
              fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
                (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) =
              (1 : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := h_inv_upper
        have h_right_cancel :
            fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
              fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R) =
              (1 : Matrix (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) R) := h_inv_lower
        calc
          fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
                (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
              (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
                  (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
                fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                  (0 : Matrix β α R) D *
                fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                  (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R)) *
              fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R)
            = (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (-(B * ⅟D))
                  (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
                fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (B * ⅟D)
                  (0 : Matrix β α R) (1 : Matrix β β R)) *
              fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                (0 : Matrix β α R) D *
              (fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                  (⅟D * C) (1 : Matrix β β R) *
                fromBlocks (1 : Matrix α α R) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                  (-(⅟D * C)) (1 : Matrix β β R)) := by
            simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) (0 : Matrix α β R)
                (0 : Matrix β α R) D := by
            rw [h_left_cancel, h_right_cancel]
            simp

end Schur22

private theorem isUnit_toBlocks₂₂_of_isUnit_entry
    {α : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {M : Matrix (α ⊕ Fin 1) (α ⊕ Fin 1) R}
    (h : IsUnit (M (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)))) :
    IsUnit M.toBlocks₂₂ := by
  rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det]
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_one]
  have h_eq :
      M.toBlocks₂₂ (0 : Fin 1) (0 : Fin 1) =
        M (Sum.inr 0) (Sum.inr 0) := rfl
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h

section LocalFinOne

variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]

/-- Local block reduction for `GL (α ⊕ Fin 1)` over a local ring. -/
theorem exists_elementary_blockReduction_finOne
    (g : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R) :
    ∃ (eL eR : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R) (s : GL α R) (p : GL (Fin 1) R),
      eL ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R ∧
        eR ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R ∧
        eL * g * eR = BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p ∧
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det s *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det p =
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g := by
  classical
  have h_nonempty : Nonempty (α ⊕ Fin 1) := ⟨Sum.inr 0⟩
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀_mem, h_unit⟩ :=
    exists_elementary_mul_isUnit_entry
      (n := α ⊕ Fin 1) g (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1))
  let g' : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R := e₀ * g
  have h_entry :
      IsUnit (g'.val (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)) (Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1))) :=
    h_unit
  have h_isUnit_D : IsUnit g'.val.toBlocks₂₂ :=
    isUnit_toBlocks₂₂_of_isUnit_entry h_entry
  have hInvD : Invertible g'.val.toBlocks₂₂ :=
    h_isUnit_D.invertible
  let s : GL α R :=
    @schurComplement₂₂Unit α (Fin 1) _ _ _ _ R _ g' hInvD
  let p : GL (Fin 1) R :=
    @unitOfInvertible (Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) _ g'.val.toBlocks₂₂ hInvD
  let eU : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    BlockElementary.upperUnit
      (-(g'.val.toBlocks₁₂ *
        @Invertible.invOf (Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) _ _
          g'.val.toBlocks₂₂ hInvD))
  let eLw : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    BlockElementary.lowerUnit
      (-(@Invertible.invOf (Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) _ _
            g'.val.toBlocks₂₂ hInvD *
          g'.val.toBlocks₂₁))
  have heU_mem : eU ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    BlockElementary.upperUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  have heLw_mem : eLw ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    BlockElementary.lowerUnit_mem_elementarySubgroup _
  let eL : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R := eU * e₀
  let eR : GL (α ⊕ Fin 1) R := eLw
  have heL_mem : eL ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R :=
    Subgroup.mul_mem _ heU_mem he₀_mem
  have heR_mem : eR ∈ elementarySubgroup (α ⊕ Fin 1) R := heLw_mem
  have h_block : eU * g' * eLw = BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p := by
    have hSchur :=
      @upper_mul_mul_lower_eq_blockDiagonal_schur α (Fin 1) _ _ _ _ R _ g' hInvD
    simpa [s, p, eU, eLw] using hSchur
  have h_eL_g_eR : eL * g * eR = BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p := by
    have h_assoc : eL * g * eR = eU * g' * eLw := by
      simp [eL, g', eR, mul_assoc]
    rw [h_assoc, h_block]
  have h_det_eL : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det eL = 1 :=
    det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup heL_mem
  have h_det_eR : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det eR = 1 :=
    det_of_mem_elementarySubgroup heR_mem
  have h_det_block :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p) =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det s * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det p :=
    BlockElementary.det_blockDiagonal s p
  have h_det_eq :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det s *
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det p =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g := by
    calc
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det s *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det p
        = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
            (BlockElementary.blockDiagonal s p) := h_det_block.symm
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (eL * g * eR) := by
          rw [h_eL_g_eR]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det eL *
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g *
              Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det eR := by
          simp [map_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det g := by
          rw [h_det_eL, h_det_eR, one_mul, mul_one]
  exact ⟨eL, eR, s, p, heL_mem, heR_mem, h_eL_g_eR, h_det_eq⟩

end LocalFinOne

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementarySubgroup
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.LocalRing.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basis

/-!
# Local-ring column pivot and elementary row operation

For a commutative local ring `R` and finite nonempty index type `n`,
every column of an invertible matrix `GL n R` contains a unit entry.
If the diagonal entry is not a unit, a single elementary transvection
adding a unit-entry row to the diagonal row makes the `(j,j)` entry a unit.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix
open Finset

variable {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]

/-- Every column of `GL n R` over a commutative local ring contains a unit entry.

Uses `(j,j)` entry of `g⁻¹ * g = 1`, `Matrix.mul_apply`, `IsLocalRing.exists_of_isUnit_sum`
and `IsUnit.mul_iff` via `isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right`. -/
theorem exists_isUnit_entry_in_column [Nonempty n] (g : GL n R) (j : n) :
    ∃ i, IsUnit ((↑g : Matrix n n R) i j) := by
  classical
  have h_mul : (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) = 1 := by
    have h_inv : (g⁻¹ * g : GL n R) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel g
    have h_val_mul : (↑(g⁻¹ * g) : Matrix n n R) =
        (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) := rfl
    have h_one_val : (↑(1 : GL n R) : Matrix n n R) = (1 : Matrix n n R) := rfl
    calc (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R)
        = (↑(g⁻¹ * g) : Matrix n n R) := h_val_mul.symm
      _ = (↑(1 : GL n R) : Matrix n n R) := by rw [h_inv]
      _ = (1 : Matrix n n R) := h_one_val
  have h_jj : ((↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R)) j j = (1 : R) := by
    rw [h_mul, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  have h_sum_eq :
      (∑ i : n, (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) j i * (↑g : Matrix n n R) i j) = (1 : R) := by
    have h_apply := Matrix.mul_apply (M := (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R))
        (N := (↑g : Matrix n n R)) (i := j) (k := j)
    rw [h_apply] at h_jj
    exact h_jj
  have h_isUnit_sum :
      IsUnit (∑ i : n, (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) j i * (↑g : Matrix n n R) i j) := by
    rw [h_sum_eq]
    exact isUnit_one
  have h_isUnit_univ :
      IsUnit (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset n),
        (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) j i * (↑g : Matrix n n R) i j) := by
    simpa using h_isUnit_sum
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := IsLocalRing.exists_of_isUnit_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun i => (↑g⁻¹ : Matrix n n R) j i * (↑g : Matrix n n R) i j) h_isUnit_univ
  exact ⟨i, isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hi⟩

/-- Make the `(j,j)` entry unit by left-multiplying with an element of the
elementary subgroup: if the diagonal is already a unit use `1`, otherwise add a
row containing a unit entry with a single elementary matrix. -/
theorem exists_elementary_mul_isUnit_entry [Nonempty n] (g : GL n R) (j : n) :
    ∃ e, e ∈ elementarySubgroup n R ∧
      IsUnit ((↑(e * g) : Matrix n n R) j j) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_isUnit_entry_in_column g j
  by_cases h_diag : IsUnit ((↑g : Matrix n n R) j j)
  · refine ⟨1, Subgroup.one_mem _, ?_⟩
    have h_one_mul : (1 * g : GL n R) = g := one_mul g
    have h_coe : (↑(1 * g) : Matrix n n R) j j = (↑g : Matrix n n R) j j := by
      rw [h_one_mul]
    rw [h_coe]
    exact h_diag
  · have h_not_diag : ¬ IsUnit ((↑g : Matrix n n R) j j) := h_diag
    have h_neq : i₀ ≠ j := by
      intro h_eq
      subst h_eq
      exact h_not_diag hi₀
    have h_ji : j ≠ i₀ := Ne.symm h_neq
    let e : GL n R := elementary j i₀ h_ji (1 : R)
    have he_mem : e ∈ elementarySubgroup n R :=
      elementary_mem_elementarySubgroup j i₀ h_ji (1 : R)
    refine ⟨e, he_mem, ?_⟩
    have h_e_val : (↑e : Matrix n n R) = 1 + Matrix.single j i₀ (1 : R) := rfl
    have h_mul_val : (↑(e * g) : Matrix n n R) =
        (↑e : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) := rfl
    have h_add_mul : (↑e : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) =
        (↑g : Matrix n n R) + Matrix.single j i₀ (1 : R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R) := by
      rw [h_e_val, add_mul, one_mul]
    have h_entry :
        (↑(e * g) : Matrix n n R) j j =
          (↑g : Matrix n n R) j j + (↑g : Matrix n n R) i₀ j := by
      calc (↑(e * g) : Matrix n n R) j j
          = ((↑e : Matrix n n R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R)) j j := by
            rw [h_mul_val]
        _ = ((↑g : Matrix n n R) +
            Matrix.single j i₀ (1 : R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R)) j j := by
            rw [h_add_mul]
        _ = (↑g : Matrix n n R) j j +
            (Matrix.single j i₀ (1 : R) * (↑g : Matrix n n R)) j j := by
            rw [Matrix.add_apply]
        _ = (↑g : Matrix n n R) j j + (↑g : Matrix n n R) i₀ j := by
          have h_single : (Matrix.single j i₀ (1 : R) *
              (↑g : Matrix n n R)) j j = (↑g : Matrix n n R) i₀ j := by
            have hs := Matrix.single_mul_apply_same (i := j) (j := i₀) (b := j)
              (c := (1 : R)) (M := (↑g : Matrix n n R))
            simp [hs]
          rw [h_single]
    have h_sum_unit : IsUnit ((↑g : Matrix n n R) j j + (↑g : Matrix n n R) i₀ j) := by
      set a := (↑g : Matrix n n R) j j
      set b := (↑g : Matrix n n R) i₀ j
      have hb : IsUnit b := hi₀
      have ha_not : ¬ IsUnit a := h_not_diag
      by_contra h_not_sum
      have h_sum_nonunit : a + b ∈ nonunits R := by
        rw [mem_nonunits_iff]
        exact h_not_sum
      have ha_nonunit : a ∈ nonunits R := by
        rw [mem_nonunits_iff]
        exact ha_not
      have h_neg_a_nonunit : (-a) ∈ nonunits R := by
        rw [mem_nonunits_iff, IsUnit.neg_iff]
        exact ha_not
      have hb_eq : b = (a + b) + (-a) := by abel
      have hb_nonunit : b ∈ nonunits R := by
        rw [hb_eq]
        exact IsLocalRing.nonunits_add h_sum_nonunit h_neg_a_nonunit
      exact (mem_nonunits_iff.mp hb_nonunit) hb
    rw [h_entry]
    exact h_sum_unit

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

Author: @toskua, Avocado

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization

/-!
# Finite matrix composition for `GL`

This module provides the multiplicative equivalence
`GL α (Matrix ι ι R) ≃* GL (α × ι) R` induced by `Matrix.compRingEquiv`,
oriented from general linear groups over matrix rings to flattened matrices,
with transparent coefficient lemmas and compatibility with reindexing of the
outer index and with `blockDiagonalOne` up to `Equiv.sumProdDistrib`.

This is the finite-stage packet for classical `K₁` matrix invariance; no
`Fin` cardinal arithmetic or stable-`GL` cofinality is included here.

## Main definitions

* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.compMulEquiv` – equivalence from general linear groups
  over matrix rings to flattened matrices induced by `Matrix.compRingEquiv`.

## Main results

* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_compMulEquiv` – underlying matrix of the
  equivalence from GL over matrix rings to flattened matrices is `Matrix.comp`.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_compMulEquiv_symm` – underlying matrix of the
  inverse equivalence from flattened matrices to GL over matrix rings is
  `Matrix.comp.symm`.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_compMulEquiv` – compatibility
  with reindexing of the outer finite index, preserving orientation from GL over
  matrix rings to flattened matrices.
* `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.reindexMulEquiv_sumProdDistrib_blockDiagonalOne_compMulEquiv` –
  compatibility with `blockDiagonalOne` up to `Equiv.sumProdDistrib`, respecting
  orientation from GL over matrix rings to flattened matrices.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup

universe u v w u₁

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type u₁} {ι : Type v} {R : Type w}
variable [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
  [Fintype ι] [Semiring R]

/-- Multiplicative equivalence from general linear groups over matrix rings to
flattened matrices: `GL α (Matrix ι ι R) ≃* GL (α × ι) R` induced by
`Matrix.compRingEquiv`. -/
def compMulEquiv (α : Type u) (ι : Type v) (R : Type w) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype α] [Fintype ι] [Semiring R] :
    GL α (Matrix ι ι R) ≃* GL (α × ι) R :=
  Units.mapEquiv (Matrix.compRingEquiv α ι R).toMulEquiv

/-- Underlying matrix of `compMulEquiv` oriented from general linear groups over
matrix rings to flattened matrices is `Matrix.comp`. -/
@[simp]
lemma coe_compMulEquiv (g : GL α (Matrix ι ι R)) :
    (↑(compMulEquiv α ι R g) : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) =
      Matrix.comp α α ι ι R (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) :=
  rfl

/-- Underlying matrix of `compMulEquiv.symm` oriented from flattened matrices to
general linear groups over matrix rings is `Matrix.comp.symm`. -/
@[simp]
lemma coe_compMulEquiv_symm (g : GL (α × ι) R) :
    (↑((compMulEquiv α ι R).symm g) : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) =
      (Matrix.comp α α ι ι R).symm (↑g : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) :=
  rfl

/-- Compatibility of reindexing with `compMulEquiv` oriented from GL over matrix rings
to flattened matrices: reindexing the outer index commutes with flattening. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_compMulEquiv_apply {α' : Type u₁} [DecidableEq α'] [Fintype α']
    (e : α ≃ α') (g : GL α (Matrix ι ι R)) :
    reindexMulEquiv (e.prodCongr (Equiv.refl ι)) (compMulEquiv α ι R g) =
      compMulEquiv α' ι R (reindexMulEquiv e g) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_compMulEquiv]
  ext ⟨b, k⟩ ⟨b', k'⟩
  rfl

/-- Bundled compatibility of reindexing with `compMulEquiv` oriented from GL over
matrix rings to flattened matrices. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_compMulEquiv {α' : Type u₁} [DecidableEq α'] [Fintype α']
    (e : α ≃ α') :
    (reindexMulEquiv (e.prodCongr (Equiv.refl ι))).toMonoidHom.comp
        (compMulEquiv α ι R).toMonoidHom =
      (compMulEquiv α' ι R).toMonoidHom.comp (reindexMulEquiv e).toMonoidHom := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  exact reindexMulEquiv_compMulEquiv_apply e g

/-- Compatibility of `blockDiagonalOne` with `compMulEquiv` oriented from GL over matrix
rings to flattened matrices, up to `Equiv.sumProdDistrib`: flattening a block-diagonal
embedding equals the block-diagonal embedding after flattening. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_sumProdDistrib_blockDiagonalOne_compMulEquiv_apply
    (g : GL α (Matrix ι ι R)) :
    reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι)
        (compMulEquiv (α ⊕ β) ι R (blockDiagonalOne α β (Matrix ι ι R) g)) =
      blockDiagonalOne (α × ι) (β × ι) R (compMulEquiv α ι R g) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_compMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalOne]
  ext p q
  rcases p with ⟨a, k⟩ | ⟨b, k⟩ <;> rcases q with ⟨a', k'⟩ | ⟨b', k'⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have h_comp :
        Matrix.comp (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ι ι R
            (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr b, k) (Sum.inr b', k') =
          (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr b) (Sum.inr b') k k' := rfl
    have h_reindex :
        Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι) (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι)
            (Matrix.comp (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ι ι R
              (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1))
            (Sum.inr (b, k)) (Sum.inr (b', k')) =
          Matrix.comp (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ι ι R
            (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr b, k) (Sum.inr b', k') := by
      dsimp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
      simp only [Equiv.sumProdDistrib_symm_apply_right]
    calc Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι) (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι)
            (Matrix.comp (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ι ι R
              (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1))
            (Sum.inr (b, k)) (Sum.inr (b', k')) =
          Matrix.comp (α ⊕ β) (α ⊕ β) ι ι R
            (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr b, k) (Sum.inr b', k') := h_reindex
      _ = (fromBlocks (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R)) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr b) (Sum.inr b') k k' := h_comp
      _ = (fromBlocks (Matrix.comp α α ι ι R (↑g : Matrix α α (Matrix ι ι R))) 0 0 1)
            (Sum.inr (b, k)) (Sum.inr (b', k')) := by
          simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.one_apply]
          by_cases hb : b = b'
          · subst hb
            by_cases hk : k = k'
            · subst hk
              simp
            · simp [hk]
          · simp [hb]

/-- Bundled compatibility of `blockDiagonalOne` with `compMulEquiv` oriented from GL
over matrix rings to flattened matrices, up to `Equiv.sumProdDistrib`. -/
theorem reindexMulEquiv_sumProdDistrib_blockDiagonalOne_compMulEquiv :
    (reindexMulEquiv (Equiv.sumProdDistrib α β ι)).toMonoidHom.comp
        ((compMulEquiv (α ⊕ β) ι R).toMonoidHom.comp
          (blockDiagonalOne α β (Matrix ι ι R))) =
      (blockDiagonalOne (α × ι) (β × ι) R).comp (compMulEquiv α ι R).toMonoidHom := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  exact reindexMulEquiv_sumProdDistrib_blockDiagonalOne_compMulEquiv_apply g

end GeneralLinearGroup

/-- Deprecated alias kept for downstream users of the previous
`Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.permMatrix_entry_eq` API. -/
@[deprecated "Use `Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq` instead." (since := "2026-10-11")]
theorem permMatrix_entry_eq (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι) :
    (σ.permMatrix R : Matrix ι ι R) i j = if σ i = j then 1 else 0 :=
  _root_.Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq σ i j

theorem diag_mul_perm_eq (d : ι → R) (τ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι)
    [Fintype ι] :
    (Matrix.diagonal d * τ.permMatrix R) i j = if τ i = j then d i else 0 := by
  calc (Matrix.diagonal d * τ.permMatrix R) i j
      = d i * (τ.permMatrix R) i j := by rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
    _ = d i * (if τ i = j then (1 : R) else 0) := by
      rw [_root_.Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq]
    _ = if τ i = j then d i else 0 := by
          by_cases h : τ i = j <;> simp [h]

theorem perm_mul_diag_eq (τ : Equiv.Perm ι) (d : ι → R) (i j : ι)
    [Fintype ι] :
    (τ.permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d) i j = if τ i = j then d j else 0 := by
  calc (τ.permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d) i j
      = (τ.permMatrix R) i j * d j := by rw [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
    _ = (if τ i = j then (1 : R) else 0) * d j := by
      rw [_root_.Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq]
    _ = if τ i = j then d j else 0 := by
          by_cases h : τ i = j <;> simp [h]

theorem perm_diag_mul_perm_eq (d : ι → R) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι)
    [Fintype ι] :
    ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d * σ.permMatrix R) i j =
      if i = j then d (σ⁻¹ i) else 0 := by
  classical
  have h_mul : ∀ k : ι,
      (((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d) i k) *
        ((σ.permMatrix R) k j) =
        (if σ⁻¹ i = k then d k else 0) * (if σ k = j then (1 : R) else 0) := by
    intro k
    have h1 : ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d) i k =
        if σ⁻¹ i = k then d k else 0 := perm_mul_diag_eq _ _ _ _
    have h2 : (σ.permMatrix R) k j = if σ k = j then (1 : R) else 0 :=
      _root_.Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq _ _ _
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h_eq : ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d * σ.permMatrix R) i j =
      ∑ k : ι, (if σ⁻¹ i = k then d k else 0) * (if σ k = j then (1 : R) else 0) := by
    calc ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d * σ.permMatrix R) i j
        = ∑ k : ι, (((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal d) i k) *
          ((σ.permMatrix R) k j) := by
            simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
      _ = _ := by
          apply Fintype.sum_congr
          intro k
          rw [h_mul k]
  rw [h_eq]
  have hs : σ (σ⁻¹ i) = i := Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i
  have h1 : ∀ b : ι, b ≠ σ⁻¹ i →
      (if σ⁻¹ i = b then d b else (0 : R)) * (if σ b = j then (1 : R) else 0) = 0 := by
    intro b hb
    rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hb), zero_mul]
  calc (∑ k : ι, (if σ⁻¹ i = k then d k else 0) * (if σ k = j then (1 : R) else 0))
      = (if σ⁻¹ i = σ⁻¹ i then d (σ⁻¹ i) else 0) *
          (if σ (σ⁻¹ i) = j then 1 else 0) := by
          rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single (σ⁻¹ i) h1]
    _ = if σ (σ⁻¹ i) = j then d (σ⁻¹ i) else 0 := by simp
    _ = if i = j then d (σ⁻¹ i) else 0 := by
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · simp [hij]

end Helpers

/-- Send a tuple of units to its diagonal matrix in the general linear group. -/
def diagonalUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : (ι → Rˣ) →* GL ι R :=
  (Units.map (Matrix.diagonalRingHom (n := ι) (α := R)).toMonoidHom).comp
    (MulEquiv.piUnits.symm.toMonoidHom)

@[simp]
theorem coe_diagonalUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (u : ι → Rˣ) :
    (↑(diagonalUnitsHom R ι u) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (u i : R)) :=
  rfl

/-- Embed permutations in the general linear group using inverse permutation matrices. -/
def permutationUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : Equiv.Perm ι →* GL ι R :=
  (Matrix.permMatrixHom (R := R) (n := ι)).toHomUnits

@[simp]
theorem coe_permutationUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    (↑(permutationUnitsHom R ι σ) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (σ⁻¹).permMatrix R :=
  rfl

theorem coe_permutationUnitsHom_GL_inv (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    (↑((permutationUnitsHom R ι σ)⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      σ.permMatrix R := by
  have h : (permutationUnitsHom R ι σ)⁻¹ =
      permutationUnitsHom R ι σ⁻¹ :=
    (map_inv (permutationUnitsHom R ι) σ).symm
  calc (↑((permutationUnitsHom R ι σ)⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R)
      = (↑(permutationUnitsHom R ι σ⁻¹) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [h]
    _ = (σ⁻¹)⁻¹.permMatrix R := rfl
    _ = σ.permMatrix R := by simp [inv_inv]

theorem diagonalUnitsHom_permute (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) (u : ι → Rˣ) :
    diagonalUnitsHom R ι (permute σ u) =
      permutationUnitsHom R ι σ * diagonalUnitsHom R ι u *
        (permutationUnitsHom R ι σ)⁻¹ := by
  apply Units.ext
  have h_left : ((diagonalUnitsHom R ι (permute σ u)).val : Matrix ι ι R) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (permute σ u k : Rˣ).val) := by
    simp [coe_diagonalUnitsHom]
  have h_right : ((permutationUnitsHom R ι σ * diagonalUnitsHom R ι u *
      (permutationUnitsHom R ι σ)⁻¹).val : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (σ⁻¹).permMatrix R * Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (u k : Rˣ).val) *
        σ.permMatrix R := by
    simp [coe_diagonalUnitsHom, coe_permutationUnitsHom,
      coe_permutationUnitsHom_GL_inv]
  rw [h_left, h_right]
  ext i j
  simp [permute_apply, perm_diag_mul_perm_eq, Matrix.diagonal_apply]

/-- Realize monomial data as a diagonal unit matrix times an inverse permutation matrix. -/
def monomialMatrixHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : MonomialBase Rˣ ι →* GL ι R :=
  SemidirectProduct.lift
    (diagonalUnitsHom R ι)
    (permutationUnitsHom R ι)
    (by
      intro σ
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro u
      simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MulAut.conj_apply, tupleActionHom_apply,
        MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom]
      exact diagonalUnitsHom_permute R ι σ u)

@[simp]
theorem monomialMatrixHom_mk (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (u : ι → Rˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩ =
      diagonalUnitsHom R ι u * permutationUnitsHom R ι σ :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem coe_monomialMatrixHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι x) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (↑(diagonalUnitsHom R ι x.left) : Matrix ι ι R) *
        (↑(permutationUnitsHom R ι x.right) : Matrix ι ι R) := by
  cases x with
  | mk l r => rfl

theorem coe_monomialMatrixHom_mk (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (u : ι → Rˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (u i : R)) * (σ⁻¹).permMatrix R := by
  simp

section CoeffNaturality

variable {R : Type uR} {S : Type vR} [Semiring R] [Semiring S]
variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]

omit [Fintype ι] in
theorem permMatrix_map (f : R →+* S) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    (σ.permMatrix R).map f = σ.permMatrix S := by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, _root_.Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq]
  by_cases h : σ i = j <;> simp [h]

theorem permutationUnitsHom_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (permutationUnitsHom R ι σ) =
      permutationUnitsHom S ι σ := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_permutationUnitsHom, coe_mapRingHom]
  exact permMatrix_map f σ⁻¹

theorem diagonalUnitsHom_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) (u : ι → Rˣ) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (diagonalUnitsHom R ι u) =
      diagonalUnitsHom S ι (fun i => Units.map f (u i)) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_diagonalUnitsHom, coe_mapRingHom, Matrix.diagonal_map, Units.coe_map]

theorem monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom (f : R →+* S) :
    (mapRingHom (n := ι) f).comp (monomialMatrixHom R ι) =
      (monomialMatrixHom S ι).comp (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f)) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  cases x with
  | mk u σ =>
    calc mapRingHom _ (monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩)
        = mapRingHom _ (diagonalUnitsHom R ι u * permutationUnitsHom R ι σ) := rfl
      _ = _ * _ := by rw [map_mul]
      _ = diagonalUnitsHom S ι (fun i => Units.map f (u i)) *
          permutationUnitsHom S ι σ := by
          rw [diagonalUnitsHom_mapRingHom, permutationUnitsHom_mapRingHom]
      _ = _ := rfl

theorem monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply (f : R →+* S)
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (monomialMatrixHom R ι x) =
      monomialMatrixHom S ι (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f) x) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom (f := f)) x

end CoeffNaturality

/-- The determinant homomorphism on monomial data over a commutative ring. -/
def monomialDetHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : MonomialBase Rˣ ι →* Rˣ :=
  (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (n := ι)).comp (monomialMatrixHom R ι)

theorem det_diagonalUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (u : ι → Rˣ) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (diagonalUnitsHom R ι u) =
      Finset.univ.prod (fun i => u i) := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_diagonalUnitsHom, Matrix.det_diagonal]

theorem det_permutationUnitsHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (permutationUnitsHom R ι σ) =
      Units.map (Int.castRingHom R) (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) := by
  apply Units.ext
  change ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R).det =
    (Units.map (Int.castRingHom R) (Equiv.Perm.sign σ)).val
  calc ((σ⁻¹).permMatrix R).det
      = (Equiv.Perm.sign (σ⁻¹) : R) := Matrix.det_permutation _
    _ = (Equiv.Perm.sign σ : R) := by rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_inv]
    _ = (Units.map (Int.castRingHom R) (Equiv.Perm.sign σ)).val := by
        simp [Units.coe_map]

theorem monomialDetHom_mk (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (u : ι → Rˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    monomialDetHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩ =
      (Finset.univ.prod (fun i => u i)) *
        Units.map (Int.castRingHom R) (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) := by
  calc monomialDetHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩
      = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
          (diagonalUnitsHom R ι u * permutationUnitsHom R ι σ) := rfl
    _ = _ := by rw [map_mul, det_diagonalUnitsHom, det_permutationUnitsHom]

theorem monomialDetHom_coe (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) :
    (monomialDetHom R ι x : R) =
      (Finset.univ.prod (fun i => (x.left i : R))) *
        (Equiv.Perm.sign x.right : R) := by
  cases x with
  | mk u σ =>
    calc (monomialDetHom R ι ⟨u, σ⟩ : R)
        = ((Finset.univ.prod (fun i => u i)) *
          Units.map (Int.castRingHom R) (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) : Rˣ) := by
            rw [monomialDetHom_mk]
      _ = _ := by simp [Units.val_mul, Units.coe_map]

/-- The subgroup of monomial data with determinant one. -/
abbrev MonomialSL (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] := (monomialDetHom R ι).ker

/-- The inclusion of the determinant kernel into the full monomial data group. -/
def monomialSLToMonomialBase (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : MonomialSL R ι →* MonomialBase Rˣ ι :=
  Subgroup.subtype _

/-- Realize monomial data with determinant one as a special linear matrix. -/
def monomialSLHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] : MonomialSL R ι →* Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R where
  toFun x :=
    ⟨(monomialMatrixHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)).val,
      by
        have hdet : monomialDetHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) = 1 := x.prop
        have h1 :
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
              (monomialMatrixHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)) = 1 := hdet
        have : (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
            (monomialMatrixHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)) : Rˣ).val = 1 := by
          rw [h1]
          rfl
        exact this⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  map_mul' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (monomialMatrixHom R ι ((x * y : MonomialSL R ι).1)).val =
      (monomialMatrixHom R ι x.1).val * (monomialMatrixHom R ι y.1).val
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul]
    have h_mul :
        monomialMatrixHom R ι (x.1 * y.1) =
          monomialMatrixHom R ι x.1 * monomialMatrixHom R ι y.1 :=
      map_mul (monomialMatrixHom R ι) x.1 y.1
    exact congrArg Units.val h_mul

@[simp]
theorem coe_monomialSLHom (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (x : MonomialSL R ι) :
    (↑(monomialSLHom R ι x) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)) : Matrix ι ι R) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem monomialSLHom_toGL (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (x : MonomialSL R ι) :
    (monomialSLHom R ι x : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι R) =
      monomialMatrixHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) := by
  apply Units.ext
  rfl

variable {R : Type uR} {S : Type vR} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]

theorem monomialDetHom_mapRingHom {R : Type uR} {S : Type vR} {ι : Type uι}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
    (f : R →+* S) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) :
    Units.map f (monomialDetHom R ι x) =
      monomialDetHom S ι (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f) x) := by
  apply Units.ext
  have h1 : (monomialDetHom R ι x : R) =
      (monomialMatrixHom R ι x).val.det := by
    simp [monomialDetHom, GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]
  have h2 : (monomialDetHom S ι (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x) : S) =
      (monomialMatrixHom S ι (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)).val.det := by
    simp [monomialDetHom, GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]
  calc (Units.map f (monomialDetHom R ι x)).val
      = f (monomialDetHom R ι x : R) := by simp [Units.coe_map]
    _ = f ((monomialMatrixHom R ι x).val.det) := by rw [h1]
    _ = (f.mapMatrix (monomialMatrixHom R ι x).val).det := by
        rw [RingHom.map_det]
    _ = (((monomialMatrixHom R ι x).val).map f).det := rfl
    _ = ((mapRingHom (n := ι) f (monomialMatrixHom R ι x)).val.det) := by
        rw [← coe_mapRingHom]
    _ = ((monomialMatrixHom S ι
          (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)).val.det) := by
        rw [monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply]
    _ = (monomialDetHom S ι (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)).val := by
        rw [h2]

/-- Map monomial data with determinant one along a coefficient ring homomorphism,
keeping the permutation unchanged. -/
def monomialSLMap (R : Type uR) (S : Type vR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (f : R →+* S) :
    MonomialSL R ι →* MonomialSL S ι where
  toFun x :=
    ⟨monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι),
      by
        calc monomialDetHom S ι
              (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι))
            = Units.map f (monomialDetHom R ι (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)) := by
                rw [← monomialDetHom_mapRingHom]
          _ = 1 := by rw [x.prop, map_one]⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [monomialBaseHom, mapTuple_one]
  map_mul' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp

@[simp]
theorem coe_monomialSLMap (R : Type uR) (S : Type vR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (f : R →+* S) (x : MonomialSL R ι) :
    (↑(monomialSLMap R S ι f x) : MonomialBase Sˣ ι) =
      monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) :=
  rfl

theorem monomialSLMap_id (R : Type uR) (ι : Type uι) [CommRing R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] :
    monomialSLMap R R ι (RingHom.id R) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hid : monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (MonoidHom.id (Rˣ)) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) =
      (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) := by
    have h := monomialBaseHom_id (A := Rˣ) (ι := ι)
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)
  have hmap : Units.map (RingHom.id R : R →+* R) = MonoidHom.id (Rˣ) := rfl
  calc monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map (RingHom.id R)) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)
      = monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (MonoidHom.id (Rˣ)) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) := by
          rw [hmap]
    _ = _ := hid

theorem monomialSLMap_comp (R : Type uR) (S : Type vR) (T : Type wR) (ι : Type uι)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) :
    monomialSLMap R T ι (g.comp f) =
      (monomialSLMap S T ι g).comp (monomialSLMap R S ι f) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, coe_monomialSLMap]
  have h_units : Units.map (g.comp f).toMonoidHom =
      (Units.map g.toMonoidHom).comp (Units.map f.toMonoidHom) := by
    calc Units.map (g.comp f).toMonoidHom
        = Units.map (g.toMonoidHom.comp f.toMonoidHom) := rfl
      _ = (Units.map g.toMonoidHom).comp (Units.map f.toMonoidHom) :=
          Units.map_comp f.toMonoidHom g.toMonoidHom
  change monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map (g.comp f).toMonoidHom)
      (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι) =
    ((monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map g.toMonoidHom)).comp
      (monomialBaseHom (ι := ι) (Units.map f.toMonoidHom))) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ ι)
  rw [h_units, monomialBaseHom_comp]

/-- Conjugation by the actual permutation unit is the original reindexing
of both matrix indices, over arbitrary semirings. This is a whole matrix
formula, using the existing partial-equivalence multiplication laws. -/
theorem permutationUnitsHom_conjugate
    (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] (Index : Type uι)
    [DecidableEq Index] [Fintype Index] (σ : Equiv.Perm Index)
    (g : GL Index R) :
    permutationUnitsHom R Index σ * g * (permutationUnitsHom R Index σ)⁻¹ =
      reindexMulEquiv σ g := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [Units.val_mul, coe_permutationUnitsHom,
    coe_permutationUnitsHom_GL_inv, coe_reindexMulEquiv]
  change (σ⁻¹).toPEquiv.toMatrix * (↑g : Matrix Index Index R) *
      σ.toPEquiv.toMatrix = Matrix.reindex σ σ (↑g : Matrix Index Index R)
  rw [PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_mul, PEquiv.mul_toMatrix_toPEquiv]
  rfl

/-- Reindexing the actual permutation unit is the permutation unit of the
same conjugated index permutation, across independent index universes. -/
theorem permutationUnitsHom_reindex
    (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] {Index₁ : Type uι} {Index₂ : Type vR}
    [DecidableEq Index₁] [DecidableEq Index₂] [Fintype Index₁] [Fintype Index₂]
    (e : Index₁ ≃ Index₂) (σ : Equiv.Perm Index₁) :
    reindexMulEquiv e (permutationUnitsHom R Index₁ σ) =
      permutationUnitsHom R Index₂ (e.permCongr σ) := by
  have hinv : (e.permCongr σ)⁻¹ = e.permCongr σ⁻¹ :=
    (map_inv e.permCongrHom σ).symm
  apply Units.ext
  rw [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_permutationUnitsHom, coe_permutationUnitsHom, hinv]
  ext i j
  dsimp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rw [Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq,
    Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq, Equiv.permCongr_apply]
  have he : e (σ⁻¹ (e.symm i)) = j ↔ σ⁻¹ (e.symm i) = e.symm j := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hh := congrArg e.symm h
      simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using hh
    · intro h
      exact (congrArg e h).trans (e.apply_symm_apply j)
  exact if_congr he.symm rfl rfl

/-- The permutation unit of a sum permutation is the original finite
two-block diagonal of both permutation units. -/
theorem permutationUnitsHom_sumCongr
    (R : Type uR) [Semiring R] (Index₁ : Type uι) (Index₂ : Type vR)
    [DecidableEq Index₁] [DecidableEq Index₂] [Fintype Index₁] [Fintype Index₂]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm Index₁) (τ : Equiv.Perm Index₂) :
    permutationUnitsHom R (Index₁ ⊕ Index₂) (Equiv.sumCongr σ τ) =
      blockDiagonalHom Index₁ Index₂ R
        (permutationUnitsHom R Index₁ σ, permutationUnitsHom R Index₂ τ) := by
  apply Units.ext
  rw [coe_permutationUnitsHom, coe_blockDiagonalHom,
    coe_permutationUnitsHom, coe_permutationUnitsHom]
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [Matrix.permMatrix_entry_eq, Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.sumCongr_symm]

end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix

universe uActive vInactive uCoeff

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-- Reindexing by an original permutation fixing every active index
leaves the entire active matrix block unchanged. The inactive block is
the actual identity, not a supplied centralizer witness. -/
public theorem reindex_blockDiagonalOne_of_fixed_left
    {Active : Type uActive} {Inactive : Type vInactive}
    [DecidableEq Active] [DecidableEq Inactive] [Fintype Active] [Fintype Inactive]
    (R : Type uCoeff) [Semiring R] (σ : Equiv.Perm (Active ⊕ Inactive))
    (hfix : ∀ i : Active, σ (Sum.inl i) = Sum.inl i)
    (g : GL Active R) :
    reindexMulEquiv σ (blockDiagonalOne Active Inactive R g) =
      blockDiagonalOne Active Inactive R g := by
  have hleft (i : Active) : σ.symm (Sum.inl i) = Sum.inl i :=
    (congrArg σ.symm (hfix i)).symm.trans (σ.symm_apply_apply (Sum.inl i))
  have hright (i : Inactive) : ∃ j : Inactive, σ.symm (Sum.inr i) = Sum.inr j := by
    have hpreimage :
        ∀ q : Active ⊕ Inactive, σ q = Sum.inr i →
          ∃ j : Inactive, q = Sum.inr j := by
      intro q hq
      rcases q with a | b
      · have he : Sum.inl a = Sum.inr i :=
          (hfix a).symm.trans hq
        cases he
      · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact hpreimage (σ.symm (Sum.inr i))
      (σ.apply_symm_apply (Sum.inr i))
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_reindexMulEquiv, coe_blockDiagonalOne]
  ext i j
  dsimp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · rw [hleft i, hleft j]
  · obtain ⟨j', hj⟩ := hright j
    rw [hleft i, hj]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨i', hi⟩ := hright i
    rw [hi, hleft j]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨i', hi⟩ := hright i
    obtain ⟨j', hj⟩ := hright j
    rw [hi, hj]
    simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.one_apply]
    have he : i' = j' ↔ i = j := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact Sum.inr.inj (σ.symm.injective
          (hi.trans ((congrArg Sum.inr h).trans hj.symm)))
      · intro h
        cases h
        exact Sum.inr.inj (hi.symm.trans hj)
    exact if_congr he rfl rfl

/-- The actual permutation unit fixing the whole active block commutes
with every original active general-linear matrix. This is a full matrix
family equation over every semiring, not elementary-subgroup membership
or pointwise homotopy information. -/
public theorem commute_blockDiagonalOne_permutation_of_fixed_left
    {Active : Type uActive} {Inactive : Type vInactive}
    [DecidableEq Active] [DecidableEq Inactive] [Fintype Active] [Fintype Inactive]
    (R : Type uCoeff) [Semiring R] (σ : Equiv.Perm (Active ⊕ Inactive))
    (hfix : ∀ i : Active, σ (Sum.inl i) = Sum.inl i)
    (g : GL Active R) :
    Commute (blockDiagonalOne Active Inactive R g)
      (permutationUnitsHom R (Active ⊕ Inactive) σ) := by
  let q := permutationUnitsHom R (Active ⊕ Inactive) σ
  let b := blockDiagonalOne Active Inactive R g
  have hc : q * b * q⁻¹ = b :=
    (permutationUnitsHom_conjugate R (Active ⊕ Inactive) σ b).trans
      (reindex_blockDiagonalOne_of_fixed_left R σ hfix g)
  have h := congrArg (fun z : GL (Active ⊕ Inactive) R => z * q) hc
  have he : q * b = b * q := by
    simpa only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using h
  exact he.symm

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.IsolatedCoordinate

open PermutationBilinearCocycle

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

universe uι uA uB uR vR

section PermutationLayer

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] (c : ι)

/-- Extend a permutation of `DeletedIndex ι c` to a permutation of `ι` fixing `c`. -/
def extendPerm (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) : Equiv.Perm ι where
  toFun i := if h : i = c then c else (σ ⟨i, h⟩).val
  invFun i := if h : i = c then c else (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, h⟩).val
  left_inv := by
    intro i
    by_cases hc : i = c
    · subst hc
      simp
    · have hi : i ≠ c := hc
      have h_toFun : (if h : i = c then c else (σ ⟨i, h⟩).val) = (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
        simp [dite_eq_right hc]
      have hk_ne : (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val ≠ c := (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).property
      have h_eq : (⟨(σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, hk_ne⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) = σ ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext; rfl
      calc (if h : (if h : i = c then c else (σ ⟨i, h⟩).val) = c then c else
            (σ⁻¹ ⟨(if h : i = c then c else (σ ⟨i, h⟩).val), h⟩).val)
          = (if h : (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val = c then c else (σ⁻¹ ⟨(σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, h⟩).val) := by
            rw [h_toFun]
        _ = (σ⁻¹ ⟨(σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, hk_ne⟩).val := by rw [dite_eq_right hk_ne]
        _ = (σ⁻¹ (σ ⟨i, hi⟩)).val := by rw [h_eq]
        _ = i := by simp
  right_inv := by
    intro i
    by_cases hc : i = c
    · subst hc
      simp
    · have hi : i ≠ c := hc
      have h_toInv : (if h : i = c then c else (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, h⟩).val) = (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
        simp [dite_eq_right hc]
      have hk_ne : (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val ≠ c := (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).property
      have h_eq : (⟨(σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, hk_ne⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) = σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext; rfl
      calc (if h : (if h : i = c then c else (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, h⟩).val) = c then c else
            (σ ⟨(if h : i = c then c else (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, h⟩).val), h⟩).val)
          = (if h : (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val = c then c else
            (σ ⟨(σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, h⟩).val) := by rw [h_toInv]
        _ = (σ ⟨(σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, hk_ne⟩).val := by rw [dite_eq_right hk_ne]
        _ = (σ (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩)).val := by rw [h_eq]
        _ = i := by simp

@[simp]
theorem extendPerm_apply_c (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    extendPerm c σ c = c := by
  simp [extendPerm]

theorem extendPerm_apply_of_ne {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    extendPerm c σ i = (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
  simp [extendPerm, dite_eq_right hi]

theorem extendPerm_apply_eq_c_iff (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) (i : ι) :
    extendPerm c σ i = c ↔ i = c := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    have hi : i ≠ c := hne
    rw [extendPerm_apply_of_ne c hi σ] at h
    exact (σ ⟨i, hi⟩).property h
  · intro h
    rw [h, extendPerm_apply_c]

theorem extendPerm_apply_ne_of_ne {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    extendPerm c σ i ≠ c := by
  rw [Ne, extendPerm_apply_eq_c_iff]
  exact hi

@[simp]
theorem extendPerm_symm_apply_c (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ c = c := by
  calc (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ c = (extendPerm c σ).symm c := rfl
    _ = (extendPerm c σ).invFun c := rfl
    _ = c := by simp [extendPerm]

theorem extendPerm_symm_apply_of_ne {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i = (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by
  calc (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i = (extendPerm c σ).symm i := rfl
    _ = (extendPerm c σ).invFun i := rfl
    _ = (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := by simp [extendPerm, dite_eq_right hi]

@[simp]
theorem extendPerm_one : extendPerm c (1 : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) = 1 := by
  ext i
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · simp [hc]
  · simp [extendPerm_apply_of_ne c hc]

theorem extendPerm_mul (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    extendPerm c (σ * τ) = extendPerm c σ * extendPerm c τ := by
  ext i
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · simp [hc, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, extendPerm_apply_c]
  · have hi : i ≠ c := hc
    have h_tau : extendPerm c τ i = (τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val := extendPerm_apply_of_ne c hi τ
    have h_tau_ne : (τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val ≠ c := (τ ⟨i, hi⟩).property
    calc extendPerm c (σ * τ) i
        = ((σ * τ) ⟨i, hi⟩).val := extendPerm_apply_of_ne c hi _
      _ = (σ (τ ⟨i, hi⟩)).val := by simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
      _ = extendPerm c σ ((τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val) := by
          have : extendPerm c σ ((τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val) = (σ ⟨(τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, h_tau_ne⟩).val :=
            extendPerm_apply_of_ne c h_tau_ne σ
          have h_eq : (⟨(τ ⟨i, hi⟩).val, h_tau_ne⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) = τ ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
            apply Subtype.ext; rfl
          rw [this, h_eq]
      _ = extendPerm c σ (extendPerm c τ i) := by rw [h_tau]
      _ = (extendPerm c σ * extendPerm c τ) i := by simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

/-- Bundled group hom for permutation extension. -/
def extendPermHom : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c) →* Equiv.Perm ι where
  toFun := extendPerm c
  map_one' := extendPerm_one c
  map_mul' := extendPerm_mul c

@[simp]
theorem extendPermHom_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    extendPermHom c σ = extendPerm c σ := rfl

theorem extendPerm_inv (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ = extendPerm c σ⁻¹ := by
  calc (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ = (extendPermHom c σ)⁻¹ := rfl
    _ = extendPermHom c σ⁻¹ := by rw [map_inv]
    _ = extendPerm c σ⁻¹ := rfl

end PermutationLayer

section TupleLayer

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] {A : Type uA} [Group A] {c : ι}

/-- Insert a distinguished coefficient `a` into a tuple `u` indexed by `DeletedIndex ι c`. -/
def insertTuple (c : ι) (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) : ι → A :=
  fun i => if h : i = c then a else u ⟨i, h⟩

omit [Group A] in
@[simp]
theorem insertTuple_apply_c (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    insertTuple c a u c = a := by
  simp [insertTuple]

omit [Group A] in
theorem insertTuple_apply_of_ne {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    insertTuple c a u i = u ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
  simp [insertTuple, dite_eq_right hi]

omit [Group A] in
theorem insertTuple_comp_val (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) (d : DeletedIndex ι c) :
    insertTuple c a u d.val = u d :=
  insertTuple_apply_of_ne d.property a u

theorem insertTuple_one : insertTuple (c := c) (1 : A) (1 : DeletedIndex ι c → A) = 1 := by
  funext i
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · simp [hc]
  · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hc]

theorem insertTuple_mul (a₁ a₂ : A) (u₁ u₂ : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    insertTuple c (a₁ * a₂) (u₁ * u₂) = insertTuple c a₁ u₁ * insertTuple c a₂ u₂ := by
  funext i
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · simp [hc]
  · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hc]

/-- Tuple insertion with fixed `1` at `c` as a group hom. -/
def insertTupleHomOne (c : ι) : (DeletedIndex ι c → A) →* (ι → A) where
  toFun u := insertTuple c (1 : A) u
  map_one' := insertTuple_one (c := c) (A := A)
  map_mul' := by
    intro u v
    have h := insertTuple_mul (c := c) (1 : A) (1 : A) u v
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    exact h

/-- Insertion from `A × (DeletedIndex → A)` to `ι → A`. -/
def insertTupleProdHom (c : ι) : A × (DeletedIndex ι c → A) →* (ι → A) where
  toFun p := insertTuple c p.1 p.2
  map_one' := by
    ext i
    by_cases hc : i = c
    · simp [hc]
    · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hc]
  map_mul' := by
    intro p q
    simp only [Prod.mul_def]
    exact insertTuple_mul p.1 q.1 p.2 q.2

@[simp]
theorem insertTupleProdHom_apply (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    insertTupleProdHom (A := A) c (a, u) = insertTuple c a u := rfl

theorem insertTuple_naturality {B : Type uB} [Group B] (f : A →* B)
    (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) (i : ι) :
    f (insertTuple c a u i) = insertTuple c (f a) (fun d => f (u d)) i := by
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · simp [hc]
  · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hc]

theorem mapTuple_insertTuple {B : Type uB} [Group B] (f : A →* B)
    (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    mapTupleHom (ι := ι) f (insertTuple c a u) =
      insertTuple c (f a) (fun d => f (u d)) := by
  funext i
  exact insertTuple_naturality f a u i

omit [Group A] in
theorem permute_insertTuple (σ : Equiv.Perm (DeletedIndex ι c))
    (a : A) (u : DeletedIndex ι c → A) :
    permute (extendPerm c σ) (insertTuple c a u) =
      insertTuple c a (permute σ u) := by
  funext i
  by_cases hc : i = c
  · have h_inv_c : (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i = c := by
      rw [hc, extendPerm_symm_apply_c]
    calc permute (extendPerm c σ) (insertTuple c a u) i
        = insertTuple c a u ((extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i) := rfl
      _ = insertTuple c a u c := by rw [h_inv_c]
      _ = a := by simp
      _ = insertTuple c a (permute σ u) i := by simp [hc]
  · have hi : i ≠ c := hc
    have h_eq_inv : (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i = c ↔ i = c := by
      rw [extendPerm_inv]
      exact extendPerm_apply_eq_c_iff c σ⁻¹ i
    have h_perm_ne : (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i ≠ c := by
      intro heq
      have : i = c := h_eq_inv.mp heq
      exact hi this
    have h_symm : (extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i = (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val :=
      extendPerm_symm_apply_of_ne c hi σ
    calc permute (extendPerm c σ) (insertTuple c a u) i
        = insertTuple c a u ((extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i) := rfl
      _ = u ⟨(extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i, h_perm_ne⟩ := by
          rw [insertTuple_apply_of_ne h_perm_ne]
      _ = u (σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩) := by
          have h_eq : (⟨(extendPerm c σ)⁻¹ i, h_perm_ne⟩ : DeletedIndex ι c) =
              σ⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            exact h_symm
          rw [h_eq]
      _ = permute σ u ⟨i, hi⟩ := rfl
      _ = insertTuple c a (permute σ u) i := by
          rw [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hi]

end TupleLayer

section MonomialLayer

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] {A : Type uA} [Group A] (c : ι)

/-- Insert a monomial over `DeletedIndex ι c` together with a pivot unit `a` into
`MonomialBase A ι`. -/
def monomialInsert (a : A) (x : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) : MonomialBase A ι :=
  ⟨insertTuple c a x.left, extendPerm c x.right⟩

@[simp]
theorem monomialInsert_left (a : A) (x : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (monomialInsert c a x).left = insertTuple c a x.left := rfl

@[simp]
theorem monomialInsert_right (a : A) (x : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (monomialInsert c a x).right = extendPerm c x.right := rfl

theorem monomialInsert_one :
    monomialInsert c (1 : A) (1 : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) = 1 := by
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · simp [monomialInsert, insertTuple_one]
  · simp [monomialInsert, extendPerm_one]

/-- Bundled monoid hom `A × MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c) →* MonomialBase A ι`. -/
def monomialInsertProdHom : A × MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c) →* MonomialBase A ι where
  toFun p := monomialInsert c p.1 p.2
  map_one' := by
    simp [monomialInsert_one]
  map_mul' := by
    intro p q
    apply SemidirectProduct.ext
    · simp only [monomialInsert, SemidirectProduct.mul_left, tupleActionHom_apply]
      have h_perm : permute (extendPerm c p.2.right) (insertTuple c q.1 q.2.left) =
          insertTuple c q.1 (permute p.2.right q.2.left) :=
        permute_insertTuple p.2.right q.1 q.2.left
      calc insertTuple c (p.1 * q.1) ((p.2 * q.2).left)
          = insertTuple c (p.1 * q.1) (p.2.left * permute p.2.right q.2.left) := by
            simp [SemidirectProduct.mul_left, tupleActionHom_apply]
        _ = insertTuple c p.1 p.2.left * insertTuple c q.1 (permute p.2.right q.2.left) := by
            rw [insertTuple_mul]
        _ = insertTuple c p.1 p.2.left *
            permute (extendPerm c p.2.right) (insertTuple c q.1 q.2.left) := by
            rw [h_perm]
    · have h_right : (p * q).2.right = p.2.right * q.2.right := rfl
      calc extendPerm c (p * q).2.right
          = extendPerm c (p.2.right * q.2.right) := by rw [h_right]
        _ = extendPerm c p.2.right * extendPerm c q.2.right := extendPerm_mul c _ _

@[simp]
theorem monomialInsertProdHom_apply (a : A) (x : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    monomialInsertProdHom c (a, x) = monomialInsert c a x := rfl

theorem monomialInsert_mul (a₁ a₂ : A)
    (x₁ x₂ : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    monomialInsert c (a₁ * a₂) (x₁ * x₂) =
      monomialInsert c a₁ x₁ * monomialInsert c a₂ x₂ := by
  have h := (monomialInsertProdHom c).map_mul (a₁, x₁) (a₂, x₂)
  simpa [Prod.mul_def] using h

theorem monomialInsert_naturality {B : Type uB} [Group B] (f : A →* B)
    (a : A) (x : MonomialBase A (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    monomialBaseHom f (monomialInsert c a x) =
      monomialInsert c (f a) (monomialBaseHom f x) := by
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · funext i
    by_cases hc : i = c
    · simp [hc]
    · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne hc, mapTuple_apply]
  · rfl

end MonomialLayer

section MatrixRealization

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (c : ι)
variable {R : Type uR} [Semiring R]

private theorem monomial_entry (t : ι → Rˣ) (p : Equiv.Perm ι) (i j : ι) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨t, p⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) i j =
      if (p⁻¹ i) = j then (t i : R) else 0 := by
  have h : (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨t, p⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun k => (t k : R)) * (p⁻¹).permMatrix R := by
    simp only [coe_monomialMatrixHom_mk]
  rw [h, diag_mul_perm_eq]

theorem monomialInsert_matrix_c_c (a : Rˣ)
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) c c = (a : R) := by
  have h_entry := monomial_entry (R := R) (fun i => insertTuple c a x.left i)
    (extendPerm c x.right) c c
  have h_perm : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ c = c := extendPerm_symm_apply_c c x.right
  have h_t : insertTuple c a x.left c = a := insertTuple_apply_c a x.left
  calc (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) c c
      = (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨fun i => insertTuple c a x.left i,
          extendPerm c x.right⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) c c := rfl
    _ = if (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ c = c then ((insertTuple c a x.left c : Rˣ) : R) else 0 := by
        rw [monomial_entry]
    _ = (a : R) := by
        have : ((insertTuple c a x.left c : Rˣ) : R) = (a : R) := by rw [h_t]
        rw [h_perm, ite_eq_left rfl, this]

theorem monomialInsert_matrix_row_c (a : Rˣ)
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) {j : ι} (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) c j = 0 := by
  have h_entry := monomial_entry (R := R) (fun i => insertTuple c a x.left i)
    (extendPerm c x.right) c j
  have h_perm : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ c = c := extendPerm_symm_apply_c c x.right
  have h_ne : ¬ (c = j) := Ne.symm hj
  calc (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) c j
      = (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨fun i => insertTuple c a x.left i,
          extendPerm c x.right⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) c j := rfl
    _ = if (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ c = j then ((insertTuple c a x.left c : Rˣ) : R) else 0 := by
        rw [monomial_entry]
    _ = if c = j then (a : R) else 0 := by
        have : ((insertTuple c a x.left c : Rˣ) : R) = (a : R) := by
          rw [insertTuple_apply_c]
        rw [h_perm, this]
    _ = 0 := by rw [ite_eq_right h_ne]

theorem monomialInsert_matrix_col_c (a : Rˣ)
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) {i : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) i c = 0 := by
  calc (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) i c
      = (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨fun k => insertTuple c a x.left k,
          extendPerm c x.right⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) i c := rfl
    _ = if (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = c then ((insertTuple c a x.left i : Rˣ) : R) else 0 := by
        rw [monomial_entry]
    _ = 0 := by
        have h_eq : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = c ↔ i = c := by
          rw [extendPerm_inv]
          exact extendPerm_apply_eq_c_iff c x.right⁻¹ i
        have h_ne : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i ≠ c := by
          intro heq
          exact hi (h_eq.mp heq)
        rw [ite_eq_right h_ne]

theorem monomialInsert_matrix_block (a : Rˣ)
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) {i j : ι} (hi : i ≠ c) (hj : j ≠ c) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) i j =
      (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (DeletedIndex ι c) x) : Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R)
        ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
  have h_entry_small : (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (DeletedIndex ι c) x) :
        Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ =
      if (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ = ⟨j, hj⟩) then (x.left ⟨i, hi⟩ : R) else 0 := by
    have h := monomial_entry (R := R) (ι := DeletedIndex ι c) (fun d => x.left d) x.right
      ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
    exact h
  calc (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) : Matrix ι ι R) i j
      = (↑(monomialMatrixHom R ι ⟨fun k => insertTuple c a x.left k,
          extendPerm c x.right⟩) : Matrix ι ι R) i j := rfl
    _ = if (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = j then ((insertTuple c a x.left i : Rˣ) : R) else 0 := by
        rw [monomial_entry]
    _ = if (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = j then (x.left ⟨i, hi⟩ : R) else 0 := by
        have h_t : insertTuple c a x.left i = x.left ⟨i, hi⟩ :=
          insertTuple_apply_of_ne hi _ _
        have h_tR : ((insertTuple c a x.left i : Rˣ) : R) = (x.left ⟨i, hi⟩ : R) := by
          rw [h_t]
        rw [h_tR]
    _ = if (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ = ⟨j, hj⟩) then (x.left ⟨i, hi⟩ : R) else 0 := by
        have h_perm_eq : ((extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = j) ↔
            (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ = ⟨j, hj⟩) := by
          constructor
          · intro heq
            have h_symm : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val :=
              extendPerm_symm_apply_of_ne c hi x.right
            rw [h_symm] at heq
            apply Subtype.ext
            exact heq
          · intro heq
            have h_symm : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val :=
              extendPerm_symm_apply_of_ne c hi x.right
            have : (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩).val = j := congrArg Subtype.val heq
            rw [h_symm, this]
        by_cases hcond : (x.right⁻¹ ⟨i, hi⟩ = ⟨j, hj⟩)
        · have h_big : (extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = j := h_perm_eq.mpr hcond
          rw [ite_eq_left h_big, ite_eq_left hcond]
        · have h_big : ¬ ((extendPerm c x.right)⁻¹ i = j) := by
            intro heq
            exact hcond (h_perm_eq.mp heq)
          rw [ite_eq_right h_big, ite_eq_right hcond]
    _ = (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (DeletedIndex ι c) x) :
        Matrix (DeletedIndex ι c) (DeletedIndex ι c) R) ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
        rw [h_entry_small]

theorem monomialInsert_isIsolated {R' : Type uR} [Ring R'] (a : R'ˣ)
    (x : MonomialBase R'ˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    IsolatedCoordinate (monomialMatrixHom R' ι (monomialInsert c a x)) c where
  col_zero _ hi := monomialInsert_matrix_col_c c a x hi
  row_zero _ hj := monomialInsert_matrix_row_c c a x hj

theorem monomialInsert_mapRingHom {S : Type vR} [Semiring S] (f : R →+* S)
    (a : Rˣ) (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) =
      monomialMatrixHom S ι
        (monomialInsert c (Units.map f a) (monomialBaseHom (Units.map f) x)) := by
  let f' : Rˣ →* Sˣ := Units.map f
  have h1 : mapRingHom (n := ι) f (monomialMatrixHom R ι (monomialInsert c a x)) =
      monomialMatrixHom S ι (monomialBaseHom f' (monomialInsert c a x)) :=
    monomialMatrixHom_mapRingHom_apply f _
  have h2 : monomialBaseHom f' (monomialInsert c a x) =
      monomialInsert c (f' a) (monomialBaseHom f' x) :=
    monomialInsert_naturality c f' a x
  rw [h1, h2]

end MatrixRealization

section DivisionSpecialization

variable {ι : Type uι} [DecidableEq ι] (c : ι)
variable {K : Type uR} [DivisionRing K]

/-- Division helper inserting `Units.mk0 p hp`. This is the only division-specific portion. -/
def monomialInsertMk0 (p : K) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : MonomialBase Kˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) : MonomialBase Kˣ ι :=
  monomialInsert c (Units.mk0 p hp) x

@[simp]
theorem monomialInsertMk0_left (p : K) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : MonomialBase Kˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (monomialInsertMk0 c p hp x).left = insertTuple c (Units.mk0 p hp) x.left := rfl

@[simp]
theorem monomialInsertMk0_right (p : K) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : MonomialBase Kˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (monomialInsertMk0 c p hp x).right = extendPerm c x.right := rfl

theorem monomialInsertMk0_matrix_c_c [Fintype ι] (p : K) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : MonomialBase Kˣ (DeletedIndex ι c)) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom K ι (monomialInsertMk0 c p hp x)) : Matrix ι ι K) c c = p :=
  monomialInsert_matrix_c_c (R := K) c (Units.mk0 p hp) x

end DivisionSpecialization

module

public import MathlibExt.GroupTheory.PermutationBilinearTitsStabilization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Monomial
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Stabilization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.SpecialLinearStabilization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.MonomialSLStabilization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.MonomialCoordinateInsertion

@[expose] public section

open Matrix
open Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup
open PermutationBilinearTitsStabilization
open PermutationBilinearCocycle

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-! ## DeletedIndex vs `Fin.castSucc` -/

theorem deletedIndexLast_insertTuple_eq_tupleSucc
    {n : ℕ} {A : Type*} [Group A] (u : Fin n → A) :
    insertTuple (Fin.last n) (1 : A)
      (fun d : DeletedIndex (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.last n) =>
        u ((finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n)).symm d)) =
      tupleSucc (n := n) u := by
  ext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i
  · simp [insertTuple_apply_c]
  · simp [insertTuple_apply_of_ne, finSuccAboveEquiv_symm_apply_last,
      tupleSucc_apply_castSucc]

theorem deletedIndexLast_extendPerm_eq_permSuccHom
    {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    extendPerm (Fin.last n)
        (((finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n)).symm.trans σ).trans
          (finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n))) =
      permSuccHom (n := n) σ := by
  ext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i
  · simp [extendPerm_apply_c, permSuccHom_apply_last]
  · simp [extendPerm_apply_of_ne, Equiv.trans_apply,
      finSuccAboveEquiv_apply, Fin.succAbove_last,
      finSuccAboveEquiv_symm_apply_last, permSuccHom_apply_castSucc]

theorem deletedIndexLast_monomialInsert_eq_monomialSuccHom
    {n : ℕ} {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] (x : MonomialBase A (Fin n)) :
    monomialInsert (Fin.last n) (1 : A)
        ⟨fun d => x.left ((finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n)).symm d),
          ((finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n)).symm.trans x.right).trans
            (finSuccAboveEquiv (Fin.last n))⟩ =
      monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := A) x := by
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · simp only [monomialInsert_left, monomialSuccHom_left]
    exact deletedIndexLast_insertTuple_eq_tupleSucc (n := n) x.left
  · simp only [monomialInsert_right, monomialSuccHom_right]
    exact deletedIndexLast_extendPerm_eq_permSuccHom (n := n) x.right

private theorem monomialMatrixHom_entry
    {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {k : ℕ}
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (Fin k)) (i j : Fin k) :
    (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin k) x) :
        Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) R) i j =
      if (x.right⁻¹ i = j) then (x.left i : R) else 0 := by
  have h_eq :
      (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin k) x) :
        Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) R) =
        Matrix.diagonal (fun t => (x.left t : R)) *
          (x.right⁻¹).permMatrix R := by
    cases x with
    | mk u σ =>
      rfl
  rw [h_eq]
  simp [Matrix.diagonal_mul, Equiv.Perm.permMatrix,
    PEquiv.toMatrix_apply, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply]

/-! ## Main GL bridge -/

theorem monomialMatrixHom_monomialSuccHom
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    (x : MonomialBase Rˣ (Fin n)) :
    monomialMatrixHom R (Fin (n + 1))
        (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R
        (monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) := by
  apply Units.ext
  ext i j
  have hL :
      (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin (n + 1))
            (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x)) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) i j =
        if ((monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).right⁻¹ i = j)
          then (((monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).left i : Rˣ) : R)
          else 0 :=
    monomialMatrixHom_entry (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x) i j
  have hR :
      (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R
            (monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x)) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) i j =
        Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
          (Matrix.fromBlocks
            (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
              Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1) i j := by
    simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_stabilization]
  rw [hL, hR]
  have h_perm_right :
      (monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) x).right =
        permSuccHom (n := n) x.right := rfl
  have h_tuple_left :
      (monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) x).left =
        tupleSuccHom (n := n) x.left := rfl
  have h_inv :
      (monomialSuccHom (n := n) (A := Rˣ) x).right⁻¹ =
        permSuccHom (n := n) x.right⁻¹ := by
    rw [h_perm_right, permSuccHom_inv]
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun a => ?_) i
  · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
    · -- i = last, j = last
      have h_last_inv : (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).right⁻¹ (Fin.last n) =
          Fin.last n := by
        rw [h_inv, permSuccHom_apply_last]
      have h_last_tuple :
          ((monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).left (Fin.last n) : R) = 1 := by
        simp only [h_tuple_left, tupleSuccHom_apply_last]
        rfl
      have h_reindex_last :
          Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
              (Matrix.fromBlocks
                (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
                  Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1)
              (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n) = 1 := by
        simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last,
          Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂]
      rw [h_reindex_last]
      simp only [h_last_inv, h_last_tuple, ite_true]
    · -- i = last, j = castSucc b
      have h_ne : (permSuccHom (n := n) x.right)⁻¹ (Fin.last n) ≠
          Fin.castSucc b := by
        simp only [permSuccHom_inv, permSuccHom_apply_last]
        exact Ne.symm (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last b))
      have h_ne' : (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).right⁻¹ (Fin.last n) ≠
          Fin.castSucc b := by
        rw [h_inv]
        exact h_ne
      have h_reindex :
          Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
              (Matrix.fromBlocks
                (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
                  Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1)
              (Fin.last n) (Fin.castSucc b) = 0 := by
        simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_last,
          finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁]
      rw [h_reindex, ite_eq_right h_ne']
  · -- i = castSucc a
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun b => ?_) j
    · have h_ne :
          (permSuccHom (n := n) x.right)⁻¹ (Fin.castSucc a) ≠
            Fin.last n := by
        rw [permSuccHom_inv, permSuccHom_apply_castSucc]
        exact ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last _)
      have h_ne' : (monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).right⁻¹ (Fin.castSucc a) ≠
          Fin.last n := by
        rw [h_inv]
        exact h_ne
      have h_reindex :
          Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
              (Matrix.fromBlocks
                (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
                  Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1)
              (Fin.castSucc a) (Fin.last n) = 0 := by
        simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc,
          finSumFinEquiv_symm_last, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂]
      rw [h_reindex, ite_eq_right h_ne']
    · -- i = castSucc a, j = castSucc b
      have h_perm : ((permSuccHom (n := n) x.right)⁻¹
            (Fin.castSucc a) = Fin.castSucc b) ↔
          (x.right⁻¹ a = b) := by
        simp only [permSuccHom_inv, permSuccHom_apply_castSucc,
          Fin.castSucc_inj]
      have h_perm' : ((monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).right⁻¹
            (Fin.castSucc a) = Fin.castSucc b) ↔
          (x.right⁻¹ a = b) := by
        rw [h_inv]
        exact h_perm
      have h_reindex : Matrix.reindex finSumFinEquiv finSumFinEquiv
            (Matrix.fromBlocks
              (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
                Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) 0 0 1)
            (Fin.castSucc a) (Fin.castSucc b) =
          (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
            Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) a b := by
        simp [Matrix.reindex_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castSucc,
          Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
      have h_entry : (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n) x) :
            Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) a b =
          if (x.right⁻¹ a = b) then (x.left a : R) else 0 :=
        monomialMatrixHom_entry x a b
      have h_tuple : ((monomialSuccHom (n := n) x).left
          (Fin.castSucc a) : R) = (x.left a : R) := by
        simp only [h_tuple_left, tupleSuccHom_apply_castSucc]
      rw [h_reindex, h_entry]
      by_cases h_eq : x.right⁻¹ a = b
      · simp only [h_perm', h_eq, h_tuple, ite_true]
      · simp only [h_perm', h_eq, h_tuple, ite_false]

/-! ## Main SL bridge -/

theorem monomialSLHom_monomialSLSuccHom
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (m : MonomialSL R (Fin n)) :
    monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
        (monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) m) =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R
        (monomialSLHom R (Fin n) m) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hGL :
      (↑(monomialSLHom R (Fin (n + 1))
            (monomialSLSuccHom (R := R) m) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R)) =
        (↑(monomialMatrixHom R (Fin (n + 1))
            (monomialSuccHom (n := n) (m : MonomialBase Rˣ (Fin n))) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R)) := by
    simp only [coe_monomialSLHom, coe_monomialSLSuccHom]
  have hGL2 :
      (↑(Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R
            (monomialSLHom R (Fin n) m) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R)) =
        (↑(Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R
            (monomialMatrixHom R (Fin n)
              (m : MonomialBase Rˣ (Fin n))) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R)) := by
    simp only [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_stabilization,
      monomialSLHom_toGL]
  rw [hGL, hGL2]
  exact congrArg Units.val
    (monomialMatrixHom_monomialSuccHom
      (R := R) (x := (m : MonomialBase Rˣ (Fin n))))

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup
