module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Inv
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Sum

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

section Defs

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {S : Type*} [Ring S]

abbrev alphaType (e : ι ↪o κ) : Type _ := {k : κ // k ∈ Set.range e}
abbrev betaType (e : ι ↪o κ) : Type _ := {k : κ // k ∉ Set.range e}

instance decPredMemRange (e : ι ↪o κ) : DecidablePred (fun k : κ => k ∈ Set.range e) :=
  fun _ => Fintype.decidableExistsFintype

instance decEqAlpha (e : ι ↪o κ) : DecidableEq (alphaType e) := Subtype.instDecidableEq
instance decEqBeta (e : ι ↪o κ) : DecidableEq (betaType e) := Subtype.instDecidableEq
instance fintypeAlpha (e : ι ↪o κ) : Fintype (alphaType e) := Subtype.fintype _
instance fintypeBeta (e : ι ↪o κ) : Fintype (betaType e) := Subtype.fintype _

def eEmb (e : ι ↪o κ) : ι ↪ κ := e.toEmbedding

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] in
theorem range_eq_range_emb (e : ι ↪o κ) : Set.range e = Set.range (eEmb e) := by
  ext k; constructor <;> rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;> exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] in
theorem mem_range_emb_of_mem_range {e : ι ↪o κ} {k : κ}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range e) : k ∈ Set.range (eEmb e) := by
  rwa [← range_eq_range_emb]

noncomputable def invOfRange (e : ι ↪o κ) (k : κ) (hk : k ∈ Set.range e) : ι :=
  (eEmb e).invOfMemRange ⟨k, mem_range_emb_of_mem_range hk⟩

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem invOfRange_spec (e : ι ↪o κ) (k : κ) (hk : k ∈ Set.range e) :
    e (invOfRange e k hk) = k :=
  (eEmb e).left_inv_of_invOfMemRange _

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem invOfRange_eq_of_eq {e : ι ↪o κ} {k : κ} (hk : k ∈ Set.range e)
    {i : ι} (h : k = e i) : invOfRange e k hk = i := by
  apply e.injective
  rw [invOfRange_spec, h]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem invOfRange_self (e : ι ↪o κ) (i : ι) :
    invOfRange e (e i) (Set.mem_range_self i) = i :=
  invOfRange_eq_of_eq (Set.mem_range_self i) rfl

noncomputable def eRangeEquiv (e : ι ↪o κ) : ι ≃ alphaType e where
  toFun i := ⟨e i, Set.mem_range_self i⟩
  invFun b := invOfRange e b.1 b.2
  left_inv i := by
    have h_mem : (e i) ∈ Set.range (eEmb e) :=
      mem_range_emb_of_mem_range (Set.mem_range_self i)
    have hl : (eEmb e) ((eEmb e).invOfMemRange ⟨(e i : κ), h_mem⟩) = e i :=
      (eEmb e).left_inv_of_invOfMemRange _
    have : (eEmb e) ((eEmb e).invOfMemRange ⟨(e i : κ), h_mem⟩) = (eEmb e) i := by
      calc (eEmb e) ((eEmb e).invOfMemRange ⟨(e i : κ), h_mem⟩) = e i := hl
        _ = (eEmb e) i := rfl
    exact (eEmb e).injective this
  right_inv b := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := b
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact invOfRange_spec e k hk

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
@[simp]
theorem eRangeEquiv_symm_apply (e : ι ↪o κ) (k : κ) (hk : k ∈ Set.range e) :
    (eRangeEquiv e).symm ⟨k, hk⟩ = invOfRange e k hk :=
  rfl

def sumComplEquiv (e : ι ↪o κ) : alphaType e ⊕ betaType e ≃ κ :=
  Equiv.sumCompl (fun k : κ => k ∈ Set.range e)

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
@[simp]
theorem sumComplEquiv_symm_of_mem {e : ι ↪o κ} {k : κ}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range e) :
    (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inl ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
  Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hk

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
@[simp]
theorem sumComplEquiv_symm_of_not_mem {e : ι ↪o κ} {k : κ}
    (hk : k ∉ Set.range e) :
    (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
  Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hk

noncomputable def extendMatrix (e : ι ↪o κ) (M : Matrix ι ι R) : Matrix κ κ R :=
  Matrix.reindex (sumComplEquiv e) (sumComplEquiv e)
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.reindex (eRangeEquiv e) (eRangeEquiv e) M) 0 0 1)

noncomputable def extendMatrixMonoidHom (e : ι ↪o κ) :
    Matrix ι ι R →* Matrix κ κ R :=
  (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv R (sumComplEquiv e)).toMonoidHom.comp
    ((Matrix.fromBlocksOneMonoidHom R (alphaType e) (betaType e)).comp
      (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv R (eRangeEquiv e)).toMonoidHom)

theorem extendMatrix_eq_hom (e : ι ↪o κ) (M : Matrix ι ι R) :
    extendMatrix e M = extendMatrixMonoidHom (R := R) e M := rfl

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem extendMatrix_apply (e : ι ↪o κ) (M : Matrix ι ι R) (k l : κ) :
    extendMatrix e M k l =
      if hk : k ∈ Set.range e then
        if hl : l ∈ Set.range e then
          M (invOfRange e k hk) (invOfRange e l hl)
        else 0
      else
        if k = l then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [extendMatrix, Matrix.reindex_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
  · by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
    · have hk_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inl (⟨k, hk⟩ : alphaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hk
      have hl_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm l = Sum.inl (⟨l, hl⟩ : alphaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hl
      rw [hk_symm, hl_symm, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁]
      simp [Matrix.submatrix_apply, eRangeEquiv_symm_apply, hk, hl]
    · have hk_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inl (⟨k, hk⟩ : alphaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hk
      have hl_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm l = Sum.inr (⟨l, hl⟩ : betaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hl
      rw [hk_symm, hl_symm, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.zero_apply]
      simp [hk, hl]
  · by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
    · have hk_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inr (⟨k, hk⟩ : betaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hk
      have hl_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm l = Sum.inl (⟨l, hl⟩ : alphaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos hl
      rw [hk_symm, hl_symm, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.zero_apply]
      have h_ne : k ≠ l := fun heq => hk (heq.symm ▸ hl)
      simp [hk, h_ne]
    · have hk_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm k = Sum.inr (⟨k, hk⟩ : betaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hk
      have hl_symm : (sumComplEquiv e).symm l = Sum.inr (⟨l, hl⟩ : betaType e) :=
        Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg hl
      rw [hk_symm, hl_symm, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.one_apply]
      by_cases hkl : k = l
      · subst hkl
        have h_eq : (⟨k, hk⟩ : betaType e) = ⟨k, hl⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
        simp [h_eq, hk]
      · have h_neq : (⟨k, hk⟩ : betaType e) ≠ ⟨l, hl⟩ := fun he => hkl (congrArg Subtype.val he)
        simp [h_neq, hk, hkl]

omit [Fintype κ] in
theorem extendMatrix_elementary (e : ι ↪o κ) (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    extendMatrix e (1 + Matrix.single i j a) = 1 + Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a := by
  have _heij : e i ≠ e j := fun h => hij (e.injective h)
  ext k l
  simp only [extendMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
  · by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
    · have hk_eq : e (invOfRange e k hk) = k := invOfRange_spec e k hk
      have hl_eq : e (invOfRange e l hl) = l := invOfRange_spec e l hl
      simp only [hk, hl, dite_eq_left, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.single_apply]
      have h_inv_eq : (invOfRange e k hk = invOfRange e l hl) ↔ (k = l) := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          calc k = e (invOfRange e k hk) := hk_eq.symm
            _ = e (invOfRange e l hl) := congrArg e h
            _ = l := hl_eq
        · intro h
          have : e (invOfRange e k hk) = e (invOfRange e l hl) := by
            rw [hk_eq, hl_eq, h]
          exact e.injective this
      have h_inv_i : (invOfRange e k hk = i) ↔ (k = e i) := by
        constructor
        · intro h; calc k = e (invOfRange e k hk) := hk_eq.symm
            _ = e i := congrArg e h
        · intro h; exact invOfRange_eq_of_eq hk h
      have h_inv_j : (invOfRange e l hl = j) ↔ (l = e j) := by
        constructor
        · intro h; calc l = e (invOfRange e l hl) := hl_eq.symm
            _ = e j := congrArg e h
        · intro h; exact invOfRange_eq_of_eq hl h
      have h_i : (i = invOfRange e k hk) ↔ (e i = k) := by
        calc (i = invOfRange e k hk) ↔ (invOfRange e k hk = i) := eq_comm
          _ ↔ (k = e i) := h_inv_i
          _ ↔ (e i = k) := eq_comm
      have h_j : (j = invOfRange e l hl) ↔ (e j = l) := by
        calc (j = invOfRange e l hl) ↔ (invOfRange e l hl = j) := eq_comm
          _ ↔ (l = e j) := h_inv_j
          _ ↔ (e j = l) := eq_comm
      have h_cond : (i = invOfRange e k hk ∧ j = invOfRange e l hl) ↔ (e i = k ∧ e j = l) := by
        rw [h_i, h_j]
      simp only [h_inv_eq, h_cond]
    · have hkl : k ≠ l := fun heq => hl (heq.symm ▸ hk)
      have hej : l ≠ e j := fun heq => hl (heq ▸ Set.mem_range_self j)
      have hej' : e j ≠ l := fun h => hej h.symm
      have _hej_ne : l ≠ e j := hej
      simp [hk, hl, hkl, hej']
  · have hk_neg : ¬(k ∈ Set.range e) := hk
    rw [dite_eq_right hk_neg]
    by_cases hkl : k = l
    · have hei : k ≠ e i := fun heq => hk (heq ▸ Set.mem_range_self i)
      have hej : ¬(e i = k ∧ e j = l) := by
        intro ⟨h1, _⟩; exact hei h1.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left hkl]
      have h_one : (1 : Matrix κ κ R) k l = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_left hkl]
      have h_sing : (Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a) k l = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.single_apply, ite_eq_right hej]
      have h_rhs : (1 + Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a) k l = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.add_apply, h_one, h_sing, add_zero]
      rw [h_rhs]
    · have hei : k ≠ e i := fun heq => hk (heq ▸ Set.mem_range_self i)
      have hej : ¬(e i = k ∧ e j = l) := by
        intro ⟨h1, _⟩; exact hei h1.symm
      rw [ite_eq_right hkl]
      have h_one : (1 : Matrix κ κ R) k l = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.one_apply, ite_eq_right hkl]
      have h_sing : (Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a) k l = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.single_apply, ite_eq_right hej]
      have h_rhs : (1 + Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a) k l = 0 := by
        rw [Matrix.add_apply, h_one, h_sing, add_zero]
      rw [h_rhs]

omit [Fintype κ] in
theorem extendMatrix_one (e : ι ↪o κ) :
    extendMatrix (R := R) e (1 : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 := by
  ext k l
  rw [extendMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
  · by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
    · rw [dite_eq_left hk, dite_eq_left hl]
      rw [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
      have h_iff : invOfRange e k hk = invOfRange e l hl ↔ k = l := by
        constructor
        · intro heq
          calc k = e (invOfRange e k hk) := (invOfRange_spec e k hk).symm
            _ = e (invOfRange e l hl) := congrArg e heq
            _ = l := invOfRange_spec e l hl
        · intro heq
          apply e.injective
          calc e (invOfRange e k hk) = k := invOfRange_spec e k hk
            _ = l := heq
            _ = e (invOfRange e l hl) := (invOfRange_spec e l hl).symm
      by_cases hkl : k = l
      · have h_eq : invOfRange e k hk = invOfRange e l hl := h_iff.mpr hkl
        rw [ite_eq_left h_eq, ite_eq_left hkl]
      · have h_ne : invOfRange e k hk ≠ invOfRange e l hl := fun heq => hkl (h_iff.mp heq)
        rw [ite_eq_right h_ne, ite_eq_right hkl]
    · have hkl : k ≠ l := fun heq => hl (heq.symm ▸ hk)
      rw [dite_eq_left hk, dite_eq_right hl]
      rw [Matrix.one_apply]
      rw [ite_eq_right hkl]
  · rw [dite_eq_right hk]
    rw [Matrix.one_apply]

omit [DecidableEq ι] in
theorem extendMatrix_mul (e : ι ↪o κ) (M N : Matrix ι ι R) :
    extendMatrix e (M * N) = extendMatrix (R := R) e M * extendMatrix e N := by
  have h := (extendMatrixMonoidHom (R := R) e).map_mul M N
  have heq1 : extendMatrix e (M * N) = extendMatrixMonoidHom e (M * N) := rfl
  have heq2 : extendMatrix (R := R) e M = extendMatrixMonoidHom e M := rfl
  have heq3 : extendMatrix e N = extendMatrixMonoidHom e N := rfl
  rw [heq1, heq2, heq3]
  exact h

noncomputable def extendByIdentity (e : ι ↪o κ) : GL ι R →* GL κ R :=
  Units.map (extendMatrixMonoidHom (R := R) e)

@[simp]
theorem coe_extendByIdentity (e : ι ↪o κ) (g : GL ι R) :
    (↑(extendByIdentity (R := R) e g) : Matrix κ κ R) =
      extendMatrix e (↑g : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem extendByIdentity_elementary (e : ι ↪o κ) (i j : ι)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    extendByIdentity e (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (e i) (e j) (fun h => hij (e.injective h)) a := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [coe_extendByIdentity, coe_elementary]
  exact extendMatrix_elementary e i j hij a

end Defs

section UpperPres

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

theorem extendByIdentity_mem_upperElementarySubgroup (e : ι ↪o κ)
    {g : GL ι R} (hg : g ∈ upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    extendByIdentity (R := R) e g ∈ upperElementarySubgroup κ R := by
  have hle :
      Subgroup.closure (upperElementarySet ι R) ≤
        (upperElementarySubgroup κ R).comap (extendByIdentity (R := R) e) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    change extendByIdentity e (elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a) ∈
      upperElementarySubgroup κ R
    have hij_ne : e i ≠ e j := fun h => (ne_of_lt hij) (e.injective h)
    have h_eq : extendByIdentity e (elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a) =
        elementary (e i) (e j) hij_ne a := by
      apply Units.ext
      calc (extendByIdentity e (elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a) : Matrix κ κ R)
          = extendMatrix e (↑(elementary i j (ne_of_lt hij) a)) := rfl
        _ = extendMatrix e (1 + Matrix.single i j a) := by
            rw [coe_elementary]
        _ = 1 + Matrix.single (e i) (e j) a :=
            extendMatrix_elementary e i j (ne_of_lt hij) a
        _ = ↑(elementary (e i) (e j) hij_ne a) := by
            rw [coe_elementary]
    rw [h_eq]
    have hij' : e i < e j := e.lt_iff_lt.mpr hij
    have : elementary (e i) (e j) (ne_of_lt hij') a =
        (elementary (e i) (e j) hij_ne a : GL κ R) := by
      apply Units.ext; rfl
    rw [← this]
    exact elementary_mem_upperElementarySubgroup _ _ hij' _
  exact (Subgroup.mem_comap).mp (hle hg)

end UpperPres

namespace UpperElementary

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {S : Type*} [Ring S]

noncomputable def extendByIdentity (e : ι ↪o κ) :
    upperElementarySubgroup ι R →* upperElementarySubgroup κ R :=
  (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := R) e).restrict
    (fun _g hg =>
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity_mem_upperElementarySubgroup e hg)

@[simp]
theorem coe_extendByIdentity (e : ι ↪o κ) (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    (↑(extendByIdentity (R := R) e g) : GL κ R) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := R) e (↑g) := by
  cases g with | mk _ _ => rfl

@[simp]
theorem extendByIdentity_elementary (e : ι ↪o κ) (i j : ι) (hij : i < j)
    (a : R) :
    extendByIdentity (R := R) e (elementary i j hij a) =
      elementary (e i) (e j) (e.lt_iff_lt.mpr hij) a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity_elementary]

end UpperElementary

section Coeff

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
variable {S : Type*} [Ring S]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem extendMatrix_mapRingHom (e : ι ↪o κ) (f : R →+* S)
    (M : Matrix ι ι R) :
    (extendMatrix (R := R) e M).map f = extendMatrix e (M.map f) := by
  ext k l
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply]
  rw [extendMatrix_apply, extendMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
  · by_cases hl : l ∈ Set.range e
    · simp [hk, hl]
    · simp [hk, hl]
  · simp only [hk, dite_eq_right, not_false_eq_true]
    by_cases hkl : k = l
    · simp [hkl, RingHom.map_one]
    · simp [hkl, RingHom.map_zero]

theorem extendByIdentity_mapRingHom (e : ι ↪o κ) (f : R →+* S) :
    (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := κ) f).comp
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := R) e) =
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := S) e).comp
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.mapRingHom (n := ι) f) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, coe_extendByIdentity,
    coe_mapRingHom, extendMatrix_mapRingHom]

theorem upper_extendByIdentity_mapRingHom (e : ι ↪o κ) (f : R →+* S) :
    (UpperElementary.mapRingHom (ι := κ) f).comp
        (UpperElementary.extendByIdentity (R := R) e) =
      (UpperElementary.extendByIdentity (R := S) e).comp
        (UpperElementary.mapRingHom (ι := ι) f) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    UpperElementary.coe_mapRingHom, UpperElementary.coe_extendByIdentity]
  have h := MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp (extendByIdentity_mapRingHom (e := e) (f := f)) g.val
  exact h

end Coeff

section Index

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [LinearOrder κ]
variable {η : Type*} [DecidableEq η] [Fintype η] [LinearOrder η]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq η] [Fintype η] in
theorem range_trans_subset_range₂ (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) :
    Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) ⊆ Set.range e₂ := by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hk
  exact ⟨e₁ i, rfl⟩

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype η] in
theorem mem_range_trans_iff_inv (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) (k : η)
    (hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂) :
    k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) ↔ invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ := by
  constructor
  · intro hk
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hk
    have h_eq : e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) = k := invOfRange_spec e₂ k hk₂
    have h_eq2 : e₂ (e₁ i) = k := by
      calc e₂ (e₁ i) = (e₁.trans e₂) i := rfl
        _ = k := hi
    have : e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) = e₂ (e₁ i) := by rw [h_eq, h_eq2]
    have : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ = e₁ i := e₂.injective this
    rw [this]
    exact Set.mem_range_self i
  · intro hk₁
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hk₁
    have h_eq : e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) = k := invOfRange_spec e₂ k hk₂
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    calc (e₁.trans e₂) i = e₂ (e₁ i) := rfl
      _ = e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) := by rw [hi]
      _ = k := h_eq

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq η] [Fintype η] in
theorem not_mem_range_trans_of_not_mem_range₂ (e₁ : ι ↪o κ)
    (e₂ : κ ↪o η) {k : η} (hk : k ∉ Set.range e₂) :
    k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
  fun h => hk (range_trans_subset_range₂ e₁ e₂ h)

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ] in
theorem invOfRange_irrel {e : ι ↪o κ} {k : κ} (hk₁ hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e) :
    invOfRange e k hk₁ = invOfRange e k hk₂ := by
  apply e.injective
  calc e (invOfRange e k hk₁) = k := invOfRange_spec e k hk₁
    _ = e (invOfRange e k hk₂) := (invOfRange_spec e k hk₂).symm

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype η] in
theorem inv_trans_eq (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) {k : η}
    (hk : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂)) :
    let hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂ := range_trans_subset_range₂ e₁ e₂ hk
    let hj : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ :=
      (mem_range_trans_iff_inv e₁ e₂ k hk₂).mp hk
    invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hj =
      invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk := by
  intro hk₂ hj
  apply (e₁.trans e₂).injective
  have h1 : e₁ (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hj) =
      invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ := invOfRange_spec e₁ _ hj
  have h2 : e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) = k := invOfRange_spec e₂ k hk₂
  have h3 : (e₁.trans e₂) (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk) = k :=
    invOfRange_spec (e₁.trans e₂) k hk
  calc (e₁.trans e₂) (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hj)
      = e₂ (e₁ (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hj)) := rfl
    _ = e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) := by rw [h1]
    _ = k := h2
    _ = (e₁.trans e₂) (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk) := h3.symm

def idOrderEmbedding (α : Type*) [LE α] : α ↪o α :=
  (OrderIso.refl α).toOrderEmbedding

theorem extendMatrix_refl (M : Matrix ι ι R) :
    extendMatrix (idOrderEmbedding ι) M = M := by
  ext k l
  have hk : k ∈ Set.range (idOrderEmbedding ι) := ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hl : l ∈ Set.range (idOrderEmbedding ι) := ⟨l, rfl⟩
  rw [extendMatrix_apply, dite_eq_left hk, dite_eq_left hl]
  have h_k : invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) k hk = k := by
    have h_eq : (idOrderEmbedding ι) (invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) k hk) = k :=
      invOfRange_spec _ k hk
    have : (idOrderEmbedding ι) k = k := rfl
    have : (idOrderEmbedding ι) (invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) k hk) =
        (idOrderEmbedding ι) k := by rw [h_eq, this]
    exact (idOrderEmbedding ι).injective this
  have h_l : invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) l hl = l := by
    have h_eq : (idOrderEmbedding ι) (invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) l hl) = l :=
      invOfRange_spec _ l hl
    have : (idOrderEmbedding ι) l = l := rfl
    have : (idOrderEmbedding ι) (invOfRange (idOrderEmbedding ι) l hl) =
        (idOrderEmbedding ι) l := by rw [h_eq, this]
    exact (idOrderEmbedding ι).injective this
  simp [h_k, h_l]

@[simp]
theorem extendByIdentity_refl :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := R)
        (idOrderEmbedding ι) = MonoidHom.id _ := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_extendByIdentity, extendMatrix_refl]

@[simp]
theorem upper_extendByIdentity_refl :
    UpperElementary.extendByIdentity (R := R) (idOrderEmbedding ι) =
      MonoidHom.id _ := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [UpperElementary.coe_extendByIdentity, extendByIdentity_refl]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype η] in
theorem extendMatrix_trans (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) (M : Matrix ι ι R) :
    extendMatrix (e₁.trans e₂) M = extendMatrix e₂ (extendMatrix e₁ M) := by
  ext k l
  simp only [extendMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂
  · by_cases hl₂ : l ∈ Set.range e₂
    · -- both k,l in range e₂
      have hk₁_def : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ ↔ k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
        (mem_range_trans_iff_inv e₁ e₂ k hk₂).symm
      have hl₁_def : invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ ↔ l ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
        (mem_range_trans_iff_inv e₁ e₂ l hl₂).symm
      by_cases hk₁ : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁
      · have hk_trans : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hk₁_def.mp hk₁
        by_cases hl₁ : invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ ∈ Set.range e₁
        · have hl_trans : l ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hl₁_def.mp hl₁
          have h_inv_k : invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk_trans =
              invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁ := (inv_trans_eq e₁ e₂ hk_trans).symm
          have h_inv_l : invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) l hl_trans =
              invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁ := (inv_trans_eq e₁ e₂ hl_trans).symm
          have lhs_eq : (if hk : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
              if hl : l ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
                M (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk) (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) l hl) else 0
            else if k = l then 1 else 0) =
              M (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁)
                (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁) := by
            rw [dite_eq_left hk_trans, dite_eq_left hl_trans, h_inv_k, h_inv_l]
          have rhs_eq : (if hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂ then
              if hl₂ : l ∈ Set.range e₂ then
                (if hk₁ : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                  if hl₁ : invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                    M (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁)
                      (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁) else 0
                else if invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ = invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ then 1 else 0)
              else 0 else if k = l then 1 else 0) =
              M (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁)
                (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁) := by
            rw [dite_eq_left hk₂, dite_eq_left hl₂, dite_eq_left hk₁, dite_eq_left hl₁]
          rw [lhs_eq, rhs_eq]
        · have hl_trans_false : l ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := by
            intro hlt
            exact hl₁ (hl₁_def.mpr hlt)
          have lhs_eq : (if hk : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
              if hl : l ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
                M (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk) (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) l hl) else 0
            else if k = l then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
            rw [dite_eq_left hk_trans, dite_eq_right hl_trans_false]
          have rhs_eq : (if hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂ then
              if hl₂ : l ∈ Set.range e₂ then
                (if hk₁ : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                  if hl₁ : invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                    M (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁)
                      (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁)
                  else 0
                else if invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ = invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ then 1 else 0) else 0
            else if k = l then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
            rw [dite_eq_left hk₂, dite_eq_left hl₂, dite_eq_left hk₁, dite_eq_right hl₁]
          rw [lhs_eq, rhs_eq]
      · have hk_trans_false : k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := by
          intro hkt
          exact hk₁ (hk₁_def.mpr hkt)
        have lhs_eq : (if hk : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
            if hl : l ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) then
              M (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) k hk) (invOfRange (e₁.trans e₂) l hl) else 0
          else if k = l then 1 else 0) = (if k = l then 1 else 0) := by
          rw [dite_eq_right hk_trans_false]
        have rhs_eq : (if hk₂ : k ∈ Set.range e₂ then
            if hl₂ : l ∈ Set.range e₂ then
              (if hk₁ : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                if hl₁ : invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ ∈ Set.range e₁ then
                  M (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) hk₁)
                    (invOfRange e₁ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) hl₁)
              else 0
              else if invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ = invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ then 1 else 0) else 0
          else if k = l then 1 else 0) = (if k = l then 1 else 0) := by
          rw [dite_eq_left hk₂, dite_eq_left hl₂, dite_eq_right hk₁]
          by_cases heq_kl : k = l
          · have hj_eq : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ = invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ := by
              subst heq_kl; rfl
            rw [ite_eq_left heq_kl, ite_eq_left hj_eq]
          · have hj_ne : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ≠ invOfRange e₂ l hl₂ := by
              intro heq_inv
              have : k = l := by
                calc k = e₂ (invOfRange e₂ k hk₂) := (invOfRange_spec e₂ k hk₂).symm
                  _ = e₂ (invOfRange e₂ l hl₂) := congrArg e₂ heq_inv
                  _ = l := invOfRange_spec e₂ l hl₂
              exact heq_kl this
            rw [ite_eq_right heq_kl, ite_eq_right hj_ne]
        rw [lhs_eq, rhs_eq]
    · -- k in range e₂, l not in range e₂
      have hl_trans_false : l ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
        not_mem_range_trans_of_not_mem_range₂ e₁ e₂ hl₂
      have hl_comp_false : l ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := by
        intro h; obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := h; exact hl_trans_false ⟨i, rfl⟩
      by_cases hk₁ : invOfRange e₂ k hk₂ ∈ Set.range e₁
      · have hk_trans : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
          (mem_range_trans_iff_inv e₁ e₂ k hk₂).mpr hk₁
        have hk_comp : k ∈ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := by
          obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hk_trans; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
        have _hk : k ∈ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hk_trans
        have _hkc : k ∈ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := hk_comp
        have _hlf : l ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hl_trans_false
        have _hlcf : l ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := hl_comp_false
        have _hk2 : k ∈ Set.range e₂ := hk₂
        have _hl2 : l ∉ Set.range e₂ := hl₂
        simp_all
      · have hk_trans_false : k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := by
          intro hkt; exact hk₁ ((mem_range_trans_iff_inv e₁ e₂ k hk₂).mp hkt)
        have hk_comp_false : k ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := by
          intro h; exact hk_trans_false (by obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := h; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩)
        have heq : k ≠ l := fun heq => hl₂ (heq ▸ hk₂)
        have _htf : k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hk_trans_false
        have _hcf : k ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := hk_comp_false
        have _hk2 : k ∈ Set.range e₂ := hk₂
        have _hl2 : l ∉ Set.range e₂ := hl₂
        have _heq : k ≠ l := heq
        simp_all
  · -- k not in range e₂
    have hk_trans_false : k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) :=
      not_mem_range_trans_of_not_mem_range₂ e₁ e₂ hk₂
    have hk_comp_false : k ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := by
      intro h; obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := h; exact hk_trans_false ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have _htf : k ∉ Set.range (e₁.trans e₂) := hk_trans_false
    have _hcf : k ∉ Set.range (⇑e₂ ∘ ⇑e₁) := hk_comp_false
    have _hk2 : k ∉ Set.range e₂ := hk₂
    simp_all

theorem extendByIdentity_trans (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity (R := R) (e₁.trans e₂) =
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity e₂).comp
        (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.extendByIdentity e₁) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Units.ext
  simp [coe_extendByIdentity, extendMatrix_trans]

theorem upper_extendByIdentity_trans (e₁ : ι ↪o κ) (e₂ : κ ↪o η) :
    UpperElementary.extendByIdentity (R := R) (e₁.trans e₂) =
      (UpperElementary.extendByIdentity e₂).comp
        (UpperElementary.extendByIdentity e₁) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [UpperElementary.coe_extendByIdentity, extendByIdentity_trans]

end Index

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

/-

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementarySweep

/-!
# Pivot clearing via division for upper-elementary sweeps

Specialization of the ring-generic `rowSweep` / `columnSweep` API to
explicit inverse-pivot coefficients. This is the first layer allowed to
assume division.

For `[DivisionRing K]` and `M : Matrix ι ι K`, `r c : ι`, `hp : M r c ≠ 0`,

* `rowClearCoeffs` uses coefficient `-(M i c) * (M r c)⁻¹` so that left row
  addition `row_i ← row_i + coeff * row_r` clears the `c`-column above `r`.
* `columnClearCoeffs` uses `-(M r c)⁻¹ * M r j` so right column addition
  `col_j ← col_j + col_c * coeff` clears the `r`-row to the right of `c`.

Assumptions are kept minimal: arbitrary possibly noncommutative division
rings and arbitrary finite linearly ordered index types, not `Field` or
`Fin n`. The generic sweep action formulas are reused directly; no
finite products are reopened.

Naturality under arbitrary `f : K →+* L` between division rings is proved
by combining sweep naturality with `f (a⁻¹) = (f a)⁻¹` for `a ≠ 0`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {K : Type*} [DivisionRing K]

section RowClear

/-- Coefficients clearing column `c` above row `r` via left multiplication. -/
noncomputable def rowClearCoeffs (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative K :=
  fun i => (fun _ : M r c ≠ 0 => Multiplicative.ofAdd (-(M i.val c * (M r c)⁻¹))) hp

/-- Ambient `GL` element clearing column `c` above `r`. -/
noncomputable def rowClear (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) : GL ι K :=
  rowSweep r (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp)

/-- Restricted `U_ι(K)` element clearing column `c` above `r`. -/
noncomputable def _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary.rowClear
    (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    upperElementarySubgroup ι K :=
  UpperElementary.rowSweep r (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp)

@[simp]
theorem coe_upper_rowClear (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    (↑(UpperElementary.rowClear M r c hp) : GL ι K) = rowClear M r c hp :=
  rfl

theorem rowClear_mul_apply (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (i j : ι) :
    (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) i j =
      if i < r then M i j + (-(M i c * (M r c)⁻¹)) * M r j else M i j := by
  have h_gen := rowSweep_mul_apply (R := K) r (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp) M i j
  have h_eq : ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      ((rowSweep r (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp) : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) := rfl
  rw [← h_eq] at h_gen
  by_cases hi : i < r
  · have h_dite : (if h : i < r then
        M i j + (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp ⟨i, h⟩).toAdd * M r j else M i j) =
        M i j + (-(M i c * (M r c)⁻¹)) * M r j := by
      rw [dite_eq_left hi]
      simp [rowClearCoeffs]
    rw [h_dite] at h_gen
    rw [ite_eq_left hi]
    exact h_gen
  · have h_dite : (if h : i < r then
        M i j + (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp ⟨i, h⟩).toAdd * M r j else M i j) =
        M i j := by
      rw [dite_eq_right hi]
    rw [h_dite] at h_gen
    rw [ite_eq_right hi]
    exact h_gen

theorem rowClear_clears_above (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (i : ι) (hi : i < r) :
    (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) i c = 0 := by
  have h := rowClear_mul_apply M r c hp i c
  rw [ite_eq_left hi] at h
  rw [h]
  have hp1 : (M r c)⁻¹ * M r c = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hp
  have h_assoc : M i c * (M r c)⁻¹ * M r c = M i c := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hp1, mul_one]
  have h_neg : -(M i c * (M r c)⁻¹) * M r c = -(M i c * (M r c)⁻¹ * M r c) := by
    rw [neg_mul]
  rw [h_neg, h_assoc, add_neg_cancel]

theorem rowClear_row_r (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (j : ι) :
    (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) r j = M r j :=
  rowSweep_mul_apply_same_row (R := K) r _ M j

theorem rowClear_of_not_lt (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (i j : ι) (h : ¬(i < r)) :
    (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) i j = M i j :=
  rowSweep_mul_apply_of_not_lt (R := K) r _ M i j h

end RowClear

section ColumnClear

/-- Coefficients clearing row `r` to the right of column `c`. -/
noncomputable def columnClearCoeffs (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative K :=
  fun j => (fun _ : M r c ≠ 0 => Multiplicative.ofAdd (-((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j.val))) hp

/-- Ambient `GL` element clearing row `r` to the right of `c`. -/
noncomputable def columnClear (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) : GL ι K :=
  columnSweep c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp)

/-- Restricted `U_ι(K)` element clearing row `r` to the right of `c`. -/
noncomputable def _root_.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary.columnClear
    (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    upperElementarySubgroup ι K :=
  UpperElementary.columnSweep c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp)

@[simp]
theorem coe_upper_columnClear (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    (↑(UpperElementary.columnClear M r c hp) : GL ι K) = columnClear M r c hp :=
  rfl

theorem columnClear_mul_apply (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (i j : ι) :
    (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) i j =
      if c < j then M i j + M i c * (-((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j)) else M i j := by
  have h_gen := columnSweep_mul_apply (R := K) c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp) M i j
  have h_eq : ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) =
      ((columnSweep c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp) : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) := rfl
  rw [← h_eq] at h_gen
  by_cases hj : c < j
  · have h_dite : (if h : c < j then
        M i j + M i c * (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp ⟨j, h⟩).toAdd else M i j) =
        M i j + M i c * (-((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j)) := by
      rw [dite_eq_left hj]
      simp [columnClearCoeffs]
    rw [h_dite] at h_gen
    rw [ite_eq_left hj]
    exact h_gen
  · have h_dite : (if h : c < j then
        M i j + M i c * (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp ⟨j, h⟩).toAdd else M i j) =
        M i j := by
      rw [dite_eq_right hj]
    rw [h_dite] at h_gen
    rw [ite_eq_right hj]
    exact h_gen

theorem columnClear_clears_right (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (j : ι) (hj : c < j) :
    (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) r j = 0 := by
  have h := columnClear_mul_apply M r c hp r j
  rw [ite_eq_left hj] at h
  rw [h]
  have hp1 : M r c * (M r c)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hp
  have h_assoc : M r c * ((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j) = M r j := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, hp1, one_mul]
  have h_neg : M r c * -((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j) = -(M r c * ((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j)) := by
    rw [mul_neg]
  rw [h_neg, h_assoc, add_neg_cancel]

theorem columnClear_col_c (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (i : ι) :
    (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) i c = M i c :=
  columnSweep_mul_apply_same_col (R := K) c _ M i

theorem columnClear_of_not_gt (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0)
    (i j : ι) (h : ¬(c < j)) :
    (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) i j = M i j :=
  columnSweep_mul_apply_of_not_gt (R := K) c _ M i j h

end ColumnClear

section PivotCleared

/-- Combined pivot-cleared matrix `L * M * R` where `L` clears above and `R` clears to the right. -/
noncomputable def pivotCleared (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    Matrix ι ι K :=
  ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M *
    ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)

theorem pivotCleared_pivot (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) (hp : M r c ≠ 0) :
    pivotCleared M r c hp r c = M r c := by
  unfold pivotCleared
  have h_same_col : ∀ (N : Matrix ι ι K),
      (N * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) r c = N r c := by
    intro N
    exact columnSweep_mul_apply_same_col (R := K) c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp) N r
  rw [h_same_col]
  exact rowClear_row_r M r c hp c

end PivotCleared

section GreatestHelpers

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] in
theorem isGreatest_support_iff (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι) :
    IsGreatest {i | M i c ≠ 0} r ↔ M r c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, r < i → M i c = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    constructor
    · exact hg.1
    · intro i hri
      by_contra h
      have hi_mem : i ∈ {i | M i c ≠ 0} := h
      have hle := hg.2 hi_mem
      have h_lt : r < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hri hle
      exact lt_irrefl r h_lt
  · intro ⟨hr, hvan⟩
    constructor
    · exact hr
    · intro i hi
      by_contra h_not_le
      have hlt : r < i := not_le.mp h_not_le
      exact hi (hvan i hlt)

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] in
theorem isGreatest_support_imp_gt_eq_zero {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hg : IsGreatest {i | M i c ≠ 0} r) (i : ι) (hi : r < i) : M i c = 0 :=
  ((isGreatest_support_iff M r c).mp hg).2 i hi

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] in
theorem isGreatest_support_imp_mem {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hg : IsGreatest {i | M i c ≠ 0} r) : M r c ≠ 0 :=
  ((isGreatest_support_iff M r c).mp hg).1

end GreatestHelpers

section LeastHelpers

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] K in
theorem isLeast_univ_iff_forall_le (c : ι) :
    IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c ↔ ∀ j : ι, c ≤ j := by
  constructor
  · intro h j
    exact h.2 (Set.mem_univ j)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ c, fun _ _ => h _⟩

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] K in
theorem isLeast_univ_imp_lt_of_ne {c j : ι} (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c)
    (hj : j ≠ c) : c < j := by
  have hle : c ≤ j := (isLeast_univ_iff_forall_le c).mp hc j
  have h_ne : c ≠ j := Ne.symm hj
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle h_ne

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] K in
theorem isLeast_univ_imp_forall_le {c : ι} (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c)
    (j : ι) : c ≤ j :=
  ((isLeast_univ_iff_forall_le c).mp hc) j

end LeastHelpers

section ColRowIsolated

theorem rowClear_col_isolated_of_isGreatest {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hg : IsGreatest {i | M i c ≠ 0} r) (i : ι) :
    (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) i c =
      if i = r then M r c else 0 := by
  by_cases hir : i = r
  · rw [ite_eq_left hir, hir, rowClear_row_r]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hir]
    by_cases hlt : i < r
    · rw [rowClear_clears_above M r c hp i hlt]
    · have hgt : r < i := by
        have h_le : r ≤ i := le_of_not_gt hlt
        have h_ne : r ≠ i := Ne.symm hir
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne h_le h_ne
      have h_zero : M i c = 0 := isGreatest_support_imp_gt_eq_zero hg i hgt
      have h_eq := rowClear_of_not_lt M r c hp i c hlt
      rw [h_eq, h_zero]

theorem pivotCleared_col_isolated {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hg : IsGreatest {i | M i c ≠ 0} r) (i : ι) :
    pivotCleared M r c hp i c = if i = r then M r c else 0 := by
  unfold pivotCleared
  have h_same_col : ∀ (N : Matrix ι ι K),
      (N * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) i c = N i c := by
    intro N
    exact columnSweep_mul_apply_same_col (R := K) c (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp) N i
  rw [h_same_col]
  exact rowClear_col_isolated_of_isGreatest hp hg i

theorem columnClear_row_isolated_of_isLeast {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) (j : ι) :
    (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) r j =
      if j = c then M r c else 0 := by
  by_cases hjc : j = c
  · rw [ite_eq_left hjc, hjc, columnClear_col_c]
  · rw [ite_eq_right hjc]
    have hlt : c < j := isLeast_univ_imp_lt_of_ne hc hjc
    exact columnClear_clears_right M r c hp j hlt

theorem pivotCleared_row_isolated {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hc : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c) (j : ι) :
    pivotCleared M r c hp r j = if j = c then M r c else 0 := by
  have h_row_r : ∀ j',
      (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) r j' = M r j' := by
    intro j'
    exact rowClear_row_r M r c hp j'
  calc pivotCleared M r c hp r j
      = ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) * M * (columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) :
          Matrix ι ι K) r j := rfl
    _ = ∑ k, (((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) * M) r k *
          ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) k j := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = ∑ k, M r k * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) k j := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        rw [h_row_r]
    _ = (M * ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)) r j := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ = if j = c then M r c else 0 := columnClear_row_isolated_of_isLeast hp hc j

theorem pivotCleared_row_isolated_of_forall_le {M : Matrix ι ι K} {r c : ι}
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hc : ∀ j : ι, c ≤ j) (j : ι) :
    pivotCleared M r c hp r j = if j = c then M r c else 0 := by
  have hc' : IsLeast (Set.univ : Set ι) c := (isLeast_univ_iff_forall_le c).mpr hc
  exact pivotCleared_row_isolated hp hc' j

end ColRowIsolated

section Naturality

variable {L : Type*} [DivisionRing L]

private theorem ringHom_map_ne_zero {f : K →+* L} {a : K} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    f a ≠ 0 := by
  intro h_zero
  have h_one : f 1 = 1 := f.map_one
  have h_a_inv : a * a⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ ha
  have h_mul : f a * f a⁻¹ = 1 := by
    calc f a * f a⁻¹ = f (a * a⁻¹) := by rw [← f.map_mul]
      _ = f 1 := by rw [h_a_inv]
      _ = 1 := h_one
  rw [h_zero, zero_mul] at h_mul
  exact one_ne_zero h_mul.symm

private theorem ringHom_map_inv {f : K →+* L} {a : K} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    f a⁻¹ = (f a)⁻¹ := by
  have hfa_ne : f a ≠ 0 := ringHom_map_ne_zero ha
  have h1 : f a * f a⁻¹ = 1 := by
    have : f (a * a⁻¹) = f 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ ha]
    calc f a * f a⁻¹ = f (a * a⁻¹) := by rw [← f.map_mul]
      _ = f 1 := by rw [this]
      _ = 1 := f.map_one
  have h2 : (f a)⁻¹ * f a = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hfa_ne
  calc f a⁻¹ = 1 * f a⁻¹ := by rw [one_mul]
    _ = ((f a)⁻¹ * f a) * f a⁻¹ := by rw [h2]
    _ = (f a)⁻¹ * (f a * f a⁻¹) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (f a)⁻¹ * 1 := by rw [h1]
    _ = (f a)⁻¹ := by rw [mul_one]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] in
theorem rowClearCoeffs_map (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) (i : RowIdx ι r) :
    multiplicativeMap f (rowClearCoeffs M r c hp i) =
      rowClearCoeffs (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' i := by
  simp only [rowClearCoeffs, multiplicativeMap]
  have h1 : f (M i.val c) = (M.map ⇑f) i.val c := rfl
  have h2 : f (M r c) = (M.map ⇑f) r c := rfl
  calc f (-(M i.val c * (M r c)⁻¹))
      = -(f (M i.val c * (M r c)⁻¹)) := by rw [f.map_neg]
    _ = -(f (M i.val c) * f ((M r c)⁻¹)) := by rw [f.map_mul]
    _ = -(f (M i.val c) * (f (M r c))⁻¹) := by rw [ringHom_map_inv hp]
    _ = -((M.map ⇑f) i.val c * ((M.map ⇑f) r c)⁻¹) := by rw [h1, h2]

theorem rowClear_mapRingHom (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (rowClear M r c hp) =
      rowClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' := by
  unfold rowClear
  rw [rowSweep_mapRingHom (f := f) (r := r)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact rowClearCoeffs_map f M r c hp hp' i

theorem upperRowClear_mapRingHom (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) :
    UpperElementary.mapRingHom (ι := ι) f (UpperElementary.rowClear M r c hp) =
      UpperElementary.rowClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [UpperElementary.coe_mapRingHom]
  exact rowClear_mapRingHom f M r c hp hp'

omit [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] in
theorem columnClearCoeffs_map (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) (j : ColIdx ι c) :
    multiplicativeMap f (columnClearCoeffs M r c hp j) =
      columnClearCoeffs (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' j := by
  simp only [columnClearCoeffs, multiplicativeMap]
  have h1 : f (M r j.val) = (M.map ⇑f) r j.val := rfl
  have h2 : f (M r c) = (M.map ⇑f) r c := rfl
  calc Multiplicative.ofAdd (f (-((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j.val)))
      = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-(f ((M r c)⁻¹ * M r j.val))) := by rw [f.map_neg]
    _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-(f ((M r c)⁻¹) * f (M r j.val))) := by rw [f.map_mul]
    _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-((f (M r c))⁻¹ * f (M r j.val))) := by
        rw [ringHom_map_inv hp]
    _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-(((M.map ⇑f) r c)⁻¹ * (M.map ⇑f) r j.val)) := by
        rw [h1, h2]

theorem columnClear_mapRingHom (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) :
    mapRingHom (n := ι) f (columnClear M r c hp) =
      columnClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' := by
  unfold columnClear
  rw [columnSweep_mapRingHom (f := f) (c := c)]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact columnClearCoeffs_map f M r c hp hp' j

theorem upperColumnClear_mapRingHom (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) :
    UpperElementary.mapRingHom (ι := ι) f (UpperElementary.columnClear M r c hp) =
      UpperElementary.columnClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [UpperElementary.coe_mapRingHom]
  exact columnClear_mapRingHom f M r c hp hp'

omit [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] in
private theorem matrix_map_mul (f : K →+* L) (A B : Matrix ι ι K) :
    (A * B).map ⇑f = A.map ⇑f * B.map ⇑f := by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, map_sum]
  simp only [f.map_mul]

omit [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] in
private theorem matrix_map_mul_assoc (f : K →+* L) (A B C : Matrix ι ι K) :
    (A * B * C).map ⇑f = A.map ⇑f * B.map ⇑f * C.map ⇑f := by
  calc (A * B * C).map ⇑f = ((A * B) * C).map ⇑f := by rfl
    _ = (A * B).map ⇑f * C.map ⇑f := matrix_map_mul f (A * B) C
    _ = (A.map ⇑f * B.map ⇑f) * C.map ⇑f := by rw [matrix_map_mul f A B]
    _ = A.map ⇑f * B.map ⇑f * C.map ⇑f := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

theorem pivotCleared_map (f : K →+* L) (M : Matrix ι ι K) (r c : ι)
    (hp : M r c ≠ 0) (hp' : (M.map ⇑f) r c ≠ 0) :
    (pivotCleared M r c hp).map ⇑f = pivotCleared (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' := by
  unfold pivotCleared
  have hL : ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f =
      ((rowClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
    calc ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f
        = ((mapRingHom (n := ι) f (rowClear M r c hp) : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
          rw [coe_mapRingHom]
      _ = ((rowClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
          rw [rowClear_mapRingHom f M r c hp hp']
  have hR : ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f =
      ((columnClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
    calc ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K).map ⇑f
        = ((mapRingHom (n := ι) f (columnClear M r c hp) : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
          rw [coe_mapRingHom]
      _ = ((columnClear (M.map ⇑f) r c hp' : GL ι L) : Matrix ι ι L) := by
          rw [columnClear_mapRingHom f M r c hp hp']
  have h_eq := matrix_map_mul_assoc f
    ((rowClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K) M
    ((columnClear M r c hp : GL ι K) : Matrix ι ι K)
  rw [h_eq, hL, hR]

end Naturality

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementarySweep

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix Finset Function

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

section RowRectangular

variable {κ : Type*}

theorem rowSingle_mul_entry_rect (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (i : RowIdx ι r) (M : Matrix ι κ R) (p : ι) (q : κ) :
    (rowSingle r v i * M) p q =
      if p = i.val then (v i).toAdd * M r q else 0 := by
  unfold rowSingle
  by_cases hp : p = i.val
  · subst hp
    have h1 : (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd * M) i.val q =
        (v i).toAdd * M r q := by
      calc (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd * M) i.val q
          = ∑ x, (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd) i.val x * M x q := by
            rw [mul_apply]
        _ = ∑ x, (if r = x then (v i).toAdd else 0) * M x q := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x _
            by_cases hx : r = x
            · simp [hx]
            · simp [hx]
        _ = (v i).toAdd * M r q := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r]
            · simp
            · intro b _ hb
              have : r ≠ b := fun h => hb h.symm
              simp [this]
            · simp
    simp [h1]
  · have h_zero : (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd * M) p q = 0 := by
      calc (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd * M) p q
          = ∑ x, (Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd) p x * M x q := by
            rw [mul_apply]
        _ = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro x _
            have : Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd p x = 0 := by
              have : ¬(i.val = p ∧ r = x) := by
                intro ⟨hp', _⟩
                exact hp hp'.symm
              rw [Matrix.single_apply]
              rw [ite_eq_right this]
            simp [this]
    simp [hp, h_zero]

theorem rowSum_mul_apply_finset_rect (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (s : Finset (RowIdx ι r)) (M : Matrix ι κ R) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    ((∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j =
      ∑ k ∈ s, (rowSingle r v k * M) i j := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    calc ((∑ k ∈ insert a s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j
        = ((rowSingle r v a + ∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      _ = (rowSingle r v a * M + (∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j := by
          rw [Matrix.add_mul]
      _ = (rowSingle r v a * M) i j + ((∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j := by
          rw [Matrix.add_apply]
      _ = (rowSingle r v a * M) i j + ∑ k ∈ s, (rowSingle r v k * M) i j := by
          rw [ih]
      _ = ∑ k ∈ insert a s, (rowSingle r v k * M) i j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]

theorem rowSum_mul_entry_rect (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (s : Finset (RowIdx ι r)) (M : Matrix ι κ R) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    ((∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j =
      ∑ k ∈ s, if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0 := by
  classical
  calc ((∑ k ∈ s, rowSingle r v k) * M) i j
      = ∑ k ∈ s, (rowSingle r v k * M) i j :=
        rowSum_mul_apply_finset_rect r v s M i j
    _ = ∑ k ∈ s, if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact rowSingle_mul_entry_rect r v k M i j

theorem rowSum_mul_apply_rect (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (M : Matrix ι κ R) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (rowSum r v * M) i j =
      if h : i < r then (v ⟨i, h⟩).toAdd * M r j else 0 := by
  classical
  have h_general := rowSum_mul_entry_rect r v Finset.univ M i j
  unfold rowSum at h_general ⊢
  rw [h_general]
  by_cases hi : i < r
  · have h_eq : (∑ k : RowIdx ι r,
          if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0) =
        (v ⟨i, hi⟩).toAdd * M r j := by
      have h_eq2 : ∀ (k : RowIdx ι r),
          (if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0) =
            if k = ⟨i, hi⟩ then (v ⟨i, hi⟩).toAdd * M r j else 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = ⟨i, hi⟩
        · subst hk
          simp
        · have hval : ¬(i = k.val) := by
            intro heq
            apply hk
            exact Subtype.ext heq.symm
          simp [hval, hk]
      calc (∑ k : RowIdx ι r, if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0)
          = ∑ k : RowIdx ι r,
              if k = ⟨i, hi⟩ then (v ⟨i, hi⟩).toAdd * M r j else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            exact h_eq2 k
        _ = (v ⟨i, hi⟩).toAdd * M r j := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨i, hi⟩ : RowIdx ι r)]
            · simp
            · intro b _ hb
              simp [hb]
            · intro hb
              exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hb
    rw [h_eq]
    simp [hi]
  · have h_all_zero : ∀ (k : RowIdx ι r),
        (if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0) = 0 := by
      intro k
      have hval : ¬(i = k.val) := by
        intro heq
        have : i < r := heq ▸ k.prop
        exact hi this
      simp [hval]
    have : (∑ k : RowIdx ι r,
        if i = k.val then (v k).toAdd * M r j else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      exact h_all_zero k
    rw [this]
    simp [hi]

theorem rowSweep_mul_apply_rect (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (M : Matrix ι κ R) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (((rowSweep r v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) * M) i j =
      if h : i < r then M i j + (v ⟨i, h⟩).toAdd * M r j else M i j := by
  classical
  have h_eq : (↑(rowSweep r v) : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 + rowSum r v :=
    coe_rowSweep r v
  calc (((rowSweep r v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) * M) i j
      = (((1 : Matrix ι ι R) + rowSum r v) * M) i j := by rw [h_eq]
    _ = (M + (rowSum r v * M)) i j := by rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = M i j + (rowSum r v * M) i j := by rw [Matrix.add_apply]
    _ = if h : i < r then M i j + (v ⟨i, h⟩).toAdd * M r j else M i j := by
        rw [rowSum_mul_apply_rect]
        by_cases hi : i < r <;> simp [hi]

theorem rowSweep_mul_apply_same_row_rect (r : ι)
    (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) (M : Matrix ι κ R) (j : κ) :
    (((rowSweep r v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) * M) r j = M r j := by
  have h := rowSweep_mul_apply_rect r v M r j
  have hr : ¬(r < r) := lt_irrefl r
  simp only [hr, dite_false] at h
  exact h

theorem rowSweep_mul_apply_of_not_lt_rect (r : ι)
    (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) (M : Matrix ι κ R)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (h : ¬(i < r)) :
    (((rowSweep r v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) * M) i j = M i j := by
  have h_eq := rowSweep_mul_apply_rect r v M i j
  simp only [h, dite_false] at h_eq
  exact h_eq

end RowRectangular

section ColRectangular

variable {κ : Type*}

theorem colSingle_mul_entry_rect (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (j : ColIdx ι c) (M : Matrix κ ι R) (p : κ) (q : ι) :
    (M * colSingle c v j) p q =
      if q = j.val then M p c * (v j).toAdd else 0 := by
  unfold colSingle
  by_cases hq : q = j.val
  · subst hq
    have h1 : (M * Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) p j.val =
        M p c * (v j).toAdd := by
      calc (M * Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) p j.val
          = ∑ x, M p x * (Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) x j.val := by
            rw [mul_apply]
        _ = ∑ x, M p x * (if c = x then (v j).toAdd else 0) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro x _
            by_cases hx : c = x
            · simp [hx]
            · simp [hx]
        _ = M p c * (v j).toAdd := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c]
            · simp
            · intro b _ hb
              have : c ≠ b := fun h => hb h.symm
              simp [this]
            · simp
    simp [h1]
  · have h_zero : (M * Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) p q = 0 := by
      calc (M * Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) p q
          = ∑ x, M p x * (Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd) x q := by
            rw [mul_apply]
        _ = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro x _
            have : Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd x q = 0 := by
              have : ¬(c = x ∧ j.val = q) := by
                intro ⟨_, hq_eq⟩
                exact hq hq_eq.symm
              rw [Matrix.single_apply]
              rw [ite_eq_right this]
            simp [this]
    simp [hq, h_zero]

theorem colSum_mul_aux_finset_rect (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (s : Finset (ColIdx ι c)) (M : Matrix κ ι R) (i : κ) (j : ι) :
    (M * (∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j =
      ∑ k ∈ s, (M * colSingle c v k) i j := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    calc (M * (∑ k ∈ insert a s, colSingle c v k)) i j
        = (M * (colSingle c v a + ∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      _ = (M * colSingle c v a + M * (∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_add]
      _ = (M * colSingle c v a) i j + (M * (∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j := by
          rw [Matrix.add_apply]
      _ = (M * colSingle c v a) i j + ∑ k ∈ s, (M * colSingle c v k) i j := by
          rw [ih]
      _ = ∑ k ∈ insert a s, (M * colSingle c v k) i j := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]

theorem colSum_mul_entry_rect (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (s : Finset (ColIdx ι c)) (M : Matrix κ ι R) (i : κ) (j : ι) :
    (M * (∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j =
      ∑ k ∈ s, if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0 := by
  classical
  calc (M * (∑ k ∈ s, colSingle c v k)) i j
      = ∑ k ∈ s, (M * colSingle c v k) i j :=
        colSum_mul_aux_finset_rect c v s M i j
    _ = ∑ k ∈ s, if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        exact colSingle_mul_entry_rect c v k M i j

theorem colSum_mul_apply_rect (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (M : Matrix κ ι R) (i : κ) (j : ι) :
    (M * colSum c v) i j =
      if h : c < j then M i c * (v ⟨j, h⟩).toAdd else 0 := by
  classical
  have h_general := colSum_mul_entry_rect c v Finset.univ M i j
  unfold colSum at h_general ⊢
  rw [h_general]
  by_cases hj : c < j
  · have h_eq : (∑ k : ColIdx ι c,
          if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0) =
        M i c * (v ⟨j, hj⟩).toAdd := by
      have h_eq2 : ∀ (k : ColIdx ι c),
          (if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0) =
            if k = ⟨j, hj⟩ then M i c * (v ⟨j, hj⟩).toAdd else 0 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : k = ⟨j, hj⟩
        · subst hk
          simp
        · have hval : ¬(j = k.val) := by
            intro heq
            apply hk
            exact Subtype.ext heq.symm
          simp [hval, hk]
      calc (∑ k : ColIdx ι c, if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0)
          = ∑ k : ColIdx ι c,
              if k = ⟨j, hj⟩ then M i c * (v ⟨j, hj⟩).toAdd else 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k _
            exact h_eq2 k
        _ = M i c * (v ⟨j, hj⟩).toAdd := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨j, hj⟩ : ColIdx ι c)]
            · simp
            · intro b _ hb
              simp [hb]
            · intro hb
              exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hb
    rw [h_eq]
    simp [hj]
  · have h_all_zero : ∀ (k : ColIdx ι c),
        (if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0) = 0 := by
      intro k
      have hval : ¬(j = k.val) := by
        intro heq
        have : c < j := heq ▸ k.prop
        exact hj this
      simp [hval]
    have : (∑ k : ColIdx ι c,
        if j = k.val then M i c * (v k).toAdd else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      exact h_all_zero k
    rw [this]
    simp [hj]

theorem columnSweep_mul_apply_rect (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (M : Matrix κ ι R) (i : κ) (j : ι) :
    (M * ((columnSweep c v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)) i j =
      if h : c < j then M i j + M i c * (v ⟨j, h⟩).toAdd else M i j := by
  classical
  have h_eq : (↑(columnSweep c v) : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 + colSum c v :=
    coe_columnSweep c v
  calc (M * ((columnSweep c v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)) i j
      = (M * ((1 : Matrix ι ι R) + colSum c v)) i j := by rw [h_eq]
    _ = (M + M * colSum c v) i j := by rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = M i j + (M * colSum c v) i j := by rw [Matrix.add_apply]
    _ = if h : c < j then M i j + M i c * (v ⟨j, h⟩).toAdd else M i j := by
        rw [colSum_mul_apply_rect]
        by_cases hj : c < j <;> simp [hj]

theorem columnSweep_mul_apply_same_col_rect (c : ι)
    (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R) (M : Matrix κ ι R) (i : κ) :
    (M * ((columnSweep c v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)) i c = M i c := by
  have h := columnSweep_mul_apply_rect c v M i c
  have hc : ¬(c < c) := lt_irrefl c
  simp only [hc, dite_false] at h
  exact h

theorem columnSweep_mul_apply_of_not_gt_rect (c : ι)
    (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R) (M : Matrix κ ι R)
    (i : κ) (j : ι) (h : ¬(c < j)) :
    (M * ((columnSweep c v : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R)) i j = M i j := by
  have h_eq := columnSweep_mul_apply_rect c v M i j
  simp only [h, dite_false] at h_eq
  exact h_eq

end ColRectangular

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSpecialLinear
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.SpecialLinearStabilization

/-!
# Upper-elementary / special-linear stabilization compatibility

Ring-generic compatibility between the already accepted upper-elementary
successor stabilization and the accepted special-linear successor
stabilization.  The proof descends to the existing `GL` coercion identities
`coe_stabilization`, `toGL_stabilization` and `toGL_toSLHom` and does not
redo matrix entry calculations.  No Bruhat or monomial-matrix material is
introduced in this file.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}

@[simp]
theorem toSLHom_stabilization (u : upperElementarySubgroup (Fin n) R) :
    toSLHom (stabilization R n u) =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (toSLHom u) := by
  apply Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_injective
  calc Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (toSLHom (stabilization R n u))
      = (stabilization R n u : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin (n + 1)) R) := by
        rw [toGL_toSLHom]
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R (u : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) R) := by
        rw [coe_stabilization]
    _ = Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.stabilization R
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL (toSLHom u)) := by
        rw [toGL_toSLHom]
    _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization R (toSLHom u)) := by
        rw [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_stabilization]

theorem toSLHom_comp_stabilization :
    (toSLHom (R := R) (ι := Fin (n + 1))).comp (stabilization R n) =
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.stabilization (R := R) (n := n)).comp
        (toSLHom (R := R) (ι := Fin n)) := by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro u
  exact toSLHom_stabilization (R := R) (n := n) u

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary

-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.UpperElementary
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementaryRelations
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.NoncommPiCoprod
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Basic

/-!
# Simultaneous upper-elementary sweeps

For `r : ι`, `rowSweep r` is the commuting product `∏_{i < r} E_{i,r}(v i)`.
For `c : ι`, `columnSweep c` is `∏_{c < j} E_{c,j}(v j)`.

Ring-generic, uses `MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod` and `commute_elementary_elementary`.
Matrix is `1 + ∑ single` and action formulas are load-bearing for Bruhat.
Division only enters later when choosing clearing coefficients.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix Finset Function

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]

section DecPred

noncomputable instance decPred_lt_r (r : ι) :
    DecidablePred (fun i : ι => i < r) :=
  fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _

noncomputable instance decPred_gt_c (c : ι) :
    DecidablePred (fun j : ι => c < j) :=
  fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _

end DecPred

abbrev RowIdx (ι : Type*) [LinearOrder ι] (r : ι) := {i : ι // i < r}
abbrev ColIdx (ι : Type*) [LinearOrder ι] (c : ι) := {j : ι // c < j}

noncomputable instance rowFintype (r : ι) : Fintype (RowIdx ι r) :=
  Subtype.fintype (fun i : ι => i < r)

noncomputable instance colFintype (c : ι) : Fintype (ColIdx ι c) :=
  Subtype.fintype (fun j : ι => c < j)

section ElementaryMulHom

noncomputable def elementaryMulHom (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Multiplicative R →* GL ι R where
  toFun v := elementary i j hij v.toAdd
  map_one' := by simp
  map_mul' a b := by
    simp only [toAdd_mul]
    rw [← elementary_mul_same]

end ElementaryMulHom

section RowFamily

noncomputable def rowFamily (r : ι) (i : RowIdx ι r) :
    Multiplicative R →* GL ι R :=
  elementaryMulHom (R := R) i.val r (ne_of_lt i.prop)

theorem rowFamily_commute (r : ι) :
    Pairwise fun (i j : RowIdx ι r) =>
      ∀ (x y : Multiplicative R),
        Commute (rowFamily (R := R) r i x) (rowFamily r j y) := by
  intro i j _hij x y
  have hi : i.val ≠ r := ne_of_lt i.prop
  have hj : j.val ≠ r := ne_of_lt j.prop
  have hrj : r ≠ j.val := Ne.symm hj
  have hri : r ≠ i.val := Ne.symm hi
  exact commute_elementary_elementary i.val r j.val r
    hi hj hrj hri x.toAdd y.toAdd

noncomputable def rowSweep (r : ι) :
    (RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) →* GL ι R :=
  MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod
    (fun i => rowFamily (R := R) r i) (rowFamily_commute (R := R) r)

theorem rowSweep_mulSingle (r : ι) (i : RowIdx ι r) (v : Multiplicative R) :
    rowSweep (R := R) r (Pi.mulSingle i v) = rowFamily r i v := by
  classical
  simp [rowSweep, MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle]

end RowFamily

section ColFamily

noncomputable def colFamily (c : ι) (j : ColIdx ι c) :
    Multiplicative R →* GL ι R :=
  elementaryMulHom (R := R) c j.val (ne_of_lt j.prop)

theorem colFamily_commute (c : ι) :
    Pairwise fun (i j : ColIdx ι c) =>
      ∀ (x y : Multiplicative R),
        Commute (colFamily (R := R) c i x) (colFamily c j y) := by
  intro i j _hij x y
  have hi : c ≠ i.val := ne_of_lt i.prop
  have hj : c ≠ j.val := ne_of_lt j.prop
  have h1 : i.val ≠ c := Ne.symm hi
  have h2 : j.val ≠ c := Ne.symm hj
  exact commute_elementary_elementary c i.val c j.val
    hi hj h1 h2 x.toAdd y.toAdd

noncomputable def columnSweep (c : ι) :
    (ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R) →* GL ι R :=
  MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod
    (fun j => colFamily (R := R) c j) (colFamily_commute (R := R) c)

theorem columnSweep_mulSingle (c : ι) (j : ColIdx ι c) (v : Multiplicative R) :
    columnSweep (R := R) c (Pi.mulSingle j v) = colFamily c j v := by
  classical
  simp [columnSweep, MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod_mulSingle]

end ColFamily

section RowMatrix

noncomputable def rowSingle (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (i : RowIdx ι r) : Matrix ι ι R :=
  Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd

noncomputable def rowMatElem (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (i : RowIdx ι r) : Matrix ι ι R :=
  1 + rowSingle r v i

theorem rowSingle_mul_rowSingle_zero (r : ι)
    (v w : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) (i j : RowIdx ι r) :
    rowSingle r v i * rowSingle r w j = 0 := by
  ext p q
  simp only [mul_apply, rowSingle]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x _
  have hrj : r ≠ j.val := Ne.symm (ne_of_lt j.prop)
  by_cases hp : i.val = p
  · by_cases hx : r = x
    · have hxj : j.val ≠ x := by
        rw [← hx]
        exact hrj.symm
      have h2 : Matrix.single j.val r (w j).toAdd x q = 0 := by
        simp [hxj]
      simp [h2]
    · have h1 : Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd p x = 0 := by
        simp [hx]
      simp [h1]
  · have h1 : Matrix.single i.val r (v i).toAdd p x = 0 := by
      simp [hp]
    simp [h1]

theorem rowSingle_mul_sum_zero (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (a : RowIdx ι r) (s : Finset (RowIdx ι r)) :
    rowSingle r v a * (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) = 0 := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  exact rowSingle_mul_rowSingle_zero r v v a i

theorem rowMatElem_eq_val_rowFamily (r : ι)
    (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) (i : RowIdx ι r) :
    rowMatElem r v i = (rowFamily (R := R) r i (v i) : Matrix ι ι R) := rfl

theorem coe_rowSweep_aux (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R)
    (s : Finset (RowIdx ι r)) :
    (↑(s.noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))
      (fun (i : RowIdx ι r) _ (j : RowIdx ι r) _ hij =>
        rowFamily_commute (R := R) r hij (v i) (v j))
      : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) =
      1 + ∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    have h_empty : (∅ : Finset (RowIdx ι r)).noncommProd
        (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))
        (fun (i : RowIdx ι r) _ (j : RowIdx ι r) _ hij =>
          rowFamily_commute (R := R) r hij (v i) (v j)) = 1 := rfl
    simp only [h_empty, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero, Units.val_one]
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    have h_comm_insert : (↑(insert a s) : Set (RowIdx ι r)).Pairwise
        (onFun Commute (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))) := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact rowFamily_commute (R := R) r hij (v i) (v j)
    have h_comm_s : (↑s : Set (RowIdx ι r)).Pairwise
        (onFun Commute (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))) := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      exact rowFamily_commute (R := R) r hij (v i) (v j)
    have h_prod : (insert a s).noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))
        h_comm_insert =
        rowFamily r a (v a) *
          s.noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i)) h_comm_s := by
      rw [Finset.noncommProd_insert_of_notMem _ _ _ _ ha]
    calc (↑((insert a s).noncommProd
          (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i)) h_comm_insert : GL ι R)
          : Matrix ι ι R)
        = (↑(rowFamily r a (v a) *
            s.noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i)) h_comm_s
            : GL ι R) : Matrix ι ι R) := by rw [h_prod]
      _ = (↑(rowFamily r a (v a)) : Matrix ι ι R) *
          ↑(s.noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i)) h_comm_s
            : GL ι R) := rfl
      _ = rowMatElem r v a * (1 + ∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) := by
          rw [rowMatElem_eq_val_rowFamily, ih]
      _ = (1 + rowSingle r v a) * (1 + ∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) := rfl
      _ = 1 + (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) + rowSingle r v a +
            rowSingle r v a * (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) := by
          simp only [mul_add, add_mul, one_mul, mul_one]
          abel
      _ = 1 + rowSingle r v a + (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) +
            rowSingle r v a * (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) := by
          abel
      _ = 1 + rowSingle r v a + (∑ i ∈ s, rowSingle r v i) := by
          rw [rowSingle_mul_sum_zero, add_zero]
      _ = 1 + (∑ i ∈ insert a s, rowSingle r v i) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
          abel

noncomputable def rowSum (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) :
    Matrix ι ι R :=
  ∑ i : RowIdx ι r, rowSingle r v i

theorem coe_rowSweep (r : ι) (v : RowIdx ι r → Multiplicative R) :
    (↑(rowSweep r v) : Matrix ι ι R) = 1 + rowSum r v := by
  classical
  unfold rowSweep rowSum
  have h_eq : MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod
      (fun i => rowFamily (R := R) r i) (rowFamily_commute r) v =
      Finset.univ.noncommProd (fun i => rowFamily r i (v i))
        (fun (i : RowIdx ι r) _ (j : RowIdx ι r) _ hij =>
          rowFamily_commute (R := R) r hij (v i) (v j)) := rfl
  rw [h_eq]
  exact coe_rowSweep_aux r v Finset.univ

end RowMatrix

section ColMatrix

noncomputable def colSingle (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (j : ColIdx ι c) : Matrix ι ι R :=
  Matrix.single c j.val (v j).toAdd

noncomputable def colMatElem (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)

  1 + colSingle c v j

theorem colSingle_mul_colSingle_zero (c : ι)
    (v w : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R) (i j : ColIdx ι c) :
    colSingle c v i * colSingle c w j = 0 := by
  ext p q
  simp only [mul_apply, colSingle]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x _
  have hci : c ≠ i.val := ne_of_lt i.prop
  by_cases hp : c = p
  · by_cases hx : i.val = x
    · have hcx : c ≠ x := by
        rw [← hx]
        exact hci
      have h2 : Matrix.single c j.val (w j).toAdd x q = 0 := by
        simp [hcx]
      simp [h2]
    · have h1 : Matrix.single c i.val (v i).toAdd p x = 0 := by
        simp [hx]
      simp [h1]
  · have h1 : Matrix.single c i.val (v i).toAdd p x = 0 := by
      simp [hp]
    simp [h1]

theorem colSingle_mul_sum_zero (c : ι) (v : ColIdx ι c → Multiplicative R)
    (a : ColIdx ι c) (s : Finset (ColIdx ι c)) :
    colSingle c v a * (∑ i ∈ s, colSingle c v i) = 0 := by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
