module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSpecialLinear
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSimpleRoot
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSimpleRootRealization
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BruhatSimpleRootExtraction
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ElementaryRelations
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.Field
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Commutator.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Cover
public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Defs
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup

/-!
# Upper Weyl generation for `SL`

The subgroup of `SL ι R` generated by the full image of
`UpperElementary.toSLHom` and the adjacent Weyl elements
`weylSLUnit i j hij.ne 1` contains every transvection. Over a field with
`[Nontrivial ι]` it is `⊤`.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

open Matrix
open scoped commutatorElement

variable {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

/-- Adjacent unit-one Weyl generators. -/
def adjacentWeylSet (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    Set (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R) :=
  { g | ∃ (i j : ι) (hij : i ⋖ j), g = weylSLUnit i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) }

/-- Generating set for the upper-plus-adjacent-Weyl subgroup. -/
def upperWeylGenerators (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    Set (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R) :=
  Set.range (UpperElementary.toSLHom (R := R) (ι := ι)) ∪
    adjacentWeylSet ι R

/-- Subgroup of `SL ι R` generated by `UpperElementary.toSLHom` and adjacent Weyls. -/
def upperWeylSubgroup (ι : Type*) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι]
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι R) :=
  Subgroup.closure (upperWeylGenerators ι R)

theorem upperWeylGenerators_mem_range {g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R} :
    UpperElementary.toSLHom (R := R) g ∈ upperWeylGenerators ι R :=
  Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self g)

theorem adjacentWeyl_mem_upperWeylGenerators {i j : ι} (hij : i ⋖ j) :
    weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) ∈ upperWeylGenerators ι R :=
  Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩

theorem UpperElementary_toSLHom_mem_upperWeylSubgroup
    (g : upperElementarySubgroup ι R) :
    UpperElementary.toSLHom (R := R) g ∈ upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
  Subgroup.subset_closure upperWeylGenerators_mem_range

theorem weylSLUnit_mem_upperWeylSubgroup {i j : ι} (hij : i ⋖ j) :
    weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (adjacentWeyl_mem_upperWeylGenerators (R := R) hij)

/- Bridge: `toGL` of a transvection is the GL elementary matrix. -/
private theorem toGL_transvection_eq_elementary {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    [Fintype ι] {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a) : GL ι R) =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a := by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe]

private theorem toSLHom_elementary_eq_transvection' {i j : ι} (hij : i < j)
    (a : R) :
    UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.elementary i j hij a) =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_lt hij) a := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

private theorem upper_transvection_mem {i j : ι} (hij : i < j) (a : R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_lt hij) a ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
  have h_eq : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_lt hij) a =
      UpperElementary.toSLHom (UpperElementary.elementary i j hij a) :=
    (toSLHom_elementary_eq_transvection' (R := R) hij a).symm
  rw [h_eq]
  exact UpperElementary_toSLHom_mem_upperWeylSubgroup
    (UpperElementary.elementary i j hij a)

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem weylSLUnit_one_conj_transvection_neg
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (r : R) :
    weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-r) *
        (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ))⁻¹ =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm r := by
  have hWeyl_eq :
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ) =
        monomialSLHom R ι (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij 1) := by
    rw [weylSLUnit_eq_monomialSLHom]
  have hRight_i :
      (weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right i = j := by
    simp [weylMonomialSLUnit, weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylPerm]
  have hRight_j :
      (weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right j = i := by
    simp [weylMonomialSLUnit, weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylPerm]
  have hLeft_right_i :
      (weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
          ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right i) = (-1 : Rˣ) := by
    rw [hRight_i]
    simp [weylMonomialSLUnit, weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylWeightUnit,
      hij.symm]
  have hLeft_right_j :
      (weylMonomialSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
          ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right j) = (1 : Rˣ) := by
    rw [hRight_j]
    simp [weylMonomialSLUnit, weylMonomialBaseUnit, weylWeightUnit]
  have hConjM :
      monomialSLHom R ι (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij 1) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-r) *
          (monomialSLHom R ι (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij 1))⁻¹ =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection
          (fun h => hij
            (Equiv.injective
              (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right h))
          (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
              ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right i) : R) *
            (-r) *
            (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
                ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right j))⁻¹ : Rˣ).val) :=
    monomialSLHom_conj_elementary
      (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)) i j hij (-r)
  have hCoeff :
      (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
            ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right i) : R) *
          (-r) *
          (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
              ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right j))⁻¹ : Rˣ).val) =
        r := by
    rw [hLeft_right_i, hLeft_right_j]
    simp
  have hTrans_eq :
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection
          (fun h => hij
            (Equiv.injective
              (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right h))
          (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
              ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right i) : R) *
            (-r) *
            (((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.left
                ((weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ)).1.right j))⁻¹ : Rˣ).val) =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm r := by
    rw [hCoeff]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe, weylMonomialBaseUnit,
      weylPerm]
  calc weylSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-r) *
          (weylSLUnit i j hij (1 : Rˣ))⁻¹
      = monomialSLHom R ι (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij 1) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-r) *
          (monomialSLHom R ι (weylMonomialSLUnit i j hij 1))⁻¹ := by
        rw [hWeyl_eq]
    _ = Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm r := by
        rw [hConjM, hTrans_eq]

omit [LinearOrder ι] in
theorem weylSLUnit_one_conj_transvection
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a *
        (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij (1 : Rˣ))⁻¹ =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm (-a) := by
  have h := weylSLUnit_one_conj_transvection_neg hij (-a)
  simpa using h

/- Lower cover transvections via Weyl conjugation. -/
private theorem lower_cover_transvection_mem {i j : ι} (hij : i ⋖ j) (r : R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne.symm r ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
  have hWeyl : weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
    weylSLUnit_mem_upperWeylSubgroup hij
  have hUpper : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne (-r) ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
    have h_lt : i < j := hij.lt
    have h_eq : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne (-r) =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_lt h_lt) (-r) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact upper_transvection_mem h_lt (-r)
  have hConj_mem :
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne (-r) *
          (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ))⁻¹ ∈
        upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
    Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.mul_mem _ hWeyl hUpper)
      (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hWeyl)
  have hConj_eq :
      weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ) *
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne (-r) *
          (weylSLUnit (R := R) i j hij.ne (1 : Rˣ))⁻¹ =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.ne.symm r :=
    weylSLUnit_one_conj_transvection_neg hij.ne r
  rw [← hConj_eq]
  exact hConj_mem

/-- Lower-root Chevalley commutator identity: for `a < b < c` in a finite
linear order over a commutative ring, the commutator of the lower transvections
`e_{c b}(r)` and `e_{b a}(1)` is `e_{c a}(r)`. -/
theorem transvection_commutator_lower {a b c : ι} (hab : a < b)
    (hbc : b < c) (r : R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R) *
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r)⁻¹ *
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R))⁻¹ =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection
        (ne_of_gt (lt_trans hab hbc)) r := by
  apply Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_injective
  have h_toGL_comm :
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r *
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R) *
            (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r)⁻¹ *
            (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R))⁻¹) =
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r) : GL ι R) *
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R)) : GL ι R) *
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc) r) : GL ι R)⁻¹ *
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R)) : GL ι R)⁻¹ := by
    simp [map_mul, map_inv]
  rw [h_toGL_comm]
  simp only [toGL_transvection_eq_elementary]
  have hGL :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary c b (ne_of_gt hbc) r *
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary b a (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R) *
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary c b (ne_of_gt hbc) r)⁻¹ *
          (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary b a (ne_of_gt hab) (1 : R))⁻¹ =
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary c a
          (ne_of_gt (lt_trans hab hbc)) r := by
    have h_ne_ca : c ≠ a := ne_of_gt (lt_trans hab hbc)
    have h_ne_cb : c ≠ b := ne_of_gt hbc
    have h_ne_ba : b ≠ a := ne_of_gt hab
    have h_comm :=
      commutatorElement_elementary (n := ι) c a b h_ne_ca h_ne_cb h_ne_ba r (1 : R)
    simp [commutatorElement_def] at h_comm
    simpa [mul_one] using h_comm
  exact hGL

private theorem lower_transvection_mem_induction (j : ι) (i : ι) (hji : j < i)
    (r : R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hji) r ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
  have hTrans : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) j i :=
    (@lt_iff_transGen_covBy ι _ (Fintype.toLocallyFiniteOrder (α := ι)) j i).mp hji
  let P : ι → ι → Prop := fun a c =>
    ∀ (h : a < c) (r : R),
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt h) r ∈
        upperWeylSubgroup ι R
  have hP : P j i :=
    Relation.TransGen.trans_induction_on hTrans
      (fun {a b} (hab : a ⋖ b) => by
        intro h r
        have h_eq :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt h) r =
              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hab.ne.symm r := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact lower_cover_transvection_mem hab r)
      (fun {a b c} (hab : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) a b)
          (hbc : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) b c) (ihab : P a b) (ihbc : P b c) => by
        intro h r
        have hab_lt : a < b :=
          (@lt_iff_transGen_covBy ι _
            (Fintype.toLocallyFiniteOrder (α := ι)) a b).mpr hab
        have hbc_lt : b < c :=
          (@lt_iff_transGen_covBy ι _
            (Fintype.toLocallyFiniteOrder (α := ι)) b c).mpr hbc
        have hac_lt : a < c := lt_trans hab_lt hbc_lt
        have h_eq :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt h) r =
              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hac_lt) r := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe]
        rw [h_eq]
        have h_bc_mem :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r ∈
              upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
          ihbc hbc_lt r
        have h_ab_one_mem :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R) ∈
              upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
          ihab hab_lt 1
        have h_comm_mem :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r *
                Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R) *
                (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r)⁻¹ *
                (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R))⁻¹ ∈
              upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
          have h1 :
              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r *
                  Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R) ∈
                upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
            Subgroup.mul_mem _ h_bc_mem h_ab_one_mem
          have h2 :
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r)⁻¹ ∈
                upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
            Subgroup.inv_mem _ h_bc_mem
          have h3 :
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R))⁻¹ ∈
                upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
            Subgroup.inv_mem _ h_ab_one_mem
          have h4 :
              (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r)⁻¹ *
                  (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R))⁻¹ ∈
                upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
            Subgroup.mul_mem _ h2 h3
          have h5 :
              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r *
                  Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R) *
                  ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r)⁻¹ *
                    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt)
                        (1 : R))⁻¹) ∈
                upperWeylSubgroup ι R :=
            Subgroup.mul_mem _ h1 h4
          simpa [mul_assoc] using h5
        have h_comm_eq :
            Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r *
                Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R) *
                (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hbc_lt) r)⁻¹ *
                (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hab_lt) (1 : R))⁻¹ =
              Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt hac_lt) r :=
          transvection_commutator_lower hab_lt hbc_lt r
        rw [← h_comm_eq]
        exact h_comm_mem)
  exact hP hji r

theorem transvection_mem_upperWeylSubgroup (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (a : R) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a ∈
      upperWeylSubgroup ι R := by
  rcases Ne.lt_or_gt hij with h_lt | h_gt
  · have h_eq : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_lt h_lt) a := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact upper_transvection_mem h_lt a
  · have h_lt : j < i := h_gt
    have h_eq : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a =
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection (ne_of_gt h_lt) a := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    exact lower_transvection_mem_induction j i h_lt a

section FieldCase

variable {F : Type*} [Field F] [Nontrivial ι]

theorem upperWeylSubgroup_eq_top :
    upperWeylSubgroup (ι := ι) (R := F) = ⊤ := by
  rw [Subgroup.eq_top_iff']
  intro g
  have h_det :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
          (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]
    exact g.prop
  have h_mem_ker :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) ∈
        MonoidHom.ker (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (n := ι) (R := F)) := by
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, h_det]
  have h_mem_elem :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) ∈
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup ι F := by
    have h_eq := Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup_eq_ker_det
      (ι := ι) (F := F)
    rw [← h_eq] at h_mem_ker
    exact h_mem_ker
  have h_le :
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup ι F ≤
        Subgroup.map Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (upperWeylSubgroup (ι := ι) (R := F)) := by
    rw [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementarySubgroup,
      Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, a, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h_trans :
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a ∈
          upperWeylSubgroup (ι := ι) (R := F) :=
      transvection_mem_upperWeylSubgroup i j hij a
    have h_eq :
        (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
            (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a) : GL ι F) =
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.elementary i j hij a :=
      toGL_transvection_eq_elementary hij a
    rw [← h_eq]
    exact Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, h_trans, rfl⟩
  have h_in_map :
      (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL g : GL ι F) ∈
        Subgroup.map Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL
          (upperWeylSubgroup (ι := ι) (R := F)) :=
    h_le h_mem_elem
  obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp h_in_map
  have h_eq2 : h = g :=
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toGL_injective heq
  rw [← h_eq2]
  exact hh

end FieldCase

end Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup

-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.BlockElementary

/-!
# Weak block LDU identity

For `B : (Fin n) × (Fin 1)`, `C : (Fin 1) × (Fin n)`,
`T, S : GL (Fin n)`, `t : GL (Fin 1)`:

`upperUnit B * blockDiagonal T t * lowerUnit C * blockDiagonalOne S = 1`

implies `B = 0`, `C = 0`, `t = 1`, `T * S = 1`
by expanding `fromBlocks` and cancelling invertible `t` and `S`.
Separate `T = 1` and `S = 1` is not claimed. Proof uniform for `n = 0`.
Uses weakest robust `Ring` API; if `Field` needed we would note it.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Matrix
namespace GeneralLinearGroup
namespace BlockElementary

open Matrix

variable {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [Ring R]

/-- Weak uniqueness: upper * diag * lower * diagOne = 1 gives
`B = 0`, `C = 0`, `t = 1`, `T * S = 1`. Not `T = 1`, `S = 1`. -/
theorem weakBlockLDU_eq_one
    {B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin 1) R} {C : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin n) R}
    {T S : GL (Fin n) R} {t : GL (Fin 1) R}
    (h : upperUnit (α := Fin n) (β := Fin 1) B *
      blockDiagonal (α := Fin n) (β := Fin 1) T t *
      lowerUnit (α := Fin n) (β := Fin 1) C *
      blockDiagonalOne (Fin n) (Fin 1) R S = 1) :
    B = 0 ∧ C = 0 ∧ t = 1 ∧ T * S = 1 := by
  have hM0 := congrArg Units.val h
  simp only [Units.val_mul, Units.val_one] at hM0
  rw [coe_upperUnit, blockDiagonal_eq_blockDiagonalHom, coe_blockDiagonalHom,
    coe_lowerUnit, coe_blockDiagonalOne] at hM0
  have hF : fromBlocks (((↑T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) +
      B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C) *
      (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
      (B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R))
      (((↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C) * (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R))
      (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) = 1 := by
    simpa only [fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, add_zero, zero_add, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add] using hM0
  rw [← fromBlocks_one] at hF
  have hBt : B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simpa [fromBlocks_apply₁₂] using congrFun (congrFun hF (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
  have htC : ((↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C) *
      (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simpa [fromBlocks_apply₂₁] using congrFun (congrFun hF (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inl j)
  have ht1 : (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) = 1 := by
    ext i j
    simpa [fromBlocks_apply₂₂] using congrFun (congrFun hF (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inr j)
  have hTS : ((↑T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) +
      B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C) *
      (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) = 1 := by
    ext i j
    simpa [fromBlocks_apply₁₁] using congrFun (congrFun hF (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
  have hB : B = 0 := by
    calc B = B * (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) := by rw [ht1]
      _ = 0 := hBt
  have hCS : C * (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) = 0 := by
    calc C * (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
        = (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C *
          (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) := by
          rw [ht1, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = 0 := htC
  have hC : C = 0 := by
    calc C = C * (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) := by rw [Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = C * (↑S * S.inv : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) := by rw [← S.val_inv]
      _ = C * (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) * S.inv := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (0 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin n) R) * S.inv := by rw [hCS]
      _ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.zero_mul]
  have ht : t = 1 := Units.ext ht1
  have hTSl : T * S = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    calc (↑(T * S) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R)
        = (↑T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) *
          (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) := rfl
      _ = ((↑T : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) +
          B * (↑t : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) R) * C) *
          (↑S : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) := by rw [hB, hC]; simp
      _ = 1 := hTS
  exact ⟨hB, hC, ht, hTSl⟩

end BlockElementary
end GeneralLinearGroup
end Matrix

Author: @toskua, Avocado

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorAlgebra.Grading
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorAlgebra.ToTensorPower
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.AlgHom
public import MathlibExt.RingTheory.GradedAlgebra.Projection

/-!
# General tensor-algebra grading API

This file provides a reusable grading API for `TensorAlgebra R M`:

* `tprod` lies in the natural degree `n` piece `(range ι) ^ n`;
* `TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra` corestricts to that degree;
* linear equivalence `TensorPower R n M ≃ₗ degree n`;
* `TensorAlgebra.lift R f` is a `GradedAlgHom` when `f` lands in degree one.

It provides fully general statements over a
commutative semiring `R` and an `R`-module `M`, using `TensorAlgebra.equivDirectSum` and
`TensorAlgebra.toDirectSum`, for reuse in general graded-algebra settings.

## Main definitions

* `TensorAlgebra.degree R M n` – the degree-`n` submodule `(range ι) ^ n`.
* `TensorAlgebra.list_prod_mem_degree` – list product of degree-one elements lies in
  degree indexed by length.
* `TensorAlgebra.tprod_mem_degree` – `tprod` lies in `degree`.
* `TensorAlgebra.toTensorAlgebra_mem_degree` – `toTensorAlgebra` lands in `degree`.
* `TensorAlgebra.toDegree` – corestriction of `toTensorAlgebra` to `degree`.
* `TensorAlgebra.degreeToTensorPower` – projection from `degree` to `TensorPower`.
* `TensorAlgebra.tensorPowerEquivDegree` – the linear equivalence.
* `TensorAlgebra.range_toTensorAlgebra_eq_degree` – range of `toTensorAlgebra` is `degree`.
* `TensorAlgebra.degree_eq_span_range_tprod` – `degree n` is spanned by pure `tprod`s.
* `TensorAlgebra.lift_mem_degree` and `TensorAlgebra.liftGradedAlgHom` – graded lift.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped DirectSum TensorProduct
open TensorAlgebra DirectSum

namespace TensorAlgebra

variable {R M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]

/-- Degree-`n` submodule of `TensorAlgebra R M`, defined as the `n`-th power of the
range of `ι`. This is the family used by `TensorAlgebra.gradedAlgebra`. -/
abbrev degree (R : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) : Submodule R (TensorAlgebra R M) :=
  (LinearMap.range (ι R : M →ₗ[R] TensorAlgebra R M)) ^ n

/-- Degree zero is the `1` submodule. -/
theorem degree_zero : degree R M 0 = 1 := by
  simp [degree, pow_zero]

/-- Degree one is the range of `ι`. -/
theorem degree_one : degree R M 1 = LinearMap.range (ι R : M →ₗ[R] TensorAlgebra R M) := by
  simp [degree, pow_one]

/-- A list whose entries all lie in degree one has product in the degree indexed by
its length. This is the reusable list version of the graded multiplication for the
tensor algebra. -/
theorem list_prod_mem_degree {l : List (TensorAlgebra R M)}
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ degree R M 1) : l.prod ∈ degree R M l.length := by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.length_nil, List.prod_nil]
    exact SetLike.one_mem_graded _
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    have hd_mem : hd ∈ degree R M 1 := hl hd (by simp)
    have tl_mem : ∀ x ∈ tl, x ∈ degree R M 1 := fun x hx =>
      hl x (by simp [hx])
    have ih_mem : tl.prod ∈ degree R M tl.length := ih tl_mem
    have hmul : hd * tl.prod ∈ degree R M (1 + tl.length) :=
      SetLike.mul_mem_graded hd_mem ih_mem
    have h_eq : 1 + tl.length = (hd :: tl).length := by simp [Nat.add_comm]
    rw [h_eq] at hmul
    exact hmul

/-- `TensorAlgebra.tprod` lies in the natural degree `n` piece. -/
theorem tprod_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    tprod R M n x ∈ degree R M n := by
  rw [tprod_apply]
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ List.ofFn (fun i => ι R (x i)), y ∈ degree R M 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp hy with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [degree_one]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
  have hlen : (List.ofFn fun i => ι R (x i)).length = n := by simp
  have hprod : (List.ofFn fun i => ι R (x i)).prod ∈
      degree R M (List.ofFn fun i => ι R (x i)).length :=
    list_prod_mem_degree hmem
  rwa [hlen] at hprod

/-- `TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra` lands in the degree-`n` piece. -/
theorem toTensorAlgebra_mem_degree (n : ℕ) (x : TensorPower R n M) :
    TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n) x ∈ degree R M n := by
  induction x using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | smul_tprod r f =>
    rw [map_smul, TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra_tprod]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (tprod_mem_degree n f)
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

/-- Corestriction of `TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra` to its natural degree. -/
def toDegree (n : ℕ) : TensorPower R n M →ₗ[R] ↥(degree R M n) :=
  (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)).codRestrict _
    (toTensorAlgebra_mem_degree n)

/-- The underlying element of `toDegree` is `toTensorAlgebra`. -/
@[simp]
theorem toDegree_apply_coe (n : ℕ) (x : TensorPower R n M) :
    (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n x : TensorAlgebra R M) =
      TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x :=
  rfl

/-- Pure tensors map to the product of `ι`'s in the degree submodule. -/
theorem toDegree_tprod (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x) =
      ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [toDegree, TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra_tprod]

/-! ### Lemmas for the equivalence with the direct sum -/

private lemma ofDirectSum_lof_eq_toTensorAlgebra (n : ℕ) (x : TensorPower R n M) :
    (ofDirectSum (R := R) (M := M)).toLinearMap
        (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n x) =
      TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x := by
  have h_eq : (ofDirectSum (R := R) (M := M)).toLinearMap =
      DirectSum.toModule R ℕ (TensorAlgebra R M)
        (fun i => TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := i)) := rfl
  rw [h_eq]
  exact DirectSum.toModule_lof R
    (M := fun i => TensorPower R i M)
    (φ := fun i => TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (n := i)) n x

/-- `toDirectSum` sends `toTensorAlgebra` to the `n`-th direct-sum component. -/
theorem toDirectSum_toTensorAlgebra_eq_of (n : ℕ) (x : TensorPower R n M) :
    toDirectSum (R := R) (M := M) (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x) =
      DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n x := by
  induction x using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | smul_tprod r f =>
    have h1 : TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) f) =
        tprod R M n f := TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra_tprod f
    calc toDirectSum (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (r • (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) f)))
        = toDirectSum (R := R) (r • tprod R M n f) := by
          rw [map_smul, h1]
      _ = r • toDirectSum (R := R) (tprod R M n f) := by rw [map_smul]
      _ = r • DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) f) := by
          rw [toDirectSum_tensorPower_tprod]
      _ = DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n (r • (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) f)) := by
          rw [← DirectSum.of_smul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    calc toDirectSum (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (x + y))
        = toDirectSum (R := R) (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x + TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra y) := by
          rw [map_add]
      _ = toDirectSum (R := R) (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x) +
          toDirectSum (R := R) (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra y) := by rw [map_add]
      _ = DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n x +
          DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n y := by rw [hx, hy]
      _ = DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n (x + y) := by
          rw [← map_add]

private lemma proj_ofDirectSum_eq_lapply (n : ℕ) :
    (GradedAlgebra.proj (degree R M) n).comp
        (ofDirectSum (R := R) (M := M)).toLinearMap =
      (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)).comp
        (DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n) := by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [ofDirectSum_lof_eq_toTensorAlgebra]
  have hmem : TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) x ∈ degree R M i :=
    toTensorAlgebra_mem_degree i x
  by_cases hi : i = n
  · cases hi
    have h_comp : (DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun j => TensorPower R j M) n)
        (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun j => TensorPower R j M) n x) = x := by simp
    simp only [h_comp]
    exact GradedAlgebra.proj_eq_self hmem
  · have h_comp_zero : (DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun j => TensorPower R j M) n)
        (DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun j => TensorPower R j M) i x) = 0 := by
      simp [DirectSum.component.of, hi]
    rw [h_comp_zero, map_zero]
    exact GradedAlgebra.proj_eq_zero_of_ne hmem hi

/-- Projection from the degree-`n` submodule to `TensorPower R n M`, using
`toDirectSum` and direct-sum projection. -/
def degreeToTensorPower (n : ℕ) : ↥(degree R M n) →ₗ[R] TensorPower R n M :=
  (DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n).comp
    ((toDirectSum (R := R) (M := M)).toLinearMap.comp (degree R M n).subtype)

/-- Left inverse: `degreeToTensorPower` after `toDegree` is identity. -/
private theorem degreeToTensorPower_toDegree (n : ℕ) (x : TensorPower R n M) :
    degreeToTensorPower (R := R) (M := M) n (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n x) = x := by
  simp only [degreeToTensorPower, toDegree, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
    LinearMap.codRestrict_apply]
  have h_eq : (toDirectSum (R := R) (M := M)).toLinearMap (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x) =
      toDirectSum (R := R) (M := M) (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra x) := rfl
  rw [h_eq, toDirectSum_toTensorAlgebra_eq_of]
  have h_of_lof : DirectSum.of (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n x =
      DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n x := by
    rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  rw [h_of_lof]
  simp

/-- Right inverse: `toDegree` after `degreeToTensorPower` is identity. -/
private theorem toDegree_degreeToTensorPower (n : ℕ) (y : ↥(degree R M n)) :
    toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n (degreeToTensorPower (R := R) (M := M) n y) = y := by
  set S := toDirectSum (R := R) (M := M) (y : TensorAlgebra R M)
  have h_y : (y : TensorAlgebra R M) =
      ofDirectSum (R := R) (M := M) S := by simp [S]
  have h_proj : GradedAlgebra.proj (degree R M) n (y : TensorAlgebra R M) =
      (y : TensorAlgebra R M) := GradedAlgebra.proj_eq_self y.2
  have h_eq : GradedAlgebra.proj (degree R M) n (ofDirectSum (R := R) (M := M) S) =
      TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M)
        ((DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n) S) := by
    have h := proj_ofDirectSum_eq_lapply (R := R) (M := M) n
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h S
  have h_combined : (y : TensorAlgebra R M) =
      TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra
        ((DirectSum.component R ℕ (fun i => TensorPower R i M) n) S) := by
    calc (y : TensorAlgebra R M) = GradedAlgebra.proj (degree R M) n (y : TensorAlgebra R M) :=
        h_proj.symm
      _ = GradedAlgebra.proj (degree R M) n (ofDirectSum S) := by rw [← h_y]
      _ = _ := h_eq
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [toDegree, degreeToTensorPower, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.codRestrict_apply,
    Submodule.subtype_apply]
  exact h_combined.symm

/-- Linear equivalence between `TensorPower R n M` and the degree-`n` submodule of the
tensor algebra. Uses `equivDirectSum` via `toDirectSum`. -/
noncomputable def tensorPowerEquivDegree (n : ℕ) :
    TensorPower R n M ≃ₗ[R] ↥(degree R M n) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap
    (toDegree n)
    (degreeToTensorPower n)
    (by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro y
      exact toDegree_degreeToTensorPower n y)
    (by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      exact degreeToTensorPower_toDegree n x)

/-- Forward direction sends pure tensors to `tprod`. -/
@[simp]
theorem tensorPowerEquivDegree_tprod (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    tensorPowerEquivDegree (R := R) (M := M) n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x) =
      ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩ := by
  calc tensorPowerEquivDegree n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x)
      = toDegree n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x) := rfl
    _ = _ := toDegree_tprod n x

/-- As an element of `TensorAlgebra R M`, the forward equivalence sends pure tensors to `tprod`. -/
theorem tensorPowerEquivDegree_apply_coe (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    (tensorPowerEquivDegree (R := R) (M := M) n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x) : TensorAlgebra R M) =
      tprod R M n x := by
  rw [tensorPowerEquivDegree_tprod]

/-- Backward direction sends `⟨tprod R M n x, _⟩` back to the pure tensor. -/
@[simp]
theorem degreeToTensorPower_tprod (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    degreeToTensorPower (R := R) (M := M) n ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩ =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod R x := by
  have h : degreeToTensorPower (R := R) (M := M) n
      (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x)) =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod R x :=
    degreeToTensorPower_toDegree n (PiTensorProduct.tprod R x)
  rw [toDegree_tprod] at h
  exact h

/-- Inverse equivalence sends `⟨tprod, _⟩` to the pure tensor. -/
theorem tensorPowerEquivDegree_symm_tprod (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → M) :
    (tensorPowerEquivDegree (R := R) (M := M) n).symm ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩ =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod R x := by
  calc (tensorPowerEquivDegree n).symm ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩
      = degreeToTensorPower n ⟨tprod R M n x, tprod_mem_degree n x⟩ := rfl
    _ = _ := degreeToTensorPower_tprod n x

/-- Range of `TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra` is exactly the degree-`n` submodule. -/
theorem range_toTensorAlgebra_eq_degree (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)) =
      degree R M n := by
  have h_eq : (degree R M n).subtype.comp (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n) =
      TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  have h_range_top : LinearMap.range (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n) = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    intro y
    exact ⟨degreeToTensorPower n y, toDegree_degreeToTensorPower n y⟩
  calc LinearMap.range (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n))
      = LinearMap.range ((degree R M n).subtype.comp (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n)) := by
        rw [h_eq]
    _ = Submodule.map (degree R M n).subtype
        (LinearMap.range (toDegree (R := R) (M := M) n)) := by
        rw [LinearMap.range_comp]
    _ = Submodule.map (degree R M n).subtype ⊤ := by rw [h_range_top]
    _ = degree R M n := by rw [Submodule.map_subtype_top]

/-- Degree-`n` submodule is spanned by pure tensor products `tprod R M n x`. -/
theorem degree_eq_span_range_tprod (n : ℕ) :
    degree R M n = Submodule.span R (Set.range (tprod R M n)) := by
  have h_range_span : LinearMap.range
      (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)) =
      Submodule.span R (Set.range (tprod R M n)) := by
    calc LinearMap.range (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n))
        = Submodule.map (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)) ⊤ := by
          rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]
      _ = Submodule.map (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n))
          (Submodule.span R (Set.range (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R)
            (s := fun _ : Fin n => M)))) := by
          rw [PiTensorProduct.span_tprod_eq_top]
      _ = Submodule.span R
          (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) ''
            Set.range (PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R)
              (s := fun _ : Fin n => M))) := by
          rw [Submodule.map_span]
      _ = Submodule.span R
          (Set.range (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) ∘
            PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) (s := fun _ : Fin n => M))) := by
          rw [Set.range_comp]
      _ = Submodule.span R (Set.range (tprod R M n)) := by
          have h_eq : (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) ∘
              PiTensorProduct.tprod (R := R) (s := fun _ : Fin n => M)) =
              tprod R M n := by
            funext x
            exact TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra_tprod x
          rw [h_eq]
  calc degree R M n = LinearMap.range
        (TensorPower.toTensorAlgebra (R := R) (M := M) (n := n)) := by
        rw [range_toTensorAlgebra_eq_degree]
    _ = Submodule.span R (Set.range (tprod R M n)) := h_range_span

/-! ### Graded lift -/

section Lift

variable {R M A : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
  [Semiring A] [Algebra R A]

private lemma algebraMap_mem_degree_zero_of_graded
    {ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R A} [GradedAlgebra ℬ] (r : R) : algebraMap R A r ∈ ℬ 0 := by
  have h1 : (1 : A) ∈ ℬ 0 := SetLike.one_mem_graded ℬ
  have h2 : r • (1 : A) ∈ ℬ 0 := Submodule.smul_mem _ r h1
  have h_eq : algebraMap R A r = r • (1 : A) := Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one r
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h2

/-- `TensorAlgebra.lift` sends the degree-`n` piece to degree-`n` when the generators land in
degree one. This is the direct component-membership theorem usable by clients. -/
theorem lift_mem_degree {ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R A} [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (hf : ∀ m : M, f m ∈ ℬ 1)
    {n : ℕ} {x : TensorAlgebra R M} (hx : x ∈ degree R M n) :
    (lift R (M := M) f) x ∈ ℬ n := by
  -- Use pow induction on `degree = (range ι)^n`
  let M₀ : Submodule R (TensorAlgebra R M) := LinearMap.range (ι R : M →ₗ[R] _)
  change x ∈ M₀ ^ n at hx
  -- motive for pow induction
  have motive : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : TensorAlgebra R M), y ∈ M₀ ^ k →
      (lift R f) y ∈ ℬ k := by
    intro k y hy
    induction hy using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      -- lift of algebraMap is algebraMap, which lies in degree 0
      have h_lift : (lift R (M := M) f) (algebraMap R (TensorAlgebra R M) r) =
          algebraMap R A r := by simp
      rw [h_lift]
      exact algebraMap_mem_degree_zero_of_graded r
    | add u v k hu hv ih_u ih_v =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ ih_u ih_v
    | mem_mul m hm k y hy ih =>
      -- m ∈ M₀ means ∃ a, m = ι a
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hm
      have h_lift_ι : (lift R (M := M) f) (ι R a) = f a := lift_ι_apply _ _
      have hf_mem : (lift R (M := M) f) (ι R a) ∈ ℬ 1 := by rw [h_lift_ι]; exact hf a
      have h_mul : (lift R (M := M) f) (ι R a * y) =
          (lift R (M := M) f) (ι R a) * (lift R (M := M) f) y := by rw [map_mul]
      rw [h_mul]
      have h_prod_mem : (lift R (M := M) f) (ι R a) * (lift R (M := M) f) y ∈ ℬ (1 + k) :=
        SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hf_mem ih
      have h_eq : ℬ (1 + k) = ℬ (k + 1) := by congr 1; exact Nat.add_comm 1 k
      rw [h_eq] at h_prod_mem
      exact h_prod_mem
  exact motive n x hx

/-- `TensorAlgebra.lift` packaged as a graded algebra homomorphism when generators land in
degree one. Uses `degree R M` as source grading. -/
noncomputable def liftGradedAlgHom {ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R A} [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (hf : ∀ m : M, f m ∈ ℬ 1) :
    (degree R M) →ₐᵍ[R] ℬ :=
  ⟨lift R (M := M) f, fun hx => lift_mem_degree f hf hx⟩

/-- The underlying map of `liftGradedAlgHom` is `lift`. -/
@[simp]
theorem liftGradedAlgHom_apply {ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R A} [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (hf : ∀ m : M, f m ∈ ℬ 1) (x : TensorAlgebra R M) :
    (liftGradedAlgHom (ℬ := ℬ) f hf) x = (lift R f) x :=
  rfl

/-- `liftGradedAlgHom` agrees with `f` on generators. -/
theorem liftGradedAlgHom_ι {ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R A} [GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (hf : ∀ m : M, f m ∈ ℬ 1) (m : M) :
    (liftGradedAlgHom (ℬ := ℬ) f hf) (ι R m) = f m := by
  simp [liftGradedAlgHom, lift_ι_apply]

end Lift

end TensorAlgebra

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorAlgebra.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.NonUnitalSubalgebra

/-!
# The actual augmentation kernel of the tensor algebra

The existing scalar retraction is the augmentation sending vector generators
to zero. Its genuine kernel inherits the original tensor multiplication and
has the original degree-one linear inclusion. These are the strict carrier
prerequisites for the positive tensor-power and universal nonunital maps.
Those further identifications and maps are separate constructions.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe uR uV

namespace TensorAlgebra

variable (R : Type uR) [CommSemiring R]
variable (V : Type uV) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]

/-- The genuine scalar-zero kernel of the existing tensor augmentation. -/
def augmentationKernel : NonUnitalSubalgebra R (TensorAlgebra R V) :=
  NonUnitalSubalgebra.comap (TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv.toNonUnitalAlgHom)
    (⊥ : NonUnitalSubalgebra R R)

/-- Membership uses the actual scalar component, with no chosen degree model. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_augmentationKernel (x : TensorAlgebra R V) :
    x ∈ augmentationKernel R V ↔ TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv x = 0 :=
  NonUnitalAlgebra.mem_bot

/-- The original vector generators have zero augmentation. -/
@[simp]
theorem algebraMapInv_ι (v : V) :
    TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv (TensorAlgebra.ι R v) = 0 := by
  simp only [TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv, TensorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]

/-- Every original vector belongs to the genuine augmentation kernel. -/
theorem ι_mem_augmentationKernel (v : V) :
    TensorAlgebra.ι R v ∈ augmentationKernel R V :=
  (mem_augmentationKernel R V _).2 (algebraMapInv_ι R V v)

/-- The augmentation kernel meets the original scalar summand only at zero. -/
theorem algebraMap_mem_augmentationKernel_iff (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (TensorAlgebra R V) r ∈ augmentationKernel R V ↔ r = 0 := by
  rw [mem_augmentationKernel, TensorAlgebra.algebraMap_leftInverse V r]

/-- Over nonzero scalars, the scalar unit is absent from the positive carrier. -/
theorem one_not_mem_augmentationKernel [Nontrivial R] :
    (1 : TensorAlgebra R V) ∉ augmentationKernel R V := by
  rw [mem_augmentationKernel]
  simpa only [map_one] using (one_ne_zero : (1 : R) ≠ 0)

end TensorAlgebra

/-- The nonunital tensor carrier is the actual augmentation kernel. -/
abbrev NonUnitalTensorAlgebra (R : Type uR) (V : Type uV)
    [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V] :=
  ↥(TensorAlgebra.augmentationKernel R V)

namespace NonUnitalTensorAlgebra

variable (R : Type uR) [CommSemiring R]
variable (V : Type uV) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]

/-- Include the original nonunital carrier in its actual unital tensor algebra. -/
def inclusion : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V →ₙₐ[R] TensorAlgebra R V :=
  NonUnitalSubalgebraClass.subtype (TensorAlgebra.augmentationKernel R V)

@[simp]
theorem inclusion_apply (x : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V) : inclusion R V x = x.1 := rfl

theorem inclusion_injective : Function.Injective (inclusion R V) := Subtype.val_injective

/-- The actual included tensor has zero scalar augmentation. -/
@[simp]
theorem algebraMapInv_inclusion (x : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V) :
    TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv (x : TensorAlgebra R V) = 0 :=
  (TensorAlgebra.mem_augmentationKernel R V _).1 x.property

/-- The degree-one inclusion has the original vector generator as its literal value. -/
def ι : V →ₗ[R] NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V :=
  (TensorAlgebra.ι R).codRestrict (TensorAlgebra.augmentationKernel R V).toSubmodule
    (TensorAlgebra.ι_mem_augmentationKernel R V)

@[simp]
theorem inclusion_ι (v : V) :
    (ι R V v : TensorAlgebra R V) = TensorAlgebra.ι R v := rfl

theorem ι_injective : Function.Injective (ι R V) := by
  intro v w h
  exact (TensorAlgebra.ι_inj R v w).1 (congrArg (inclusion R V) h)

/-- The original tensor multiplication is unchanged by the literal inclusion. -/
theorem inclusion_mul (x y : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V) :
    inclusion R V (x * y) = inclusion R V x * inclusion R V y :=
  (inclusion R V).map_mul x y

end NonUnitalTensorAlgebra

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.TensorAlgebra.NonUnital
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Unitization

/-!
# Lifting original vectors into a possibly nonunital algebra

The stock tensor lift into the actual algebraic unitization has the original
augmentation as its scalar component. Its second component therefore restricts
to a nonunital algebra homomorphism on the actual augmentation kernel.
This constructor serves the source tensor projection and kernel extension,
without selecting DATA from an open universal-property theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

universe uR uV uA
namespace NonUnitalTensorAlgebra

variable (R : Type uR) [CommSemiring R]
variable (V : Type uV) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalSemiring A] [Module R A]
variable [IsScalarTower R A A] [SMulCommClass R A A]

/-- The stock unital lift into the actual unitization of the original target. -/
def unitizationLift (s : V →ₗ[R] A) : TensorAlgebra R V →ₐ[R] Unitization R A :=
  TensorAlgebra.lift R ((Unitization.inrHom R R A).comp s)

/-- Original generators map to the scalar-zero embedding of their given values. -/
theorem unitizationLift_ι (s : V →ₗ[R] A) (v : V) :
    unitizationLift R V s (TensorAlgebra.ι R v) = (s v : Unitization R A) :=
  TensorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply ((Unitization.inrHom R R A).comp s) v

/-- The actual scalar component equals augmentation, allowing restriction to its kernel. -/
theorem unitizationLift_fst (s : V →ₗ[R] A) (x : TensorAlgebra R V) :
    (unitizationLift R V s x).fst = TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv x := by
  have h : (Unitization.fstHom (R := R) (A := A)).comp (unitizationLift R V s) =
      TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv := by
    apply TensorAlgebra.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change (unitizationLift R V s (TensorAlgebra.ι R v)).fst =
      TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv (TensorAlgebra.ι R v)
    rw [unitizationLift_ι, TensorAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι R V v]
    exact Unitization.fst_inr R (s v)
  exact congrArg (fun f : TensorAlgebra R V →ₐ[R] R => f x) h

/-- The original nonunital target receives the actual scalar-zero tensor carrier. -/
def lift (s : V →ₗ[R] A) : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V →ₙₐ[R] A where
  toFun x := (unitizationLift R V s x.1).snd
  map_zero' := by
    change (unitizationLift R V s 0).snd = 0
    rw [map_zero]
    exact Unitization.snd_zero
  map_add' := by
    intro x y
    change (unitizationLift R V s (x.1 + y.1)).snd =
      (unitizationLift R V s x.1).snd + (unitizationLift R V s y.1).snd
    rw [map_add, Unitization.snd_add]
  map_mul' := by
    intro x y
    change (unitizationLift R V s (x.1 * y.1)).snd =
      (unitizationLift R V s x.1).snd * (unitizationLift R V s y.1).snd
    rw [map_mul, Unitization.snd_mul]
    have hx := (TensorAlgebra.mem_augmentationKernel R V x.1).1 x.property
    have hy := (TensorAlgebra.mem_augmentationKernel R V y.1).1 y.property
    simp only [unitizationLift_fst, hx, hy, zero_smul, zero_add]
  map_smul' := by
    intro r x
    change (unitizationLift R V s (r • x.1)).snd = r • (unitizationLift R V s x.1).snd
    rw [map_smul, Unitization.snd_smul]

/-- The literal second-component value of the restricted lift. -/
theorem lift_apply (s : V →ₗ[R] A) (x : NonUnitalTensorAlgebra R V) :
    lift R V s x = (unitizationLift R V s x.1).snd := rfl

/-- The computed lift has every original degree-one value. -/
theorem lift_ι (s : V →ₗ[R] A) (v : V) :
    lift R V s (ι R V v) = s v := by
  change (unitizationLift R V s (TensorAlgebra.ι R v)).snd = s v
  rw [unitizationLift_ι]
  exact Unitization.snd_inr R (s v)

end NonUnitalTensorAlgebra

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Map
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fin.Basic

/-!
# The first coordinate of a tensor power

The cons equivalence is the native singleton tensor equivalence, tensor-product
concatenation, and reindexing. It is natural under the original linear map on
every factor. Only a commutative semiring and its modules are required.

This extracts the computed coordinate equivalence previously owned by the
coefficient Hochschild construction so other tensor-power clients can use it.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace TensorPower

universe u v w

/-- A first coordinate followed by the remaining tensor-power coordinates. -/
def consIndexEquiv (n : ℕ) : PUnit.{1} ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
  ((_root_.finSuccEquiv n).trans
    ((Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit.{0, 0} (Fin n)).trans
      (Equiv.sumComm (Fin n) PUnit.{1}))).symm

@[simp]
theorem consIndexEquiv_inl (n : ℕ) (x : PUnit.{1}) :
    consIndexEquiv n (Sum.inl x) = 0 := by
  cases x
  simp [consIndexEquiv]

@[simp]
theorem consIndexEquiv_inr (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    consIndexEquiv n (Sum.inr i) = i.succ := by
  simp [consIndexEquiv]

variable (k : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommSemiring k] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module k M]

/-- A tensor power of degree zero is canonically the scalar module. -/
def zeroEquiv : TensorPower k 0 M ≃ₗ[k] k :=
  PiTensorProduct.isEmptyEquiv (Fin 0)

/-- Separate the first tensor coordinate from a tensor power. -/
def consEquiv (n : ℕ) : M ⊗[k] TensorPower k n M ≃ₗ[k] TensorPower k (n + 1) M :=
  ((PiTensorProduct.subsingletonEquiv
      (R := k) (s := fun _ : PUnit.{1} => M) PUnit.unit).symm.rTensor
        (TensorPower k n M)).trans
    ((PiTensorProduct.tmulEquiv k M).trans
      (PiTensorProduct.reindex k (fun _ : PUnit.{1} ⊕ Fin n => M)
        (consIndexEquiv n)))

/-- The computed equivalence puts the literal first factor before the tail. -/
@[simp]
theorem consEquiv_tmul (n : ℕ) (m : M) (s : Fin n → M) :
    consEquiv k M n (m ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k s) =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod k (Fin.cons m s) := by
  simp only [consEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul,
    PiTensorProduct.subsingletonEquiv_symm_apply', PiTensorProduct.tmulEquiv_apply,
    PiTensorProduct.reindex_tprod]
  apply congrArg (PiTensorProduct.tprod k)
  funext i
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (consIndexEquiv n).surjective i
  rcases j with j | j
  · cases j
    change Sum.elim (fun _ : PUnit.{1} => m) s
      ((consIndexEquiv n).symm (consIndexEquiv n (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))) = m
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  · change Sum.elim (fun _ : PUnit.{1} => m) s
      ((consIndexEquiv n).symm (consIndexEquiv n (Sum.inr j))) = s j
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl

/-- Splitting a pure tensor recovers its actual first coordinate and tail. -/
@[simp]
theorem consEquiv_symm_tprod (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    (consEquiv k M n).symm (PiTensorProduct.tprod k a) =
      a 0 ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k (Fin.tail a) := by
  apply (consEquiv k M n).injective
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, consEquiv_tmul, Fin.cons_self_tail]

variable {k M} {N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module k N]

/-- Applying the original linear map to every factor commutes with cons coordinates. -/
theorem consEquiv_naturality (f : M →ₗ[k] N) (n : ℕ) :
    (consEquiv k N n).toLinearMap.comp
        (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin n => f))) =
      (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => f)).comp
        (consEquiv k M n).toLinearMap := by
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro m y
  have h :
      ((consEquiv k N n).toLinearMap.comp
        (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin n => f)))).comp
          (TensorProduct.mk k M (TensorPower k n M) m) =
      ((PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => f)).comp
        (consEquiv k M n).toLinearMap).comp
          (TensorProduct.mk k M (TensorPower k n M) m) := by
    apply PiTensorProduct.ext
    apply MultilinearMap.ext
    intro s
    change consEquiv k N n
        (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin n => f))
          (m ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k s)) =
      PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => f)
        (consEquiv k M n (m ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k s))
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, PiTensorProduct.map_tprod, consEquiv_tmul]
    apply congrArg (PiTensorProduct.tprod k)
    funext i
    cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h y


/-- Insert an actual first vector while retaining the original cons coordinates. -/
def consInsert (k : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommSemiring k] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module k M] (e : M) (n : ℕ) :
    M ⊗[k] TensorPower k n M →ₗ[k] M ⊗[k] TensorPower k (n + 1) M :=
  (TensorProduct.mk k M (TensorPower k (n + 1) M) e).comp
    (consEquiv k M n).toLinearMap

/-- The inserted vector precedes the actual first input vector and its tail. -/
@[simp]
theorem consInsert_tmul (k : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommSemiring k] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module k M] (e : M) (n : ℕ) (m : M) (a : Fin n → M) :
    consInsert k M e n (m ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k a) =
      e ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k (Fin.cons m a) := by
  change e ⊗ₜ[k] consEquiv k M n (m ⊗ₜ[k] PiTensorProduct.tprod k a) = _
  exact congrArg (fun y : TensorPower k (n + 1) M => e ⊗ₜ[k] y)
    (consEquiv_tmul k M n m a)

/-- Every original linear map takes insertion of e to insertion of its actual image. -/
theorem consInsert_naturality (f : M →ₗ[k] N) (e : M) (n : ℕ) :
    (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => f))).comp
        (consInsert k M e n) =
      (consInsert k N (f e) n).comp
        (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin n => f))) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => f))
      (e ⊗ₜ[k] consEquiv k M n x) =
    f e ⊗ₜ[k] consEquiv k N n
      (TensorProduct.map f (PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin n => f)) x)
  rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (consEquiv_naturality f n) x
  exact congrArg (fun y => f e ⊗ₜ[k] y) h.symm

end TensorPower
